ch.gaopingling.history: Sima Yi feigned illness to bait Cao Shuang; in the coup at the Gaoping Tombs, Wei slid into Sima hands.
ch.gaopingling.name: Gaoping Tombs
ch.gaopingling.note: Writer's note: his tells are all bait.
ch.gaopingling.premise: If that jar of "illness" had not fooled you.
ch.gaopingling.regret: One feigned sickness fooled all of Wei.
ch.gaopingling.ruleText: Every tell he shows is shown on purpose — expect feints in plenty.
ch.gaopingling.skirmish.name: Retainers of the Sima House
ch.gaopingling.yeshi: The porridge at the sickbed went to the dog. When he opened his eyes, your blade was already set.
ch.guandu.boss.name: Yuan Shao
ch.guandu.defeat: The fire at Wuchao never rose.
ch.guandu.history: Xu You came over; Wuchao burned; Yuan Shao's host collapsed.
ch.guandu.name: Guandu
ch.guandu.note: Writer's note: his granaries are full, yours are empty. Speed is your only ally.
ch.guandu.premise: If Xu You had not come over that night.
ch.guandu.regret: One fire at Wuchao bought the north ten years.
ch.guandu.ruleText: He has grain and you don't; the blinds climb faster. Make it quick.
ch.guandu.skirmish.name: Gao Lan · Champion of Hebei
ch.guandu.yeshi: This time the fire at Wuchao never caught. Hebei lost all the same — lost to the hearts of men.
ch.guijin.boss.name: Sima Yan
ch.guijin.boss.op.0.name: Sima Yan · He Who Takes the Seal
ch.guijin.boss.op.1.name: Wang Jun · Admiral of the Tower Ships
ch.guijin.defeat: In the end, all under heaven went to Jin.
ch.guijin.history: Three parts returned to Jin; the realm was one.
ch.guijin.name: All Under Jin
ch.guijin.note: Writer's note: long united, the realm must divide; long divided, it need not unite.
ch.guijin.premise: If the Three Kingdoms' game had one last hand in it.
ch.guijin.regret: Long divided, the realm must unite; long united... it need not stay that way.
ch.guijin.skirmish.name: Jin Vanguard
ch.guijin.yeshi: The tower ships never came; Jianye never fell. The Three Kingdoms' game still has players.
ch.huainan.boss.name: The Volunteers of Huainan
ch.huainan.defeat: The flags over Shouchun changed three times.
ch.huainan.history: Guanqiu Jian and Zhuge Dan rose in Huainan against the Simas, one after the other. Both fell, their families wiped out root and branch.
ch.huainan.name: Huainan
ch.huainan.note: Writer's note: the more names on your list, the more you need the hearts first.
ch.huainan.premise: If the call to arms had lacked only one name.
ch.huainan.regret: Three revolts in Huainan — the last spine Wei's ministers ever showed.
ch.huainan.ruleText: Two revolts, back to back: one starved for grain, one rotted from doubt.
ch.huainan.skirmish.name: Yue Chen Holds Huainan
ch.huainan.yeshi: Both manifestos reached Luoyang. From that day on, Sima Shi slept badly.
ch.huarong.boss.name: Cao Cao · At the End of His Road
ch.huarong.defeat: Cao's army is long gone; the trail stands empty.
ch.huarong.history: Yunchang released Cao Cao for old honor's sake.
ch.huarong.name: Huarong Trail
ch.huarong.note: Writer's note: on this page, winning still leaves a choice.
ch.huarong.premise: If, at that moment, the blade falls — or doesn't.
ch.huarong.regret: Sparing Cao Cao: honor, or a tiger let loose?
ch.huarong.ruleText: On this page, winning the hand still leaves you a choice.
ch.huarong.skirmish.name: Beaten Men
ch.huarong.yeshi: The blade fell. On the Huarong Trail, Cao Cao lost his head — and the north fell apart at once.
ch.hulao.boss.name: Lü Bu
ch.hulao.defeat: The finest under heaven — and every word of it true.
ch.hulao.history: The three heroes battled Lü Bu; Lü Bu rode away beaten.
ch.hulao.name: Hulao
ch.hulao.note: Writer's note: this one only advances, never retreats. Wait for him to run dry.
ch.hulao.omen.0: The Three Heroes at Your Back
ch.hulao.premise: If, when the strongest under heaven was called, only one man dared answer.
ch.hulao.regret: Three heroes fought Lü Bu — and even in victory, no second man dared try.
ch.hulao.ruleText: He is peerless under heaven and never gives ground. Fold, and wait for him to run dry.
ch.hulao.skirmish.name: Bingzhou Wolf Riders
ch.hulao.yeshi: The painted halberd struck the ground. The Marquis of Wen cast off his helmet and laughed long: "What a fight!"
ch.jiameng.boss.name: Ma Chao · Silver Spear, Brocade Robe
ch.jiameng.defeat: The lamp wick cracked; the spear went wide.
ch.jiameng.history: Zhang Fei fought Ma Chao at Jiameng Pass by lantern light, with no victor; Ma Chao later surrendered.
ch.jiameng.name: Jiameng Pass
ch.jiameng.note: Writer's note: you only see a man clearly when he can barely lift his arms.
ch.jiameng.premise: If, in the lantern-lit duel, one man had blinked first.
ch.jiameng.regret: Zhang Fei against Ma Chao — the last romance of the great brawlers.
ch.jiameng.skirmish.name: Ma Dai · Xiliang Wing
ch.jiameng.yeshi: After two hundred rounds, the two of them laughed across the fire pit. Second-best and third-best under heaven, in perfect mutual regard.
ch.jiange.boss.name: Zhong Hui · One Hundred Eighty Thousand Men
ch.jiange.defeat: Jianmen is steep, but one beam cannot hold up a house.
ch.jiange.history: Jiang Wei held Zhong Hui at Jiange until Zhong could not advance; Deng Ai then slipped across Yinping.
ch.jiange.name: Jiange
ch.jiange.note: Writer's note: hold the front — and mind the flank.
ch.jiange.premise: If one man at the gate had meant no trail behind it.
ch.jiange.regret: The sheer walls of Jiange stopped the army — not the Yinping trail.
ch.jiange.skirmish.name: Wei Vanguard Before the Gate
ch.jiange.yeshi: After twenty days staring at the gate, Zhong Hui set down his brush: "This gate isn't worth taking." Shu-Han bought one more winter.
ch.jieqiao.boss.name: Wen Chou · Hebei's Iron Spear
ch.jieqiao.defeat: The white horses forded the river; the vanguard was already drawn up.
ch.jieqiao.history: Yuan Shao smashed Gongsun Zan at Jieqiao; Qu Yi's first-to-the-walls led the charge.
ch.jieqiao.name: Jieqiao
ch.jieqiao.note: Writer's note: cavalry is fast, but never faster than a rank of crossbows.
ch.jieqiao.premise: If the White Horse Riders had never met the men who went over the walls first.
ch.jieqiao.regret: At Jieqiao the white horses were all broken — and Zhao Yun found his voice.
ch.jieqiao.skirmish.name: Qu Yi · First to the Walls
ch.jieqiao.yeshi: The wall-stormers never formed up; the white horses swept around them. Both banks of the Jie changed hands.
ch.jieting.boss.name: Zhang He
ch.jieting.defeat: No water on the hill; Jieting lost.
ch.jieting.history: Ma Su lost Jieting; Kongming put him to death through tears.
ch.jieting.name: Jieting
ch.jieting.note: Writer's note: stand and win; press and perish.
ch.jieting.premise: If Ma Su had camped on the road.
ch.jieting.regret: The tearful execution of Ma Su cut down his own mistake with him.
ch.jieting.skirmish.name: Wei Vanguard
ch.jieting.yeshi: One stockade on the road, and Zhang He could only stare. Jieting held; no tears were shed.
ch.kongcheng.boss.name: Sima Yi · The Feint
ch.kongcheng.defeat: One string snaps, and the whole board is lost.
ch.kongcheng.history: One empty city, and Zhongda drew his army back.
ch.kongcheng.name: The Empty City
ch.kongcheng.note: Writer's note: the cleverer he is, the easier the fooling.
ch.kongcheng.premise: If one string of that qin on the wall had snapped.
ch.kongcheng.regret: The empty city gambled on one thing: that he was too clever.
ch.kongcheng.ruleText: The cleverer he is, the easier the fooling — bluffs are worth more on this page.
ch.kongcheng.skirmish.name: Wei Scouts
ch.kongcheng.yeshi: The qin never broke, and he fell back thirty li. Above the wall and below it, each side swallowed a breath.
ch.luofengpo.boss.name: Zhang Ren
ch.luofengpo.defeat: The phoenix falls before the slope; the arrows fall like rain.
ch.luofengpo.history: Pang Tong took a stray arrow at Fallen Phoenix Slope and died, thirty-six years old.
ch.luofengpo.name: Fallen Phoenix Slope
ch.luofengpo.note: Writer's note: the name of the place bodes ill. Plan around it.
ch.luofengpo.premise: If the Dilu had never changed riders.
ch.luofengpo.regret: The fledgling phoenix fell on the slope, thirty-six years old.
ch.luofengpo.skirmish.name: Ambush of the Riverlands
ch.luofengpo.yeshi: Before the slope, the ambush lunged at empty air. The fledgling phoenix spread his wings and flew straight into Chengdu.
ch.maicheng.boss.name: Lü Meng · Lu Xun
ch.maicheng.boss.op.0.name: Lü Meng · White Robes
ch.maicheng.boss.op.1.name: Lu Xun · The Long Game
ch.maicheng.defeat: Over Maicheng, the snow fell all night again.
ch.maicheng.history: Yunchang fell; Sun Quan sent his head to Luoyang.
ch.maicheng.name: Maicheng
ch.maicheng.note: Writer's note: this page is where the whole book weeps.
ch.maicheng.regret: The death of Yunchang is the book's deepest unfinished grief.
ch.maicheng.skirmish.name: Eastern Wu · Pan Zhang
ch.maicheng.yeshi: A snowy night at Maicheng: Yunchang cut his way free, and Jingzhou stood whole.
ch.nanjun.boss.name: Cao Ren · Heaven-Sent Defender
ch.nanjun.defeat: Under Nanjun's walls, the wound split again.
ch.nanjun.history: Zhou Yu besieged Nanjun for over a year; Cao Ren abandoned the city, and the commander's wound broke open.
ch.nanjun.name: Nanjun
ch.nanjun.note: Writer's note: the man behind walls does not fear a long game. The man outside does.
ch.nanjun.premise: If the commander's arrow wound had split open — once more.
ch.nanjun.regret: One year at Nanjun spent Zhou Yu down to the last drop.
ch.nanjun.skirmish.name: Cao Hong · Holding the Rear
ch.nanjun.yeshi: Jiangling's gates opened; the wound held. The commander walked in with his hand on his sword, and Nanjun took the name Sun.
ch.qianli.boss.name: Wardens of the Five Passes
ch.qianli.defeat: One pass unpassed, and a thousand li stretch endless.
ch.qianli.history: Yunchang left the seal behind, refused the gold, and cut through five passes and six generals.
ch.qianli.name: A Thousand-Li Ride
ch.qianli.note: Writer's note: win and keep walking. Don't linger over a fight.
ch.qianli.premise: If the five passes had refused him passage.
ch.qianli.regret: Five passes crossed, six generals cut down — the story can't spare a single pass.
ch.qianli.ruleText: Five fights in a row, all of them close quarters. Your chips travel with you.
ch.qianli.skirmish.name: Pass Wardens
ch.qianli.yeshi: Five passes broken in a line; at the Yellow River ferry, the drums of Gucheng already near.
ch.qiqin.boss.name: Meng Huo
ch.qiqin.defeat: The miasma of the South is a harder foe than any man.
ch.qiqin.history: Captured and freed seven times, the South settled and never rose again.
ch.qiqin.name: Seven Captures of Meng Huo
ch.qiqin.note: Writer's note: take him seven times — and let him go six.
ch.qiqin.omen.2: The Lu River Rites Are Done
ch.qiqin.premise: If, the seventh time, he still refused to yield.
ch.qiqin.regret: Seven times taken, seven times freed — win the man, not the field.
ch.qiqin.ruleText: Seven fights in a row. Take him seven times — and let him go six.
ch.qiqin.skirmish.name: Nanman Rattan Troops
ch.qiqin.yeshi: The seventh time, he walked into the camp on his own: "Chancellor, I yield."
ch.qishan.boss.name: Cao Zhen
ch.qishan.defeat: The wind off Qishan blows as hard as ever.
ch.qishan.history: Six thrusts from Qishan; the heartland never recovered.
ch.qishan.name: Qishan
ch.qishan.note: Writer's note: know it cannot be done — do it anyway.
ch.qishan.premise: If the Memorial on Departure had not been his last.
ch.qishan.regret: Six campaigns from Qishan: doing the impossible, knowing it.
ch.qishan.skirmish.name: Wei Outriders
ch.qishan.yeshi: This time, the road through Qishan held.
ch.ruxu.boss.name: The King of Wei's Own Guard
ch.ruxu.boss.op.0.name: Cao Cao · Four Hundred Thousand
ch.ruxu.boss.op.1.name: Xu Huang · Ranks in Order
ch.ruxu.defeat: The bells rang. The men did not come back.
ch.ruxu.history: Gan Ning raided Cao's camp with a hundred riders and lost not one man. Said Sun Quan: "Mengde has Zhang Liao; I have Xingba."
ch.ruxu.name: Ruxu
ch.ruxu.note: Writer's note: a hundred men, with the nerve of a hundred thousand.
ch.ruxu.premise: If, of the hundred riders who raided the camp, one had not come back.
ch.ruxu.regret: A hundred riders raiding Wei's camp — the brightest night under Sun Quan's banner.
ch.ruxu.ruleText: A raid must be fast: his relief force draws one step nearer every hand.
ch.ruxu.skirmish.name: Yue Jin · Wei's Front Line
ch.ruxu.yeshi: The bells rang three times, and Wei's camp fell into disorder. The hundred rode home and counted themselves — all there.
ch.sangu.boss.name: The Crouching Dragon · Zhuge
ch.sangu.defeat: The cottage stands deep in the hills; the wicker gate stays shut.
ch.sangu.history: Three visits; one counsel at Longzhong; the realm split in three.
ch.sangu.name: Three Visits
ch.sangu.note: Writer's note: you'll lose the first two visits. Go anyway.
ch.sangu.omen.0: Three Visits in Wind and Snow
ch.sangu.omen.1: A Nap in the Thatched Hall
ch.sangu.premise: If, on the third visit, he still would not see you.
ch.sangu.regret: Three visits to the thatched cottage — miss one, and there are no Three Kingdoms.
ch.sangu.ruleText: Call three times before he takes a seat. Sincerity is the only key that opens that door.
ch.sangu.skirmish.name: Longzhong's Gate Boy
ch.sangu.yeshi: On the third visit, the cottage door opened. He took your hand: "General, look — here is the realm, entire."
ch.sanqi.boss.name: Zhou Yu
ch.sanqi.defeat: Heaven gave birth to Yu — why then also to Liang?
ch.sanqi.history: Thrice provoked, Zhou Yu died at Baqiu, thirty-six years old.
ch.sanqi.name: The Third Provocation
ch.sanqi.note: Writer's note: his heart splits more easily than the wound.
ch.sanqi.omen.1: A Borrowed Road, a Swallowed State
ch.sanqi.premise: If Zhou Yu's wound could not weather a third goad.
ch.sanqi.regret: Heaven gave birth to Yu — why then also to Liang?
ch.sanqi.ruleText: He ignites at a touch. Goading is the knife on this page.
ch.sanqi.skirmish.name: Young Officers of Wu
ch.sanqi.yeshi: After the third goad, he laughed instead: "Kongming — the student is schooled." Zhou Yu lived another ten years.
ch.shangfanggu.boss.name: The Simas, Father and Sons
ch.shangfanggu.boss.op.0.name: Sima Yi · The Wall That Walked In
ch.shangfanggu.boss.op.1.name: Sima Zhao · Second Son in the Field
ch.shangfanggu.defeat: The rain arrived first; the fire died after.
ch.shangfanggu.history: The Chancellor lured Sima Yi into Shangfang Valley; as the fire took hold, a great rain fell, and father and son escaped.
ch.shangfanggu.name: Shangfang Valley
ch.shangfanggu.note: Writer's note: at the end of man's reckoning waits heaven's single breath.
ch.shangfanggu.premise: If that rain had come half a quarter-hour later.
ch.shangfanggu.regret: Heaven would not let Wei die: rain drowned the fire in Shangfang Valley.
ch.shangfanggu.ruleText: Fire starts at the valley mouth — win his line of retreat before you drive him in.
ch.shangfanggu.skirmish.name: Wei Rampart Scouts
ch.shangfanggu.yeshi: When the rain came down, the hand at the valley mouth was already over. Sima Yi looked up at the sky and, for the first time, had nothing to say.
ch.shenting.boss.name: Taishi Ci · The Ape-Armed Archer
ch.shenting.defeat: The wind hadn't turned before the halberd left his hand.
ch.shenting.history: Sun Ce and Taishi Ci fought at Shenting, each wrenching away the other's gear, with no victor.
ch.shenting.name: Shenting Ridge
ch.shenting.note: Writer's note: let them fight it out; don't pick the winner for them.
ch.shenting.omen.1: Reading the Wind on the Ridge
ch.shenting.premise: If the halberd that snapped had been the other man's.
ch.shenting.regret: One struggle at Shenting — hero meets hero, and honors him.
ch.shenting.skirmish.name: Liu Yao's Guards
ch.shenting.yeshi: Halberd broken, armor torn, the two of them lay on the ridge laughing. Nothing makes friends like a good fight — so notes this page.
ch.shezhan.boss.name: The Scholars of Jiangdong · Zhang Zhao
ch.shezhan.boss.op.0.name: Zhang Zhao · Voice of Jiangdong
ch.shezhan.boss.op.1.name: Yu Fan · The Blunt Question
ch.shezhan.boss.op.2.name: Lu Ji · Young Blade
ch.shezhan.defeat: Many mouths can melt gold; one word cannot hold.
ch.shezhan.history: Kongming argued down the assembled scholars; Sun Quan resolved to fight.
ch.shezhan.name: The Debate
ch.shezhan.note: Writer's note: stillness against motion, the few against the many.
ch.shezhan.premise: If the scholars of Jiangdong had argued you into silence.
ch.shezhan.regret: One tongue against a hundred thousand men.
ch.shezhan.ruleText: Three scholars share the table, each with his own line of attack. Let them contradict one another — and let none of them lead you.
ch.shezhan.skirmish.name: Jiangdong Scholars
ch.shezhan.yeshi: The hall fell silent. You closed your fan and smiled: "Anyone else?"
ch.shuiyan.boss.name: The Seven Armies · Yu Jin
ch.shuiyan.boss.op.0.name: Yu Jin · General of the Left
ch.shuiyan.boss.op.1.name: Pang De · The Coffin Bearer
ch.shuiyan.defeat: The rain stopped; the dikes held.
ch.shuiyan.history: The floodwaters drowned seven armies; Yu Jin taken, Pang De slain; the whole realm shook.
ch.shuiyan.name: The Drowned Seven Armies
ch.shuiyan.note: Writer's note: heaven's timing is on your side.
ch.shuiyan.premise: If that autumn rain had come three days late.
ch.shuiyan.regret: Terror across the heartland — Yunchang at his zenith.
ch.shuiyan.skirmish.name: Vanguard of the Seven Armies
ch.shuiyan.yeshi: When the water came, the seven armies were fish. From that day, the name of Guan Yu frightened Xuchang.
ch.sishui.boss.name: Hua Xiong
ch.sishui.defeat: The wine went cold; the pass held.
ch.sishui.history: Hua Xiong cut down two generals in a row; Yunchang took his head while the wine was still warm.
ch.sishui.name: Sishui
ch.sishui.note: Writer's note: drink the wine hot, play the hand hard.
ch.sishui.premise: If the one warming that wine had been you, not Guan Yu.
ch.sishui.regret: Hua Xiong fell before the wine cooled. One minute slower, and it turns to regret.
ch.sishui.skirmish.name: Xiliang Riders
ch.sishui.yeshi: The cup had not cooled before Hua Xiong fell. The lords never dared sneer again.
ch.taoyuan.boss.name: Yellow Turban Chieftain
ch.taoyuan.defeat: The wine still warm; the men already gone.
ch.taoyuan.history: The Yellow Turbans rose, and the whole realm rose after them.
ch.taoyuan.name: Peach Garden
ch.taoyuan.note: Writer's note: this page is an easy read. Off you go.
ch.taoyuan.premise: If the ruin of an age began with a round of wine.
ch.taoyuan.regret: The Yellow Turban Rebellion was the opening line of the chaos.
ch.taoyuan.skirmish.name: Yellow Turbans · Cheng Yuanzhi
ch.taoyuan.yeshi: One defeat at Zhuo, and the Yellow Turbans scattered like startled birds. In the peach garden, the wine was still warm.
ch.tianshui.boss.name: Jiang Wei · The Boy of Jicheng
ch.tianshui.defeat: The boy's spear is faster than the rumors say.
ch.tianshui.history: On the first Qishan campaign Jiang Wei saw through the ruse; he later surrendered, and the Chancellor taught him all he knew.
ch.tianshui.name: Tianshui
ch.tianshui.note: Writer's note: this page isn't about beating him. It's about asking him.
ch.tianshui.premise: If the old general of Phoenix Cry Hill had lost to a boy.
ch.tianshui.regret: Winning over Jiang Wei was the northern campaign's greatest windfall.
ch.tianshui.skirmish.name: Jicheng Garrison
ch.tianshui.yeshi: You could read the art of war in his spearwork. The Chancellor tossed aside his fan and laughed: "My way has an heir."
ch.tielongshan.boss.name: Guo Huai · Old Guard of Longyou
ch.tielongshan.defeat: The spring gave out; the relief arrived.
ch.tielongshan.history: Jiang Wei trapped Sima Zhao on Tielong Mountain; Guo Huai broke the siege and Jiang fell back. The tale of Guo Huai shot dead is the novelist's ink.
ch.tielongshan.name: Tielong Mountain
ch.tielongshan.note: Writer's note: before you besiege a man, count the days you can last yourself.
ch.tielongshan.premise: If, when the spring ran dry, the Qiang had pressed on instead of falling back.
ch.tielongshan.regret: One thrust of Jiang Wei's spear, and Longyou nearly got a new map.
ch.tielongshan.skirmish.name: Probing the Zhao Camp · Sima Zhao
ch.tielongshan.yeshi: Before the spring ran dry, Qiang fire had already reached the Wei camp. The Longyou board gained another move.
ch.tongguan.boss.name: The Wrath of Xiliang
ch.tongguan.boss.op.0.name: Ma Chao · Divine Might
ch.tongguan.boss.op.1.name: Xu Chu · The Bared Tiger
ch.tongguan.defeat: Iron cavalry like a tide; the Wei River ran red.
ch.tongguan.history: Ma Chao raised the Xiliang host for vengeance; Cao Cao lost his beard and his robe, and only a sown rift turned them back.
ch.tongguan.name: Tong Pass
ch.tongguan.note: Writer's note: Xiliang lacks no horses. It lacks a man willing to sit down.
ch.tongguan.premise: If the night of the shorn beard and cast-off robe had never turned dark.
ch.tongguan.regret: The iron cavalry of Xiliang haunted Cao Cao all his life.
ch.tongguan.skirmish.name: Pang De · Xiliang Vanguard
ch.tongguan.yeshi: Xu Chu fought bare-armed and Ma Chao's spear ran hot — but you laid the forged letter on the table, and the Xiliang host scattered on its own.
ch.wancheng.boss.name: Zhang Xiu
ch.wancheng.defeat: The halberds gone; the gate broken.
ch.wancheng.history: Dian Wei held the camp gate, took dozens of wounds, and died standing.
ch.wancheng.name: Wancheng
ch.wancheng.note: Writer's note: guard your weapon, and it guards your life.
ch.wancheng.premise: If, that night, the twin halberds had not been stolen.
ch.wancheng.regret: The death of Dian Wei — the first great grief of Cao's camp.
ch.wancheng.skirmish.name: Hu Che'er · Night of the Stolen Halberds
ch.wancheng.yeshi: The hand that came for the halberds — Hu Che'er's — Dian Wei caught it in the act. The night passed quietly.
ch.wuzhangyuan.boss.name: Sima Yi · The Standing Walls
ch.wuzhangyuan.defeat: Autumn wind on the Wuzhang Plains; the star fell.
ch.wuzhangyuan.history: Autumn wind on the Wuzhang Plains; the star fell. He was fifty-four.
ch.wuzhangyuan.name: Wuzhang Plains
ch.wuzhangyuan.note: Writer's note: he won't come out, and your grain is your life.
ch.wuzhangyuan.omen.2: A Fast March Down the Xie Valley
ch.wuzhangyuan.premise: If, this once, the star in the southeast had burned bright.
ch.wuzhangyuan.regret: Autumn wind on the Wuzhang Plains; a star fell. The campaign unfinished, the man already gone.
ch.wuzhangyuan.ruleText: He keeps to his walls and will not fight; Goading is wasted on him. Blinds rise at double speed — force the battle before your grain runs out.
ch.wuzhangyuan.skirmish.name: Mumen Path · Zhang He
ch.wuzhangyuan.yeshi: That night the Chancellor pushed out of his tent, saw the star in the southeast burning bright — and borrowed ten more years.
ch.xianshan.boss.name: Huang Zu · Arrow of Jiangxia
ch.xianshan.boss.op.0.name: Huang Zu · Arrow of Jiangxia
ch.xianshan.boss.op.1.name: Cai Mao · Fleet of Jing
ch.xianshan.defeat: The bamboo grows thick on Xianshan; the arrows came like locusts.
ch.xianshan.history: Sun Jian struck Liu Biao, pursued him into the hills of Xianshan, and fell to arrows and stones in an ambush.
ch.xianshan.name: Xianshan
ch.xianshan.note: Writer's note: the tiger was lost on one final breath of pride.
ch.xianshan.premise: If the tiger had not chased after that storm of arrows.
ch.xianshan.regret: The fortunes of Jiangdong began with a tiger — and lost one at Xianshan.
ch.xianshan.skirmish.name: Hidden Crossbows of Xianshan
ch.xianshan.yeshi: Where the arrows fell, there was no tiger. Sun Wentai turned his horse about, and Jiangdong's first stone had only just been placed.
ch.xiaoyaojin.boss.name: Eight Hundred Braves
ch.xiaoyaojin.boss.op.0.name: Zhang Liao · Eight Hundred Break a Hundred Thousand
ch.xiaoyaojin.boss.op.1.name: Yue Jin · First Over the Walls
ch.xiaoyaojin.defeat: The bridge falls, and every road back falls with it.
ch.xiaoyaojin.history: Eight hundred men under Zhang Liao broke a hundred thousand; Sun Quan barely escaped; Xiaoyao Ford became a lullaby.
ch.xiaoyaojin.name: Xiaoyao Ford
ch.xiaoyaojin.note: Writer's note: his courage is built on your disorder.
ch.xiaoyaojin.premise: If the riders at the bridge had waited one incense stick longer.
ch.xiaoyaojin.regret: Zhang Liao's name hushed crying children — every six-year-old in Jiangdong knew it.
ch.xiaoyaojin.ruleText: He is deadliest while you're halfway across — set your feet before you take the ford.
ch.xiaoyaojin.skirmish.name: Hefei Garrison · Li Dian
ch.xiaoyaojin.yeshi: The bridge stood; the Wu lines held. Zhang Liao saw Sun Quan's canopy — and for the first time, did not charge.
ch.yanglu.boss.name: Yang Hu · The Light Robe
ch.yanglu.defeat: A wall of decency — you cannot break it down.
ch.yanglu.history: Yang Hu and Lu Kang held Jingzhou for rival states, yet traded and kept faith. When Yang died, he recommended Du Yu; the men of Wu raised a stele to him.
ch.yanglu.name: Yang and Lu
ch.yanglu.note: Writer's note: the hardest opponent is the one you no longer want to beat.
ch.yanglu.premise: If two years of facing each other across the border had come down to a single cup of medicine.
ch.yanglu.regret: The friendship of Yang and Lu — gentlemen's terms between enemy states.
ch.yanglu.ruleText: His way of winning is not fighting. Attack in haste and you play his game.
ch.yanglu.skirmish.name: Xiling Mutineers
ch.yanglu.yeshi: Two years, no war. The stele at Xiangyang and the tears at Jiangling fell on the same day.
ch.yiling.boss.name: Lu Xun
ch.yiling.history: Lu Xun burned the linked camps for seven hundred li; the First Ruler fled to Baidi.
ch.yiling.name: Yiling
ch.yiling.note: Writer's note: the anger is his — and yours.
ch.yiling.premise: If the seven hundred li of linked camps had not stood in the woods.
ch.yiling.regret: The fire that burned the camps burned the revenge and Shu Han together.
ch.yiling.ruleText: Blinds climb faster — his fire is waiting for your mistake.
ch.yiling.skirmish.name: Wu Army · Zhu Ran
ch.yiling.yeshi: Before fire could catch, the camps moved out of the forest. With nowhere to set his blaze, Lu Xun stood holding the torch.
ch.yinping.boss.name: Deng Ai
ch.yinping.boss.op.0.name: Deng Ai · Below Motian Ridge
ch.yinping.boss.op.1.name: Deng Zhong · First Blood
ch.yinping.defeat: Yinping unmanned, Chengdu without a shield.
ch.yinping.history: Deng Ai crossed Yinping in secret; the Last Ruler surrendered; Shu fell.
ch.yinping.name: Yinping
ch.yinping.note: Writer's note: the boldest road fears one thing — a welcome.
ch.yinping.premise: If someone had been waiting on Motian Ridge.
ch.yinping.regret: The crossing at Yinping — a perilous road turned road to ruin.
ch.yinping.skirmish.name: Deng Ai's Raiders
ch.yinping.yeshi: From Motian Ridge, logs and stones came down together. After that, no one dared the Yinping trail.
ch.yuanshemen.boss.name: Ji Ling
ch.yuanshemen.defeat: The arrow never left the string; the game broke first.
ch.yuanshemen.history: Lü Bu shot at the halberd from the camp gate; both houses made peace.
ch.yuanshemen.name: The Halberd Shot
ch.yuanshemen.note: Writer's note: the peacemaker has the hardest seat.
ch.yuanshemen.premise: If that arrow had strayed half an inch.
ch.yuanshemen.regret: One arrow from the gate, and two houses stood down from war.
ch.yuanshemen.skirmish.name: Ji Ling's Troops
ch.yuanshemen.yeshi: The arrow struck the small branch of the halberd. The whole assembly went silent — and so did the wager.
ch.zhujiu.boss.name: Cao Cao · A Drink Between Rivals
ch.zhujiu.defeat: The wine was good. The company was not.
ch.zhujiu.history: Cao said: "Of the heroes of this age, there are only you, my lord — and Cao."
ch.zhujiu.name: Warm Wine
ch.zhujiu.note: Writer's note: he is reading you, just as you are reading him.
ch.zhujiu.premise: If that 'my lord' had been aimed at you.
ch.zhujiu.regret: Over warm wine, heroes of the age were ranked: the heart jumped, and the chopsticks hit the floor.
ch.zhujiu.skirmish.name: Xuchang Gatekeepers
ch.zhujiu.yeshi: The chopsticks fell, but the heart did not. He laughed; you laughed too.
ch.zuizhong.boss.name: The Writer
ch.zuizhong.defeat: He picks up the brush: "This page — again."
ch.zuizhong.name: The Last Page · The Writer
ch.zuizhong.premise: If the man who wrote this book would sit down and play you a hand.
ch.zuizhong.regret: You have been betting against the narrator all along.
ch.zuizhong.ruleText: He knows everything — except the cards. Cards can be checked.
ch.zuizhong.skirmish.name: The Writer
ch.zuizhong.yeshi: He pushes his cards away and smiles: "This volume — you write it."
codex.motto: Not every page must be won; defeat too becomes a chapter
codex.sub: Cards for blades · rewriting what history left unfinished
codex.title: The Tattered Scroll
event.chest.story: In the captured wagon, the late owner's coin sits stacked in tidy rows.
event.chest.title: The Supply Wagon
event.rest.calm: Steady your mind — fewer fake tells next table
event.rest.story: Night in camp, the third watch sounds. You replay today's hands in your head, then sleep on your blade.
event.rest.title: The Camp
event.shop.bribe: Grease the guard — foe starts -250 next table
event.shop.eye: A spy's report — far fewer fake tells
event.shop.story: A camp merchant lifts the canvas flap: "For you, sir, front-line prices. Pick one — call it a friendship."
event.shop.title: The Market
finale.memoryDefault: He leafs through the pages you left behind: "Now tell me — which of these is the true Three Kingdoms?"
finale.memoryHuarong: He brings up Huarong first: "You spared Cao Cao — for honor, or because you couldn't watch him die?"
finale.memoryMaicheng: Then he turns to Maicheng: "On this page, you finally saw which hand Lü Meng was showing you."
finale.restore.a: You tear the apocrypha out page by page, and the record shows through again. They have not forgotten you. In the snow of Maicheng, in the autumn wind of Wuzhang, someone will suddenly remember: a reader once grieved on their behalf.
finale.restore.q: Restore it — let what happened, happen
finale.seal.a: You lay the pen down on the last page. Some lived; others paid the bill for that happy ending. The Writer closes the cover: "This time, don't say you didn't know the price."
finale.seal.q: Seal it — keep the Three Kingdoms you rewrote
finale.title: The Writer Is Waiting
finale.unwritten.a: You tear out the last page, and the scraps become more blank pages. The Writer laughs: "Good. Then let every future heartbreak grow a new Three Kingdoms." The unfinished scroll opens here.
finale.unwritten.q: Tear it — the Three Kingdoms shall have no final draft
fx.keenEye.desc: Tells and feints greatly reduced this round
fx.keenEye.label: Keen Eye
fx.raid.label: Night Raid
fx.sow.label: Sap Spirit
fx.supply.label: Grain
gen.bianxi.bark.badbeat: A blade before the Buddha, and still he saw it.
gen.bianxi.bark.open: A word at Zhenguo Temple, shall we?
gen.bianxi.bark.taunt: Not even Buddha can save you.
gen.bianxi.bio: Monk of Zhenguo Temple. A blade beneath the cassock.
gen.bianxi.name: Bian Xi
gen.bianxi.tell.strong: Palms together, eyes lowered, breath even.
gen.bianxi.tell.weak: The knife-ring in his sleeve gives a soft rattle.
gen.caimao.bark.open: Cai Mao, admiral of the Jing fleet.
gen.caimao.bark.taunt: Save your swagger for dry land!
gen.caimao.bio: Admiral of the Jing fleet — checks his sister's face first.
gen.caimao.name: Cai Mao
gen.caimao.tell.strong: Naval charts up his sleeve, deploying ships mid-laugh
gen.caimao.tell.weak: Glances back for word from the women's quarters
gen.caizhong.bark.badbeat: Little brother... gone ahead of me.
gen.caizhong.bark.open: Cai Zhong, surrendered soldier, at your orders.
gen.caizhong.bark.smug: Whoever doubts a defector has something to hide.
gen.caizhong.bark.taunt: Lord Cao has treated us brothers well!
gen.caizhong.bio: One of the twin false defectors.
gen.caizhong.name: Cai Zhong
gen.caizhong.tell.strong: His story matches his brother's to the drop.
gen.caizhong.tell.weak: The twins' signals land half a beat apart.
gen.caocao.bark.open: With wine before us, let us sing. Life is short.
gen.caocao.bark.smug: Better I betray the world than the world betray me.
gen.caocao.bio: A capable minister in good times; in bad times, the hero-villain.
gen.caocao.name: Cao Cao
gen.caocao.tell.strong: Spear level, declaiming verse, as if no one else exists.
gen.caocao.tell.weak: Stroking his beard, murmuring, eyes adrift.
gen.caohong.bark.badbeat: The horse I could give... not the ground...
gen.caohong.bark.open: Cao Hong stands here. No one passes!
gen.caohong.bark.taunt: The realm can spare a Hong; it cannot spare my lord!
gen.caohong.bio: The brother who gave up his horse; the general who guards his lord.
gen.caohong.name: Cao Hong
gen.caohong.tell.strong: Blade across, horse planted, blocking the line of retreat
gen.caohong.tell.weak: Keeps checking how far his lord has gotten clear
gen.caomao.bark.open: I, Cao Mao, Emperor of Great Wei!
gen.caomao.bark.smug: A dragon was never meant for a pond.
gen.caomao.bark.taunt: If this can be borne, what cannot?!
gen.caomao.bark.tilt: Today I hunt the traitor myself!
gen.caomao.bio: Sima Zhao's intent — plain to every passerby.
gen.caomao.name: Cao Mao
gen.caomao.tell.strong: Boards the imperial carriage sword in hand, dragon banner before him
gen.caomao.tell.weak: Fingers his poem 'The Hidden Dragon' on the desk
gen.caopi.bark.badbeat: Seven paces... a poem is nothing!
gen.caopi.bark.smug: Wei for Han — the way of the mandate.
gen.caopi.bark.taunt: Abdication merely lends the realm a stair to descend with dignity.
gen.caopi.bark.tilt: The ways of Shun and Yu — I know them now!
gen.caopi.bio: Emperor Wen of Wei, crowned on the Abdication Terrace.
gen.caopi.name: Cao Pi
gen.caopi.tell.strong: Abdication edict in hand; every character weighs a thousand.
gen.caopi.tell.weak: Looks back toward Ye and its old pear trees.
gen.caoren.bark.taunt: A year under siege? So what!
gen.caoren.bio: Courage beyond men; holds a city like a mountain.
gen.caoren.name: Cao Ren
gen.caoren.tell.strong: Rides the walls at a gallop, counting your banners himself
gen.caoren.tell.weak: Fingers the arrow scars on his old armor
gen.caoshuang.bark.open: You stand before the General-in-Chief. Bow.
gen.caoshuang.bark.smug: The house of Wei sits in my palm.
gen.caoshuang.bark.taunt: You think you can goad me?
gen.caoshuang.bio: Power in hand, suspicion at the door.
gen.caoshuang.name: Cao Shuang
gen.caoshuang.tell.strong: Reclining on an armrest, orders dealt out carelessly.
gen.caoshuang.tell.weak: Sending again and again to ask what stirs outside.
gen.caozhen.bark.open: Cao Zhen, overseer of the armies.
gen.caozhen.bio: A famed commander of Cao Wei's own blood.
gen.caozhen.name: Cao Zhen
gen.caozhen.tell.strong: Seated square, hand on sword, still as a mountain.
gen.cenhun.bark.badbeat: Why... why do you all stare at me!
gen.cenhun.bark.open: Cen Hun, with a plan for lasting peace.
gen.cenhun.bark.taunt: Iron chains across the river — nothing slips past!
gen.cenhun.bio: The flatterer who chained the river shut.
gen.cenhun.name: Cen Hun
gen.cenhun.tell.strong: Presents prophecies and portents with an air of total certainty.
gen.cenhun.tell.weak: Still crying injustice as the guards drag him off.
gen.chengong.bark.badbeat: My lord... still you will not listen?
gen.chengong.bark.open: Chen Gong. I have a plan.
gen.chengong.bark.smug: This game can still be saved.
gen.chengong.bio: What a strategist fights for is usually one turn of his lord's mind.
gen.chengong.name: Chen Gong
gen.chengong.tell.strong: Sleeves folded, sitting square, eyes fixed.
gen.chengong.tell.weak: His gaze drifts to a corner of the city map.
gen.chengpu.bark.badbeat: The young... are to be feared.
gen.chengpu.bark.smug: I laid my share of Jiangdong's stones.
gen.chengpu.bark.taunt: Think my years make me easy?
gen.chengpu.bark.tilt: One more fight in this old frame!
gen.chengpu.bio: Elder of three courts, iron spine, serpent spear.
gen.chengpu.name: Cheng Pu
gen.chengpu.tell.strong: Plants his serpent spear; older and harder than ever
gen.chengpu.tell.weak: Starts to mutter 'that whelp Zhou' — then bites it off
gen.chengyuanzhi.bark.smug: The Way of Great Peace — a million strong.
gen.chengyuanzhi.bark.taunt: The Yellow Sky rules — all who stand in its way die!
gen.chengyuanzhi.bio: A Yellow Scarf chieftain — where the great enterprise begins.
gen.chengyuanzhi.name: Cheng Yuanzhi
gen.chengyuanzhi.tell.strong: Waves his saber and roars; the numbers are on his side.
gen.chengyuanzhi.tell.weak: Looks back to check his lieutenant is still there.
gen.dailai.bark.open: Dailai the cave lord — I have a plan!
gen.dailai.bark.taunt: The men I recommend never fail!
gen.dailai.bio: The cave lord who fetched the rattan armor.
gen.dailai.name: Dailai, Lord of the Bana Caves
gen.dailai.tell.strong: Eyes quick and rolling as he offers up the plan.
gen.dailai.tell.weak: Arranges for the credit to land on himself.
gen.dengai.bark.open: D-Deng Ai. Grant me the fight.
gen.dengai.bio: The stuttering general who stole through Yinping.
gen.dengai.name: Deng Ai
gen.dengai.tell.strong: The stutter holds; the eyes are torches.
gen.dengzhong.bark.taunt: Mind your manners before my father!
gen.dengzhong.bio: A tiger's son, first blood at Mianzhu.
gen.dengzhong.name: Deng Zhong
gen.dengzhong.tell.strong: His spear speaks before his father's stammer can
gen.dengzhong.tell.weak: Steals a glance at his father's face
gen.dianwei.bark.badbeat: My lord... is he clear of here?
gen.dianwei.bark.open: Dian Wei stands here. No one passes.
gen.dianwei.bio: Where his halberds stand, there stands the gate.
gen.dianwei.name: Dian Wei
gen.dianwei.tell.strong: Halberds butt the floor. Not one step back.
gen.dianwei.tell.weak: One glance back at the camp gate.
gen.diaochan.bark.badbeat: So I was never outside the plan either.
gen.diaochan.bark.open: Gentlemen, why hurry to despise each other?
gen.diaochan.bark.smug: Those inside the game rarely see it.
gen.diaochan.bark.taunt: Does the general know no words but threats?
gen.diaochan.bark.tilt: None of you will hear me.
gen.diaochan.bio: In the chain of schemes, the one free move.
gen.diaochan.name: Diao Chan
gen.diaochan.tell.weak: A fingertip brushes the short blade in her sleeve.
gen.dingfeng.bark.badbeat: The general is old; the blade is not.
gen.dingfeng.bark.smug: The victory at Dongxing — only yesterday.
gen.dingfeng.bark.taunt: Close work is the true skill!
gen.dingfeng.bark.tilt: In the snow, we see what you're made of!
gen.dingfeng.bio: The old general who won with short blades in the snow.
gen.dingfeng.name: Ding Feng
gen.dingfeng.tell.strong: Sheds his armor, takes up a blade, forms ranks in the snow
gen.dingfeng.tell.weak: Squints, tallying the wind and the enemy's grain
gen.dongzhuo.bio: Deep moats at Mei; lakes of wine, forests of meat.
gen.dongzhuo.name: Dong Zhuo
gen.dongzhuo.tell.strong: Roaring laughter, belly shaking, tassels aquiver.
gen.dongzhuo.tell.weak: A fat hand claps over the purse.
gen.duyu.bark.badbeat: Wait on the water, or on the hour?
gen.duyu.bark.smug: Under ten thousand men — more than enough for these walls.
gen.duyu.bark.taunt: Like splitting bamboo — past a few joints, the blade runs free.
gen.duyu.bio: The Zuo Commentary devotee who never reined in.
gen.duyu.name: Du Yu
gen.duyu.tell.weak: Counts off the ten-day weeks, pressing for river reports.
gen.fazheng.bark.badbeat: Heaven would not lend me the years...
gen.fazheng.bark.smug: Mount Dingjun — already in this hand.
gen.fazheng.bark.taunt: Every favor, every grudge — I keep the account.
gen.fazheng.bio: Never forgot a slight; never failed a scheme.
gen.fazheng.name: Fa Zheng
gen.fazheng.tell.strong: Signals with a look — the edge hidden in his sleeve
gen.fazheng.tell.weak: A quiet cough; one hand braces the old ailment in his chest.
gen.ganning.bark.open: Gan Ning of the brocade sails. Heard of me?
gen.ganning.bark.taunt: A hundred riders raiding a camp. Heard of that?
gen.ganning.bio: The pirate with the brocade sails, turned commander.
gen.ganning.name: Gan Ning
gen.ganning.tell.strong: One ring of the bell and the blade is already out.
gen.ganning.tell.weak: Fingering the bronze bell at his throat.
gen.gaolan.bark.taunt: No men of worth in the north? A joke!
gen.gaolan.bio: A famed name of the north — with an exit always in mind.
gen.gaolan.name: Gao Lan
gen.gaolan.tell.strong: Spear heavy, seat steady — northern bearing
gen.gaolan.tell.weak: Watches which way the commander's flag leans
gen.gaoshun.bark.badbeat: I knew counsel was wasted on him...
gen.gaoshun.bark.open: Gao Shun, of the Formation Breakers.
gen.gaoshun.bark.taunt: Shun drinks no wine and takes no bait.
gen.gaoshun.bio: Commander of the Formation Breakers — every battle, a breach.
gen.gaoshun.name: Gao Shun
gen.gaoshun.tell.strong: The banner rises; spears advance like a wall
gen.gongsunzan.bark.badbeat: The towers of Yijing... built too high after all...
gen.gongsunzan.bark.open: Gongsun Zan of the White Horse Volunteers!
gen.gongsunzan.bark.taunt: The barbarians flee at my name!
gen.gongsunzan.bio: The White Rider, holding the northern frontier.
gen.gongsunzan.name: Gongsun Zan
gen.gongsunzan.tell.strong: White horses in formation, every rider's bow drawn
gen.gongsunzan.tell.weak: Stares at his high walls, counting the grain
gen.guanping.bark.badbeat: Father... your son goes on ahead.
gen.guanping.bark.smug: The Guan blade keeps its measure.
gen.guanping.bark.taunt: Insult my father — come through me first.
gen.guanping.bio: The adopted son — blade and heart equally upright.
gen.guanping.name: Guan Ping
gen.guanping.tell.strong: Blade across, covering his father's flank
gen.guanping.tell.weak: Adjusts the cloak on his father's shoulders
gen.guanqiujian.bark.open: Guanqiu Jian raises the righteous banner!
gen.guanqiujian.bark.smug: An army long in the field without a cause rots from within.
gen.guanqiujian.bark.taunt: The Simas deceive heaven and earth!
gen.guanqiujian.bark.tilt: Soldiers — with me, back to Luoyang!
gen.guanqiujian.bio: The general whose stone stands in Liaodong — loyal to Wei.
gen.guanqiujian.name: Guanqiu Jian
gen.guanqiujian.tell.strong: Sword at hand, reading the call to arms aloud
gen.guanqiujian.tell.weak: Gazing toward Luoyang, old tears running free
gen.guanxing.bark.taunt: My father's blade cuts no nameless man.
gen.guanxing.bark.tilt: This blade settles my father's debts!
gen.guanxing.bio: The Green Dragon blade, drawn a second time.
gen.guanxing.name: Guan Xing
gen.guanxing.tell.strong: Blade and body as one, quick without disorder
gen.guanxing.tell.weak: Traces his father's old marks on the scabbard
gen.guanyu.bark.badbeat: This hand — Guan has marked it.
gen.guanyu.bark.smug: Where duty leads, what is there to fear?
gen.guanyu.bio: Green Dragon Crescent Blade; one promise outweighs a thousand weights.
gen.guanyu.name: Guan Yu
gen.guanyu.tell.strong: Phoenix eyes half open, stroking his beard, saying nothing
gen.guohuai.bark.smug: I saw your move before you made it.
gen.guohuai.bark.taunt: Huai does not spend courage on a moment's vanity.
gen.guohuai.bio: Veteran of the west; reads the winds well.
gen.guohuai.name: Guo Huai
gen.guohuai.tell.strong: Bent over the map, moving each piece slowly
gen.guohuai.tell.weak: Rubs his leg where the old wound lives
gen.guojia.bark.badbeat: Heaven's mandate... does not fall within my ten years.
gen.guojia.bark.smug: The last stratagem still holds its warmth.
gen.guojia.bark.taunt: Jia does not fear losing — only not playing.
gen.guojia.bio: The prodigy who plotted ten years ahead — but never counted his own.
gen.guojia.name: Guo Jia
gen.guojia.tell.strong: Coughs faintly behind a sleeve; plays the stone without mercy.
gen.guojia.tell.weak: The medicine sits untouched, gone cold.
gen.handang.bark.smug: Bow and horse — nothing gone rusty.
gen.handang.bark.taunt: A son of Liaodong fears the likes of you?
gen.handang.bio: Old hand of the Volunteers; never out of bowshot or saddle.
gen.handang.name: Han Dang
gen.handang.tell.strong: Bow drawn to a full moon, roaring into the breach
gen.hanfu.bark.badbeat: As if I dared stop him...
gen.hanfu.bark.open: Han Fu stands here. Leave your papers.
gen.hanfu.bio: Warden at Luoyang. Quick blade, hollow heart.
gen.hanfu.name: Han Fu
gen.hanfu.tell.strong: Draws first, all noise and blade.
gen.haozhao.bark.badbeat: Even the best wall needs relief eventually...
gen.haozhao.bark.taunt: If you've got it, come back for another month!
gen.haozhao.bio: A thousand men at Chencang — held his way into legend.
gen.haozhao.name: Hao Zhao
gen.haozhao.tell.strong: Repeating crossbows spanned; the walls go silent
gen.huanggai.bark.badbeat: This time these old bones are spent...
gen.huanggai.bark.open: Old Huang Gai will take the van.
gen.huanggai.bark.smug: Three reigns of service; my word holds.
gen.huanggai.bark.taunt: A little flesh and pain — nothing!
gen.huanggai.bio: Servant of three reigns; the spark behind the self-scarring ruse.
gen.huanggai.name: Huang Gai
gen.huanggai.tell.strong: Iron whip in hand, back straight as a mast
gen.huanggai.tell.weak: Rubs the cane welts still healing on his back
gen.huangquan.bark.badbeat: The road home... cut on the river.
gen.huangquan.bark.smug: One day's earlier counsel, and it never comes to this.
gen.huangquan.bark.taunt: Quan will not betray his lord — nor ruin his state.
gen.huangquan.bio: He surrendered to Wei, not Wu — the hard arithmetic of loyalty.
gen.huangquan.name: Huang Quan
gen.huangquan.tell.strong: Plain counsel over the map; a quiet voice with weighty reasons.
gen.huangquan.tell.weak: Gazes north across the river, long silent.
gen.huangzhong.bark.open: Huang Zhong, old soldier. Give me a fight!
gen.huangzhong.bark.smug: Can this old man still eat? He can!
gen.huangzhong.bark.tilt: Watch me draw a hundred-catty bow again!
gen.huangzhong.bio: The old bow still draws. Age is somebody else's problem.
gen.huangzhong.name: Huang Zhong
gen.huangzhong.tell.strong: Bow drawn to a full moon, arm steady.
gen.huangzu.bark.open: Huang Zu of Jiangxia. I only hold what's mine.
gen.huangzu.bark.taunt: Sun whelps! Every last one of you dies!
gen.huangzu.bio: Old general holding Jiangxia. Keeps his grudges.
gen.huangzu.name: Huang Zu
gen.huangzu.tell.strong: Crouched behind the parapet, waiting on one arrow
gen.huangzu.tell.weak: Keeps wiping sweat, eyes on the river upstream
gen.huaxiong.bark.open: Hua Xiong is here! Who dares answer!
gen.huaxiong.bark.smug: So this is all the lords can muster.
gen.huaxiong.bark.tilt: Your head will christen my banner!
gen.huaxiong.bio: The man whose wine was still warm.
gen.huaxiong.name: Hua Xiong
gen.huaxiong.tell.weak: Keeps glancing back at the gate.
gen.hucheer.bark.badbeat: The halberd... still in his hand!
gen.hucheer.bark.open: Hu Che'er — a bowl to the General.
gen.hucheer.bark.smug: Five hundred jin, and still at a trot.
gen.hucheer.bark.taunt: I do the lifting. I don't take the stage.
gen.hucheer.bio: The halberd-thief who could carry five hundred jin.
gen.hucheer.name: Hu Che'er
gen.hucheer.tell.strong: The toasting hand is steady — too steady.
gen.hucheer.tell.weak: His gaze keeps sliding back to the weapon rack.
gen.jiachong.bark.badbeat: The regicide's name... will not stick to me!
gen.jiachong.bark.smug: There's always someone eager for the dirty work.
gen.jiachong.bark.taunt: A thousand days of feeding troops — for this one day.
gen.jiachong.bark.tilt: What does Lord Sima keep you for?!
gen.jiachong.bio: The hand that aimed Cheng Ji's blade.
gen.jiachong.name: Jia Chong
gen.jiachong.tell.strong: Arms folded, standing behind his master
gen.jiachong.tell.weak: Nudges the elbow of the man beside him
gen.jiangwei.bark.badbeat: Lord Chancellor... Wei has failed you.
gen.jiangwei.bark.open: Jiang Wei of Tianshui. Instruct me.
gen.jiangwei.bark.smug: The will can still be carried on.
gen.jiangwei.bio: The young cub carries the will; the edge unbent.
gen.jiangwei.name: Jiang Wei
gen.jiangwei.tell.strong: Spear upright, a level stare that presses back.
gen.jiaxu.bark.badbeat: This move was never mine to make.
gen.jiaxu.bark.smug: Keeping oneself whole is also a strategy.
gen.jiaxu.bio: One sentence threw the realm into chaos; a second carried him out whole.
gen.jiaxu.name: Jia Xu
gen.jiaxu.tell.strong: Eyes lowered as if dozing; speaks least at the table.
gen.jiaxu.tell.weak: Rolls the words around his mouth one more time.
gen.jiling.bark.open: Ji Ling, under Yuan Shu's banner!
gen.jiling.name: Ji Ling
gen.jiling.tell.strong: Great blade stamps the floor, thunder in it.
gen.jiling.tell.weak: Eyes sliding toward his own camp gate.
gen.jushou.bark.smug: This ground could have been taken slow.
gen.jushou.bark.taunt: Haste wins the day and loses the month.
gen.jushou.bark.tilt: Guard the grain! Guard the grain!
gen.jushou.bio: His slow-war counsel fell on deaf ears.
gen.jushou.name: Ju Shou
gen.jushou.tell.strong: Stands clutching his plan, eyes like torches.
gen.jushou.tell.weak: Sighs at the great host fording the river.
gen.kongxiu.bark.badbeat: The name Guan... it was no bluff.
gen.kongxiu.bark.open: Kong Xiu of the East Ridge. Papers, then passage.
gen.kongxiu.bio: Warden of the East Ridge. A pass is a promise.
gen.kongxiu.name: Kong Xiu
gen.kongxiu.tell.strong: Blade barred across the pass, heels planted.
gen.kongxiu.tell.weak: Looks back at his seal of office.
gen.lejin.bark.badbeat: Over the wall... too early this time...
gen.lejin.bark.open: Yue Jin of Yangping — first over the wall!
gen.lejin.bio: First up the wall every battle — short of stature, long of blade.
gen.lejin.name: Yue Jin
gen.lejin.tell.strong: Leads from the very front, gives not an inch
gen.lejin.tell.weak: Rears his horse to check the main line
gen.leshen.bark.badbeat: An old friend's son... how did it come to this...
gen.leshen.bark.taunt: My father's name will not be insulted!
gen.leshen.bio: A great general's son, holding Huainan.
gen.leshen.name: Le Chen
gen.leshen.tell.strong: Runs his father's formations by the letter
gen.liaohua.bark.taunt: This old man will outlast the lot of you!
gen.liaohua.bark.tilt: Sword Gate — while a man stands, the pass stands!
gen.liaohua.bio: The man who outlived the road from Maicheng to Sword Gate.
gen.liaohua.name: Liao Hua
gen.liaohua.tell.strong: Older and harder still; the saber still comes up in his hand.
gen.liaohua.tell.weak: Counting how many Shu comrades are left.
gen.lidian.bark.open: Li Dian — a word, if I may.
gen.lidian.bark.smug: I keep the whole board in view.
gen.lidian.bio: A scholar in armor; minds the whole board.
gen.lidian.name: Li Dian
gen.lidian.tell.strong: Sets the scroll down unread, studies the ground first
gen.lidian.tell.weak: Opens his mouth to object, swallows it
gen.lingtong.bark.badbeat: The rearguard... is where men die.
gen.lingtong.bark.smug: A state's man does not indulge private feuds.
gen.lingtong.bark.taunt: My father's blood — I keep the ledger!
gen.lingtong.bark.tilt: My father's old troops — with me!
gen.lingtong.bio: A father's murder in his heart; the common cause ahead of it.
gen.lingtong.name: Ling Tong
gen.lingtong.tell.strong: Spear out through clenched teeth, fast and vicious
gen.lingtong.tell.weak: Fists clench at the sound of Gan Ning's bells
gen.liubei.bark.badbeat: If we lose, we rise again.
gen.liubei.bark.open: Bei would be glad of your company.
gen.liubei.bark.taunt: It is not that Bei lacks anger — he spends it rarely.
gen.liubei.bark.tilt: Is this, then, the will of Heaven?
gen.liubei.bio: Down a hundred times, up a hundred and one — he knows men's hearts haven't cooled.
gen.liubei.name: Liu Bei
gen.liubei.tell.strong: Twin swords set down together, eyes gentle
gen.liubei.tell.weak: Thumb worrying the silk inside his sleeve
gen.liubiao.bark.badbeat: And after me... whom do I trust?
gen.liubiao.bark.smug: One of the Eight Fine Gentlemen — the name is earned.
gen.liubiao.bark.taunt: Jingzhou needs only to keep itself.
gen.liubiao.bio: A fine host for parlor talk; a keeper, not a taker.
gen.liubiao.name: Liu Biao
gen.liubiao.tell.strong: Plays his zither unhurried, every courtesy to guests intact.
gen.liubiao.tell.weak: Asks his lady, then asks her brother.
gen.liuzhang.bark.badbeat: Father to son, and still we could not hold it.
gen.liuzhang.bark.smug: Peace kept in Shu — that too is a merit.
gen.liuzhang.bark.taunt: Zhang was never made for an age of chaos.
gen.liuzhang.bio: A keeper of what he was given — until the day he opened the gates.
gen.liuzhang.name: Liu Zhang
gen.liuzhang.tell.strong: Weeps over the city registers; his courtesy never slips.
gen.liuzhang.tell.weak: Looks out at the elders of the city and cannot speak.
gen.luji.bark.open: Lu Ji. I would hear the particulars.
gen.luji.bio: The boy who pocketed oranges for his mother. Young, and edged.
gen.luji.name: Lu Ji
gen.luji.tell.strong: Sits bolt upright, returns the question, yields nothing.
gen.luji.tell.weak: Glances at the orange pits on the table.
gen.lukang.bark.badbeat: When I am gone, who holds Jing Province...
gen.lukang.bark.smug: Each keeps his border; each keeps his people in peace.
gen.lukang.bark.taunt: Kang does not dare forget his family's teaching.
gen.lukang.name: Lu Kang
gen.lukang.tell.strong: Raises siege works like mountains; his grain lines immaculate
gen.lukang.tell.weak: Looks toward Jianye, sighs, says nothing
gen.lusu.bark.open: Lu Su. I wish both houses well.
gen.lusu.bark.taunt: There is no need for this, my friend.
gen.lusu.bark.tilt: Even Su will fight for something!
gen.lusu.bio: The couch-side plan: honesty with an edge.
gen.lusu.name: Lu Su
gen.lusu.tell.strong: Bowed fists and a smile, every word certain.
gen.lusu.tell.weak: Starts to speak, stops, looks north across the river.
gen.luxun.bark.smug: A linked-camp blaze. Nothing to it.
gen.luxun.bio: A scholar-commander who burned a whole linked camp.
gen.luxun.name: Lu Xun
gen.luxun.tell.strong: Hands clasped behind, watching the fire, unmoved.
gen.luxun.tell.weak: Fingers counting in his sleeve, slow to commit.
gen.lvbu.bark.open: Lü Fengxian, without equal under heaven!
gen.lvbu.bark.taunt: Who are you calling a thrice-adopted dog?!
gen.lvbu.bio: The finest under heaven, and he never bows.
gen.lvbu.name: Lü Bu
gen.lvbu.tell.strong: Halberd across his knees, knuckles white
gen.lvbu.tell.weak: Red Hare pawing the ground, restless
gen.lvmeng.bark.open: Lü Meng. Three days apart, sir.
gen.lvmeng.bio: White-robed across the river. Look at him anew.
gen.lvmeng.name: Lü Meng
gen.lvmeng.tell.strong: White robes, a scroll in hand, wholly settled.
gen.machao.bark.open: Ma Chao of Xiliang! Who dares take me!
gen.machao.bark.taunt: My father's blood will not share a sky with you!
gen.machao.bio: Silk robe, silver spear. The wrath of Xiliang.
gen.machao.name: Ma Chao
gen.machao.tell.strong: Spear laid across his knees, the killing not hidden.
gen.machao.tell.weak: One look back at the men from Xiliang.
gen.madai.bark.smug: The Ma clan still has men.
gen.madai.bark.taunt: Dai does not contend with his brother.
gen.madai.bio: The cousin — reliable at the rearguard and the finishing stroke.
gen.madai.name: Ma Dai
gen.madai.tell.strong: Bladework steady; neither rushing nor rattled
gen.madai.tell.weak: Keeps an eye on where his brother's warhorse goes
gen.maliang.bark.badbeat: The camps... one sheet of fire now...
gen.maliang.bark.smug: The map is in my hand.
gen.maliang.bark.taunt: These white brows did not grow white for nothing.
gen.maliang.bark.tilt: Move camp? It cannot be done!
gen.maliang.bio: The white-browed best of five brothers, brush in hand on campaign.
gen.maliang.name: Ma Liang
gen.maliang.tell.strong: One white eyebrow lifts; his brush deploys formations.
gen.maliang.tell.weak: Checks the maps of the Five Creeks once more.
gen.masuo.bark.open: Ma Su. The plan was settled long ago.
gen.masuo.bark.smug: The high ground. Momentum like split bamboo.
gen.masuo.bark.taunt: What do you know of war!
gen.masuo.bio: Armies on paper; a lonely stockade on a hill.
gen.masuo.name: Ma Su
gen.masuo.tell.strong: Talks war without end, finger tracing rivers and peaks.
gen.menghuo.bark.open: Meng Huo, King of the South!
gen.menghuo.bark.smug: None can match me in the South!
gen.menghuo.bio: King of the South, caught and freed seven times.
gen.menghuo.name: Meng Huo
gen.menghuo.tell.strong: Slaps the table and surges up; bowls leap.
gen.mengyou.bark.open: Meng You — holding the stockade for my brother!
gen.mengyou.bark.taunt: My brother is king of the southern lands!
gen.mengyou.bio: Meng Huo's brother, advancing and retreating at his side.
gen.mengyou.name: Meng You
gen.mengyou.tell.weak: Takes the field still holding his wine bowl.
gen.pangde.bark.badbeat: The coffin... put to use after all.
gen.pangde.bark.open: Pang De of Nan'an, come to die.
gen.pangde.bark.taunt: My coffin is ready. What is there to fear!
gen.pangde.bio: He carried his own coffin to battle. No turning back.
gen.pangde.name: Pang De
gen.pangde.tell.strong: The hand that bore the coffin steadier than the one on the blade.
gen.pangde.tell.weak: Thumb rubbing the empty gourd at his belt.
gen.pangtong.bark.badbeat: Fallen Phoenix... an ill-named slope after all.
gen.pangtong.bark.open: Pang Tong, at your service. Forgive the display.
gen.pangtong.bark.taunt: Go on. Say who is useless.
gen.pangtong.bark.tilt: How dare you slight me, boy!
gen.pangtong.bio: The young phoenix does not perch on dead wood.
gen.pangtong.name: Pang Tong
gen.pangtong.tell.strong: Hands behind his back, laughing, eyes sharp.
gen.pangtong.tell.weak: A cough; he steers clear of the slope's name.
gen.panzhang.bark.smug: The Green Dragon blade sits sweet in the hand.
gen.panzhang.bark.taunt: That weapon of yours is mine now!
gen.panzhang.bio: Ambushes grain, bags generals — no method too low.
gen.panzhang.name: Pan Zhang
gen.panzhang.tell.strong: Blade laid across the narrow road, grinning ugly
gen.panzhang.tell.weak: Eyeing another man's fine blade and horse
gen.qinqi.bark.badbeat: Even the Yellow River won't hold you.
gen.qinqi.bark.open: Qin Qi holds this ford. Halt.
gen.qinqi.bark.smug: No wings will carry you over.
gen.qinqi.bio: The Yellow River ford. One last challenge.
gen.qinqi.name: Qin Qi
gen.qinqi.tell.strong: Horse set, blade across, stare going straight through you.
gen.qinqi.tell.weak: His grip tightens on the reins.
gen.quyi.bark.badbeat: The one who underestimated... was me.
gen.quyi.bark.open: Qu Yi, of the First Assault.
gen.quyi.bark.smug: A white horse is still just a horse.
gen.quyi.bio: Leader of first-assault men — arrogant, and good enough to be.
gen.quyi.name: Qu Yi
gen.quyi.tell.strong: The shield wall sinks low — the silence is frightening
gen.quyi.tell.weak: Scowls at the rear ranks for lagging
gen.shamoke.bark.smug: Fighting for the Han — what a joy!
gen.shamoke.bark.taunt: The king's mace knows your face!
gen.shamoke.bio: King of the Five Creeks, wielding an iron-spiked mace.
gen.shamoke.name: Shamoke
gen.shamoke.tell.strong: Mace at his hip, bare-chested, hair loose.
gen.shamoke.tell.weak: Frowns at Han commands he cannot parse.
gen.simashi.bark.badbeat: This eye... will not see the end of it.
gen.simashi.bark.smug: Who wears the crown — that is my call.
gen.simashi.bark.taunt: Ziyuan does not anger. Anger undoes the work.
gen.simashi.bark.tilt: An ailing eye? Kill them anyway!
gen.simashi.bio: A tumor in his eye — and the empire in his gaze.
gen.simashi.name: Sima Shi
gen.simashi.tell.strong: Seated with hand on sword, eyes fixed dead ahead
gen.simashi.tell.weak: Presses the bandage over his eye
gen.simayan.bark.smug: All under heaven comes home to Jin.
gen.simayan.bio: Emperor Wu of Jin. Three kingdoms, one.
gen.simayan.name: Sima Yan
gen.simayan.tell.strong: Crown-beads still, looking down from height.
gen.simayan.tell.weak: Keeps glancing beyond the hall doors.
gen.simayi.bio: The Tomb Tiger. Whoever can wait longest, wins.
gen.simayi.name: Sima Yi
gen.simayi.tell.strong: Eyes shut, resting, breath long and slow.
gen.simayi.tell.weak: Knuckles on the table: three short, one long.
gen.simazhao.bark.badbeat: What my father and brother built... shall not fall to me!
gen.simazhao.bark.smug: The realm was settled long ago.
gen.simazhao.bark.taunt: Why bleed for a dead man's cause, General?
gen.simazhao.bark.tilt: Ring him in! Not a bird gets out!
gen.simazhao.bio: His intent — plain to every passerby on the street.
gen.simazhao.name: Sima Zhao
gen.simazhao.tell.strong: Smiles, hand resting on his sword, yielding three inches in every word
gen.simazhao.tell.weak: Taps the table lightly, counting hearts
gen.songxian.bark.badbeat: He truly does not care whether we live?
gen.songxian.bark.smug: No weak soldiers serve the Marquis of Wen.
gen.songxian.bio: One of Lü Bu's old officers, carrying a heavy heart.
gen.songxian.name: Song Xian
gen.songxian.tell.strong: Shakes himself alert; his blade-work stays clean
gen.songxian.tell.weak: Trades a glance with Wei Xu
gen.sunce.bark.open: Sun Ce the Little Conqueror — fight me!
gen.sunce.bark.taunt: Three calls and you still won't answer?
gen.sunce.bio: The Little Conqueror — traded a seal for a realm.
gen.sunce.name: Sun Ce
gen.sunce.tell.strong: Flicks a helmet plume from his spear, grinning like a boy
gen.sunce.tell.weak: Presses a thumb to the arrow wound in his cheek
gen.sunhao.bark.badbeat: Guiming... 'surrendered to destiny' — what a title!
gen.sunhao.bark.taunt: A green canopy for my throne and the North Star for my court!
gen.sunhao.bio: Wu's last and cruelest emperor; styled, at the end, Marquis of Guiming.
gen.sunhao.name: Sun Hao
gen.sunhao.tell.strong: Hurls the cup and rises, fire in his eyes.
gen.sunhao.tell.weak: Counting how many loyal ministers survive.
gen.sunjian.bark.open: Sun Jian, Marquis of Wucheng, stands here!
gen.sunjian.bark.smug: The tiger has crossed. Who stops him?
gen.sunjian.bark.taunt: Turncoats think they can bar my way?
gen.sunjian.bark.tilt: A tiger does not die boxed in at Xian Mountain!
gen.sunjian.bio: The tiger of Jiangdong — undone by the jewel he carried.
gen.sunjian.name: Sun Jian
gen.sunjian.tell.strong: Points his Guding blade forward, first into the fray
gen.sunjian.tell.weak: Rubs the Imperial Seal tucked in his robe
gen.sunquan.bark.badbeat: We will discuss it. Later. Again.
gen.sunquan.bark.open: Sun Quan of Jiangdong. I would hear your counsel.
gen.sunquan.bark.smug: Jiangdong is not to be trifled with.
gen.sunquan.bio: He holds the Southeast by knowing which men to keep.
gen.sunquan.name: Sun Quan
gen.sunquan.tell.strong: Hand on sword, listening to the tide, saying nothing.
gen.sunquan.tell.weak: Weighing the faces to his left and right, again and again.
gen.taishici.bark.badbeat: A true man should carry a three-foot sword...
gen.taishici.bark.open: Taishi Ci of Donglai. I'll take this fight.
gen.taishici.bark.smug: The bow arm has not aged.
gen.taishici.bark.taunt: A true man does not fear you!
gen.taishici.bio: Ape-armed archer; his word before his life.
gen.taishici.name: Taishi Ci
gen.taishici.tell.strong: Short halberds in the sleeves, bow never off his back.
gen.taishici.tell.weak: A look toward his old lord's camp.
gen.tianfeng.bark.badbeat: My lord... would not listen after all.
gen.tianfeng.bark.smug: I called it. What of it.
gen.tianfeng.bark.taunt: Win, and Feng dies. Lose, and Feng dies.
gen.tianfeng.bark.tilt: Do not fight — fight, and we lose!
gen.tianfeng.bio: The blunt counselor, waiting out the victory from prison.
gen.tianfeng.name: Tian Feng
gen.tianfeng.tell.strong: Bows to the ground, speaks without trimming.
gen.tianfeng.tell.weak: Still working the calculations to the clink of chains.
gen.wangjun.bark.open: Wang Jun — tower ships running east.
gen.wangjun.bark.smug: A single surrender flag over Stone City.
gen.wangjun.bio: Tower ships down from Yizhou, to gather Jinling's kingly air.
gen.wangjun.name: Wang Jun
gen.wangjun.tell.strong: Revises the tower-ship plans one more time
gen.wangjun.tell.weak: Counts the iron chains left across the river
gen.wangping.bark.badbeat: In the end, he would not be talked down.
gen.wangping.bark.open: Wang Ping. Ordered to hold here.
gen.wangping.bio: Solid in defense; knows the hour to advance.
gen.wangping.name: Wang Ping
gen.wangping.tell.weak: Counting the water sources under his breath.
gen.wangshen.bark.badbeat: How will history's pen... write me?
gen.wangshen.bark.open: Wang Shen, with a memorial to submit.
gen.wangshen.bark.smug: This ending was written long ago.
gen.wangshen.bark.taunt: A man who reads the times owes no blind loyalty.
gen.wangshen.bio: The pen that turned a conspiracy into a memorial.
gen.wangshen.name: Wang Shen
gen.wangshen.tell.strong: Pen never leaving his hand, words watertight
gen.wangshen.tell.weak: Ink still wet, already weighing who holds power
gen.wangshuang.bark.badbeat: An ambush... how is there an ambush!
gen.wangshuang.bio: A giant out of Longxi, with a meteor hammer.
gen.wangshuang.name: Wang Shuang
gen.wangshuang.tell.strong: Plants his hammer on the ground and the ground shudders
gen.wangshuang.tell.weak: Looks around for where the main force went
gen.wangzhi.bark.badbeat: My own game, and you saw through it.
gen.wangzhi.bark.open: Wang Zhi has laid on a humble wine.
gen.wangzhi.bark.taunt: Take the kindness while it is offered.
gen.wangzhi.bio: Grand Administrator of Xingyang. He sets his snares smiling.
gen.wangzhi.name: Wang Zhi
gen.wangzhi.tell.strong: The smile holds; not a cup stirs.
gen.wangzhi.tell.weak: A glance at the shadows under the gallery.
gen.weiyan.bark.smug: With the Chancellor away, watch me take the stage.
gen.weiyan.bark.taunt: Give me ten thousand men — Chang'an outright!
gen.weiyan.bio: One road through the Ziwu Valley — and no one would take it.
gen.weiyan.name: Wei Yan
gen.weiyan.tell.strong: Stands with sword, eyes full of nothing but Chang'an
gen.weiyan.tell.weak: Folds away, again, his own petition to fight
gen.wenchou.bark.open: Wen Chou is here. For Yan Liang, in repayment!
gen.wenchou.bio: One of Hebei's twin walls, riding beside Yan Liang.
gen.wenchou.name: Wen Chou
gen.wenchou.tell.strong: Iron spear stamps the earth; no one is in his eyes.
gen.wenchou.tell.weak: Jaw clenching at the name Yan Liang.
gen.wenpin.bark.badbeat: In the end... the spear went wide...
gen.wenpin.bark.smug: To chase or not — Pin knows the measure.
gen.wenpin.bark.taunt: Pin failed neither Liu of Jing nor Lord Cao.
gen.wenpin.bio: Loyal keeper of Jing Province — who could not face his old lord's kin.
gen.wenpin.name: Wen Pin
gen.wenpin.tell.strong: Halts his horse, spear leveled, courtesy intact
gen.wenpin.tell.weak: Head bowed, unable to meet his old lord's family
gen.wenqin.bark.badbeat: Too late... we've lost the whole game!
gen.wenqin.bark.smug: Every lad of Huainan is a hero.
gen.wenqin.bark.taunt: No coward bears the name Wen!
gen.wenqin.bio: Brave, thin on plans; father and son share one enemy.
gen.wenqin.name: Wen Qin
gen.wenqin.tell.strong: His voice arrives first; the blade follows
gen.wenqin.tell.weak: Fights his own son for the right to charge first
gen.wenyang.bark.open: Wen Yang stands here! Who dares follow!
gen.wenyang.bark.smug: Do you vermin know the name Wen Yang?
gen.wenyang.bio: The boy who turned the pursuers back alone.
gen.wenyang.name: Wen Yang
gen.wenyang.tell.strong: One flick of his whip — a thousand men give way
gen.wenyang.tell.weak: Glances back, counting what's left of the pursuit
gen.wutugu.bark.badbeat: Fire... where does the fire come from!!
gen.wutugu.bark.smug: Rattan armor — nothing like it under heaven.
gen.wutugu.bark.taunt: Blade and arrow bounce off. What have you left?
gen.wutugu.bio: King of Wuge, lord of rattan armor.
gen.wutugu.name: Wutugu
gen.wutugu.tell.strong: Rattan armor clattering on a twelve-foot frame.
gen.wutugu.tell.weak: Wrinkles his nose at the smell of tung oil.
gen.xiahouba.bark.smug: The Long slopes — I know every gully.
gen.xiahouba.bark.taunt: The Simas stole my house and my country!
gen.xiahouba.bio: A Xiahou of Wei's own blood, fled to Shu.
gen.xiahouba.name: Xiahou Ba
gen.xiahouba.tell.strong: Bow and saber together — the family's inherited ruthlessness.
gen.xiahouba.tell.weak: His hand stalls a beat at the sight of Wei banners.
gen.xiahoudun.bark.tilt: I have pulled an arrow and eaten the eye. You think I fear you!
gen.xiahoudun.bio: The one-eyed general who pulled the arrow out and ate the eye.
gen.xiahoudun.name: Xiahou Dun
gen.xiahoudun.tell.strong: The single eye crackles. It does not blink.
gen.xiahoudun.tell.weak: The single eye slides away from you.
gen.xiahouyuan.bark.badbeat: Too fast... I was the one too fast.
gen.xiahouyuan.bark.smug: Speed is the whole of war.
gen.xiahouyuan.bio: War prizes speed; his temper is the war.
gen.xiahouyuan.name: Xiahou Yuan
gen.xiahouyuan.tell.strong: Tiger strides grinding the earth, itching to go.
gen.xiahouyuan.tell.weak: Hurrying the dealer, again and again.
gen.xuchu.bark.open: Xu Chu of Qiao. Bring it on!
gen.xuchu.bio: The Tiger Fool. Great strength, straighter heart.
gen.xuchu.name: Xu Chu
gen.xuchu.tell.strong: Bare-armed slap on the table; the rafters ring.
gen.xuchu.tell.weak: Scratches his head, looks again, none the wiser.
gen.xuhuang.bark.badbeat: This loss... the regulations never covered.
gen.xuhuang.bark.open: Xu Huang of Yang County. Your move.
gen.xuhuang.bio: In the mold of Zhou Yafu — drills his men hard.
gen.xuhuang.name: Xu Huang
gen.xuhuang.tell.strong: Axe and halberd in hand, ranks standing like a forest
gen.xunyu.bark.badbeat: In the end, no Han stipend left to eat...
gen.xunyu.bark.smug: A steady hand at the center; ten quiet years.
gen.xunyu.bark.taunt: What Yu serves is the house of Han.
gen.xunyu.bio: A king-maker's talent — held in trust for Han.
gen.xunyu.name: Xun Yu
gen.xunyu.tell.strong: Sits formal as rite; counsel laid out in clean order.
gen.xunyu.tell.weak: Thumb tracing the lid of an empty provision box.
gen.xuyou.bark.badbeat: You... dare show me such disrespect!
gen.xuyou.bark.taunt: A-Man — you still know my face?
gen.xuyou.bio: One traitor's name, one torch at Wuchao.
gen.xuyou.name: Xu You
gen.xuyou.tell.strong: Slaps an old friend's calling card, laughing loud.
gen.xuyou.tell.weak: Fingers an emptied cup, scanning the room for someone to fill it.
gen.yanghu.bark.badbeat: This illness... cost me the crossing...
gen.yanghu.bark.smug: Not fighting is its own kind of fighting.
gen.yanghu.bark.taunt: Hu does not prey on the bereaved.
gen.yanghu.bio: Light furs, loose sash; he besieges with good faith.
gen.yanghu.name: Yang Hu
gen.yanghu.tell.strong: Closes the hunt slowly, taking only what is his
gen.yanghu.tell.weak: Shakes his head gently at the medicine pot
gen.yangyi.bark.badbeat: Why is the credit... never mine!
gen.yangyi.bark.smug: An orderly retreat is a victory too.
gen.yangyi.bark.taunt: The Chancellor's tent cannot do without me.
gen.yangyi.bio: A fine administrator; a poor companion.
gen.yangyi.name: Yang Yi
gen.yangyi.tell.strong: Grain ledgers, muster rolls — recited clean in one breath.
gen.yangyi.tell.weak: Side-eye fixed on a colleague's merit list.
gen.yanliang.bark.badbeat: This one... something is wrong with this one!
gen.yanliang.bark.open: Yan Liang of Hebei. Form ranks!
gen.yanliang.bio: Hebei's first blade, and it does not stop.
gen.yanliang.name: Yan Liang
gen.yanliang.tell.strong: Great saber level; the whole camp goes quiet.
gen.yanliang.tell.weak: Pacing the front line, out of patience.
gen.yanyan.bark.smug: Half the credit for Shu rides on one of my arrows.
gen.yanyan.bark.taunt: In this army there are only generals who lose their heads!
gen.yanyan.bio: The general who offers his neck, never his knee.
gen.yanyan.name: Yan Yan
gen.yanyan.tell.strong: Leaning on his saber, white hair unperturbed.
gen.yanyan.tell.weak: Quietly leaves the newly surrendered men behind him a way out.
gen.yuanshao.bark.open: Yuan Shao. Four generations of ministers.
gen.yuanshao.bark.smug: Heaven's mandate rides with the Yuans.
gen.yuanshao.bio: Four generations of ministers. Stern outside, hollow within.
gen.yuanshao.name: Yuan Shao
gen.yuanshao.tell.strong: That pedigree holds his spine bolt-straight.
gen.yuanshao.tell.weak: Eyes darting left and right, left and right.
gen.yuanshu.bark.badbeat: Honey water... is there no honey water?
gen.yuanshu.bark.smug: The mandate belongs to my Yuan clan.
gen.yuanshu.bark.taunt: Four generations of my house have sat among the Three Excellencies!
gen.yuanshu.bark.tilt: I, the Emperor, will not suffer this!
gen.yuanshu.bio: Dry bones in a barrow, clutching a jade seal and styling himself sovereign.
gen.yuanshu.name: Yuan Shu
gen.yuanshu.tell.strong: Cradles the Imperial Seal, knuckles gone white.
gen.yuanshu.tell.weak: Counts the grain carts — then counts them again.
gen.yufan.bark.open: Yu Fan. I have a question.
gen.yufan.bio: Jiangdong's blunt scholar; a needle in every sentence.
gen.yufan.name: Yu Fan
gen.yufan.tell.strong: Flicks his sleeve, fires back, voice climbing.
gen.yufan.tell.weak: Twists his beard, pauses a beat.
gen.yujin.bark.badbeat: The water... is the water rising?
gen.yujin.bark.smug: A military order is a mountain.
gen.yujin.bio: Steady as Mount Tai, until the last chapter.
gen.yujin.name: Yu Jin
gen.yujin.tell.weak: One glance at the low ground.
gen.zhangbao.bark.badbeat: Xing, brother... finish it for me.
gen.zhangbao.bark.open: Zhang Bao, heir to his father's spear!
gen.zhangbao.bark.smug: A tiger cub from a house of generals.
gen.zhangbao.bark.taunt: You've heard my father's name, haven't you?
gen.zhangbao.bio: A tiger's son, new master of the serpent spear.
gen.zhangbao.name: Zhang Bao
gen.zhangbao.tell.strong: Spear like a tiger's pounce, a roar to clear the road
gen.zhangbao.tell.weak: Flushes red racing Guan Xing for honors
gen.zhangfei.bark.badbeat: I don't believe in luck. Deal again!
gen.zhangfei.bark.open: Zhang Fei of Yan is here!
gen.zhangfei.bark.taunt: Say that again. I dare you.
gen.zhangfei.bio: Leopard head, ring eyes — and a fine mind hiding in the rough.
gen.zhangfei.name: Zhang Fei
gen.zhangfei.tell.strong: Round eyes bulging, leaning into the table.
gen.zhangfei.tell.weak: Reaches for the wine bowl, sets it back down.
gen.zhanghe.bark.badbeat: After Jieting, there is no road back...
gen.zhanghe.bio: A great captain who wins by the clever turn.
gen.zhanghe.name: Zhang He
gen.zhanghe.tell.strong: Leaning forward, a fox watching the rabbit.
gen.zhanghe.tell.weak: Half a step back; he takes your measure again.
gen.zhangliao.bark.open: Zhang Liao of Yanmen. Your move.
gen.zhangliao.bark.smug: I can hold this ten more years.
gen.zhangliao.bio: The man who broke a hundred thousand with eight hundred.
gen.zhangliao.name: Zhang Liao
gen.zhangliao.tell.strong: Reins held still, counting your camps first.
gen.zhangliao.tell.weak: A laugh with weariness in it.
gen.zhangren.bark.open: Zhang Ren. This land is mine to hold.
gen.zhangren.name: Zhang Ren
gen.zhangren.tell.strong: Bow at full draw, nothing moves.
gen.zhangren.tell.weak: A glance toward Fallen Phoenix Slope.
gen.zhangxiu.bark.open: Zhang Xiu of Wancheng. Your move.
gen.zhangxiu.bio: Spear-king of the North. Surrendered, then turned.
gen.zhangxiu.name: Zhang Xiu
gen.zhangxiu.tell.strong: Spear-point resting on the floor, steady as bedrock.
gen.zhangyi.bark.smug: I had my say, then I fought.
gen.zhangyi.bark.taunt: Strong they may be — the line holds!
gen.zhangyi.bark.tilt: Han stands or falls with us!
gen.zhangyi.bio: He remonstrated first, then fought, and never once looked back.
gen.zhangyi.name: Zhang Yi
gen.zhangyi.tell.strong: Counsels with hand on sword, every word a driven nail.
gen.zhangyi.tell.weak: Fingers resting on an old knot in his sword tassel.
gen.zhangzhao.bark.open: Zhang Zhao of Jiangdong. A question.
gen.zhangzhao.name: Zhang Zhao
gen.zhangzhao.tell.strong: Ramrod straight, quoting the classics chapter and verse.
gen.zhangzhao.tell.weak: The hand inside his sleeve trembles.
gen.zhaoyun.bark.badbeat: The young lord still lives. Yun cannot retreat.
gen.zhaoyun.bark.open: Zhao Yun of Changshan. I'll take this fight.
gen.zhaoyun.bark.smug: Room to advance, room to retreat.
gen.zhaoyun.bio: All courage, stem to stern. Changban proved it.
gen.zhaoyun.name: Zhao Yun
gen.zhaoyun.tell.strong: Spear angled behind him, breathing slow and long.
gen.zhaoyun.tell.weak: One arm curling over the bundle in his lap.
gen.zhonghui.bark.badbeat: Merit too tall... and the throne indeed trembled.
gen.zhonghui.bark.smug: The conquest of Shu — who but me?
gen.zhonghui.bark.taunt: You child — you dare debate war with me?
gen.zhonghui.bark.tilt: Sound the call — all armies, to order!
gen.zhonghui.bio: A calligrapher's ambition — a sword hidden beneath the brush.
gen.zhonghui.name: Zhong Hui
gen.zhonghui.tell.strong: His brush coils like dragons; each stroke deploys a formation
gen.zhonghui.tell.weak: Reads someone else's victory dispatch one more time
gen.zhoucang.bark.open: Zhou Cang, blade-bearer to Lord Guan!
gen.zhoucang.bark.smug: Even Red Hare rests. I don't.
gen.zhoucang.bark.taunt: This blade of mine ain't light either!
gen.zhoucang.bark.tilt: I'll run on water to catch him!
gen.zhoucang.bio: The blade-bearer — fastest legs under heaven.
gen.zhoucang.name: Zhou Cang
gen.zhoucang.tell.strong: Carries eighty-two jin like a bamboo staff
gen.zhoucang.tell.weak: Gnashes his teeth at naval banners
gen.zhoutai.bark.tilt: To reach my lord, come through me!
gen.zhoutai.bio: Twelve wounds, one lord's life. A fair trade.
gen.zhoutai.name: Zhou Tai
gen.zhoutai.tell.strong: Strips his armor to show the scars — nerve from head to heel
gen.zhoutai.tell.weak: Draws his lord a little further behind him
gen.zhouyu.bark.open: One wrong note in the music, and Zhou Yu turns.
gen.zhouyu.bark.smug: Between a jest and a laugh, masts and hulls to ash.
gen.zhouyu.bark.tilt: If heaven made Yu, why also—!
gen.zhouyu.bio: Jiangdong's young commander. Genius and temper in equal flame.
gen.zhouyu.name: Zhou Yu
gen.zhouyu.tell.strong: The hand that played the qin comes to rest on the sword.
gen.zhouyu.tell.weak: The arrow wound pulses, faint and old.
gen.zhuge.bark.open: Liang. A farmer of Nanyang, no more.
gen.zhuge.name: Zhuge Liang
gen.zhuge.tell.weak: The fan pauses for a breath.
gen.zhugedan.bark.badbeat: My own men... going over to them?
gen.zhugedan.bark.open: Zhuge Dan — for the house of Wei, down with the usurper!
gen.zhugedan.bark.tilt: Shouchun lives or dies with me!
gen.zhugedan.bio: An egg against a stone — and the fiercest rebellion of them all.
gen.zhugedan.name: Zhuge Dan
gen.zhugedan.tell.strong: Stands by his banner as Huainan's troops roar his name
gen.zhugedan.tell.weak: Rubs the Zhuge family letter over and over
gen.zhugeshang.bark.badbeat: Father... your son goes on ahead.
gen.zhugeshang.bark.smug: A grandson does not let the family name fall.
gen.zhugeshang.bark.taunt: My grandfather's name, my father's name — no man defiles them!
gen.zhugeshang.bio: A general's grandson, first over the wall and first to die.
gen.zhugeshang.name: Zhuge Shang
gen.zhugeshang.tell.strong: Cinches his armor tighter and tighter; gives no ground.
gen.zhugeshang.tell.weak: Looks back toward Chengdu, eyes rimmed red.
gen.zhugezhan.bark.badbeat: Within, I could not root out Huang Hao...
gen.zhugezhan.bark.smug: I will not shame my father's name.
gen.zhugezhan.bark.taunt: Father and son — Han's debt runs two generations deep!
gen.zhugezhan.bio: The Chancellor's son; Mianzhu was his last stand.
gen.zhugezhan.name: Zhuge Zhan
gen.zhugezhan.tell.strong: Carries his father's old fan; sits straight as his shadow.
gen.zhugezhan.tell.weak: Afraid the surname outweighs the man.
gen.zhuran.bark.badbeat: Relief... why does it not come?
