gen.zhuran.name: Zhu Ran
gen.zhuran.tell.strong: Knows the granary ledgers by heart
gen.zhuran.tell.weak: Counts the new rings of siege outside
gen.zhurong.bark.smug: If not the Lady, then who?
gen.zhurong.bark.taunt: The women of the south burn hotter!
gen.zhurong.bio: Descendant of the fire god; her flying blades collect what is owed.
gen.zhurong.name: Zhurong
gen.zhurong.tell.strong: Throwing knives across her back, smiling at ease.
gen.zhurong.tell.weak: Keeps one eye on the children's tent.
intro.bossBio: A warlord of the chaos, with a game of his own.
intro.bossQuote: This road answers to my cards first.
intro.caption: Portrait from the tattered scroll
intro.skirmishBio: A nobody, guarding the one step he will not yield.
intro.skirmishQuote: A chance meeting on the road — let the hands decide.
line.tauntImmune: (He doesn't blink, as if he never heard.)
map.hint2: Win to rewrite history · lose and still enter the record
map.title: March Map
omen.pick: Before you march, choose one omen.
omen.title: The Omen
page.apocFolio: No final draft · a stray tale
practice.entrySub: 33 tables from Three Kingdoms lore · 2–8 players · practice book only, the canon stays untouched
practice.title: The Muster Grounds
prologue.0.kicker: Prologue · The Scroll Chooses Its Reader
prologue.0.p0: Four volumes, fifty chapters, each with historical sources and the bounds of the romance
prologue.0.p1: Old friends remember your wins—and your choices
prologue.0.text: You are the reader outside the tattered scroll. The Writer asks you to step into the Records of Heroes—not to stand nameless in place of Liu Bei or Guan Yu, but to sit beside old friends and, in one crucial hand, win them another possibility. Collect thirty crimson seals of the apocrypha and you will meet the Writer, and learn why this scroll chose you.
prologue.0.title: History recorded the battlefield, never the card table.
prologue.1.kicker: Prologue · Every Outcome Becomes a Chapter
prologue.1.p0: Victory rewrites; defeat also enters the scroll
prologue.1.p1: Only after a major chapter is rewritten does the next volume unfold
prologue.1.text: Win the final hand and the original record is rewritten as apocrypha. A defeat is not wasted: you live through the regret as it was, and earn a Lesson—so next time you know what to watch.
prologue.1.title: Win, and rewrite a regret; lose, and understand a deeper truth.
prologue.2.kicker: Prologue · The Card Table Is the Battlefield
prologue.2.text: Make the best five-card hand from your hole cards and the community cards. Protect your war chest through bets, calls, and folds; reduce the enemy general's war chest to zero and you rewrite this chapter. In multi-player games, eliminate every enemy general.
prologue.2.title: Two hole cards, five community cards; win war chests, not arguments.
prologue.3.kicker: Prologue · Three Lessons Beyond the Cards
prologue.3.p0: Tell: strong may not be strong, weak may not be weak
prologue.3.p1: Goading: Zhang Fei is quick to anger; Sima Yi is immovable as a mountain
prologue.3.p2: The march: your war chest follows you; choices along the way leave consequences
prologue.3.text: Before the volume opens, choose an Omen. At the table, a general's manner will betray strength or weakness—but can also be feigned; after the showdown, the tell log tests your judgment. Once per hand you may use Goading to stir his Temper.
prologue.3.title: Read the cards, and the man; seize the initiative, and borrow the Omen.
prologue.hint: The background prologue lasts about thirty seconds; mechanics will be explained again at your first action
prologue.skip: Skip the background, enter the scroll
save.invalid: Unrecognized save file — choose a JSON exported by this game.
save.note: Save files interoperate with the web edition; unfinished marches and hands are not included.

settings.equityAssistDesc: Shows win rate, split rate and draw outs from your cards, the board and live opponents; never reads hidden cards.
settings.languageNote: The literary chapter text is Chinese-original; other languages fill in as they are completed.
settings.title: Settings
settle.chooseYeshi: How this page ends is yours to write:
story.baidicheng.battle.0.text: You can change a man's fate. Can you change the sunrise?
story.baidicheng.battle.1.text: I have sold straw sandals and I have sat on a throne. At the end, what frightens me most is that Adou cannot stand once no one holds him up.
story.baidicheng.battle.2.text: Then let him stand today, on his own. I can aid him. I cannot live his life for him.
story.baidicheng.battle.3.text: Elder brother, you did not leave me at Maicheng. Today you are not allowed to leave yourself first.
story.baidicheng.battle.4.text: Yunchang, if you were still here, would you scold me again for doing nothing but weep?
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.0.text: The smell of medicine at Yong'an Palace cannot cover the sound of the river. A half-written edict lies by Liu Bei's pillow, its last few words refusing to be set down.
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.1.text: Two years ago Cao Pi took the Han seal on the altar of abdication. When word reached Chengdu the whole court urged the throne. The First Lord took it to continue Han, and for one sentence: Han need not die.
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.2.text: The business of Shun and Yu, I know it now. Four hundred years of Han must have someone to close the book. Xuande, will you not be the one?
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.3.text: Yunchang lives, and Yiling never burned. So why am I still lying here? A man can dodge his own mistakes. He cannot dodge the years.
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.4.text: Yunchang lives, and Yiling burned all the same. Saving one name does not excuse us from the next mistake.
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.5.text: Since my second brother left, every day has felt borrowed. Today there is nowhere left to borrow from, so I have sent for Adou and Kongming.
story.baidicheng.coldOpen.6.text: Your Majesty, illness can be treated. Words cannot be left standing on their heads. Today, is it your minister you wished to see, or a man who can carry Shu-Han to the end for you?
story.baidicheng.intros.天命 · 沉疴.0.bio: The fire at Yiling did not finish Ji-Han, so it came back as medicine bowls and a water clock, taking Liu Bei a little at a time.
story.baidicheng.intros.天命 · 沉疴.0.quote: A man may dodge a war. He may not dodge the years.
story.baidicheng.intros.天命 · 沉疴.1.bio: It brings no soldiers and plays no tricks. It simply takes a little from every day at the sickbed.
story.baidicheng.intros.天命 · 沉疴.1.quote: You can beat the heroes of the age. Can you beat an illness?
story.baidicheng.loss.clue: Lesson · The long illness wins by grinding you down. On a new run the war chest starts at +150: hold your own pot first, then look for something beyond the deathbed charge.
story.baidicheng.loss.text: The edict was finished after all. Zhuge Liang bowed to receive it, and Liu Bei was at ease, having laid a whole state on one man's every waking and sleeping hour.
story.baidicheng.map.0.choices.0.detail: Tell reading up this round; remember the words at the sickbed
story.baidicheng.map.0.choices.0.text: Ask him to say everything left unsaid, face to face
story.baidicheng.map.0.choices.1.detail: The Omen starts at -1 morale; remember the young lord ruling in his own right
story.baidicheng.map.0.choices.1.text: Have Adou read the memorials through himself first
story.baidicheng.map.0.lines.0.text: If I write 'take it yourself if he cannot hold it,' am I trusting you, or loading on you the throne I dare not put down? Kongming, guess whether I was afraid when I wrote that line.
story.baidicheng.map.0.lines.1.text: My lord, if you truly trust me, do not write your trust as an order I am not allowed to refuse. What I want is not to take it. It is for you to leave Adou the share he should carry.
story.baidicheng.map.0.title: Yong'an Palace · The Edict Unwritten
story.baidicheng.objective: Win Liu Bei back more time from the long illness, and turn the deathbed charge from a test and a burden back into real trust.
story.baidicheng.win.hook: After the sickbed came urgent word from Nanzhong. Meng Huo would not submit to the king's law, and Kongming said his heart must be taken first.
story.baidicheng.win.text: When daylight reached Yong'an Palace, Liu Bei pushed the medicine bowl aside and sat up on his own. He struck 'take it yourself' from the edict and wrote only that Adou should rule in his own right, and Kongming should never hold his tongue. The charge too heavy for any man to take up was never spoken at all.
story.baima.battle.0.text: Again? The blades of Song Xian and Wei Xu are still hanging at my saddle!
story.baima.battle.1.text: The Red Hare wheels from behind the earthen hill, and Yan Liang's standard burns alone at the front of the line — he is still asking who comes when the blade already arrives.
story.baima.battle.2.text: Under that standard is the army's morale he exists to shield. Break his banner and the line is finished.
story.baima.battle.3.text: That horse is fast! Wen Chiu's spear has not even warmed up — why are you running?!
story.baima.battle.4.text: The worst fault between two battle lines is lingering. Yunchang — the wine is here, and so is the road.
story.baima.coldOpen.0.text: Before the slopes of Baima, Yan Liang has cut down Song Xian and Wei Xu and beaten Xu Huang in twenty passes; Cao's generals go pale. Cao Cao turns his gaze to the one man who has kept his back to every battle report.
story.baima.coldOpen.1.text: Yunchang, I know your body is here and your heart is not. But Yan Liang's blade now hangs over the head of every general I have.
story.baima.coldOpen.2.text: I gave my word: two deeds and I go. After this battle, Chancellor, honor yours — I have already heard where Xuande is.
story.baima.coldOpen.3.text: Yan Liang's valor cannot be met head-on; Wen Chiu's temper can be played. Only one thing worries Fengxiao: after these two strokes of Yunchang's blade, no power on earth will hold him.
story.baima.coldOpen.4.text: Is Cao's camp out of men? Send up that red-faced horse-archer. Let's have a look.
story.baima.intros.songxian.0.bio: Awake from Lü Bu's old dream, he burns to prove himself to a new lord.
story.baima.intros.songxian.0.quote: A man of the Warm Lord's old guard is no coward! Watch me!
story.baima.intros.wenchou.0.bio: After Jieqiao he learned to wait; now Yanjin asks him to chase — and he hates nothing more than that contradiction.
story.baima.intros.wenchou.0.quote: You taught me to count the beats. This time, you count my hooves.
story.baima.intros.wenchou.1.bio: Vengeance for Yan Liang weighs heavier than his spear; baggage scattered across the road will not slow his charge.
story.baima.intros.wenchou.1.quote: Baima's account is settled at Yanjin.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.0.bio: He remembers a blade too fast to see; this time he digs his camp in deeper.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.0.quote: That blade... this time, I will see where it comes from.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.1.bio: The finest blade of Hebei — his winning streak has convinced him no faster blade exists under heaven.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.1.quote: Ten li of linked camps. Whoever comes, dies.
story.baima.loss.clue: Lesson · Yan Liang loses to contempt; Wen Chiu wins by waiting for your haste. On retry, abandon baggage first to disorder his ranks: Wen Chiu opens with -200 war chest.
story.baima.loss.text: Victory in the first line made you greedy for the second. By the time Wen Chiu's iron cavalry floods the riverbank, you remember Guo Jia's words: between two lines, what truly must be read is Yunchang's heart.
story.baima.map.0.choices.0.detail: Wen Chiu opens with -200 war chest; remember the bait column
story.baima.map.0.choices.0.text: Bait him with the old and weak; abandon baggage in pretend rout
story.baima.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember what stands under the standard
story.baima.map.0.choices.1.text: Walk Guan Yu through a good look at Yan Liang's standard
story.baima.map.0.lines.0.text: Yan Liang's troops are drilled but know no variation; Wen Chiu is brave but hot-blooded. Between the two lines, what truly must be read is Yunchang's heart.
story.baima.map.0.lines.1.text: Rest easy, Lord Xun. This blade swings for the Chancellor once — and once only. Then I go to find my brother.
story.baima.map.0.lines.2.text: Two lines, two strokes of the blade, both of them clean. Drag the mud and the road home grows long.
story.baima.map.0.title: Liyang · Between Two Battle Lines
story.baima.objective: Between Baima and Yanjin, win Guan Yu two great deeds — and win him, with them, one road home.
story.baima.win.hook: Two great deeds buy one sheet of passage. Ahead lie five passes and six generals — and not one of them has read this letter.
story.baima.win.text: When Baima's standard falls, Wen Chiu at Yanjin is still counting your rhythm in the hoofbeats. Two lines, two strokes — clean as the spine of Guan Yu's blade. He does not drink the wine Cao Cao pours with his own hand; he only bows with cupped fists: 'Chancellor — Guan takes his leave.' The letter seeking his brother, long folded in his sleeve, finally comes out.
story.baimenlou.battle.0.text: Watch for when his stack falls below three tenths. A cornered beast shoves in its last scrap of reason too.
story.baimenlou.battle.1.text: Chen Gong! If I obey you this once — will the world laugh at me?
story.baimenlou.battle.2.text: It will. But only the living get to be laughed at.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.0.text: Outside the walls, Cao's army. Inside, soldiers three days without water. And the Warm Lord still says: were he only allowed to ride out, he could not lose.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.1.text: At Hulao you won the cards. Dare you wager your life one more time?
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.2.text: You've come. I've read that page of Hulao — but this time, what needs saving is not his winning name.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.3.text: The rope at White Gate Tower hangs just outside the page. Every hand you win brings it into focus.
story.baimenlou.intros.chengong.0.bio: He has not come to win for Lü Bu. He has come to beg one road out for Xiapi.
story.baimenlou.intros.chengong.0.quote: If all you can do is win hands, you cannot save him.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.0.bio: Beaten once at Hulao, Lü Bu is all the less willing to admit he is already trapped.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.0.quote: You can make me lose. Can you make me live?
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.1.bio: The Si River drowns the city, and the finest under heaven is still waiting for a direction worth charging.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.1.quote: Stand aside. I'll cut one more road out.
story.baimenlou.loss.clue: Lesson · Chen Gong has read the rhythm of a cornered beast. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.baimenlou.loss.text: Only as the rope draws tight do you realize: all along you answered 'how to beat Lü Bu,' and never once answered 'how Lü Bu might agree to live.'
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves; remember Chen Gong's counsel
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.0.text: Let Chen Gong finish describing that one road out
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.1.text: Make Lü Bu promise, in his own words, not to charge blindly again
story.baimenlou.map.0.lines.0.text: I urged him out of the city. He asked me whether he would still be Lü Bu once he left it. There — that is his true cage.
story.baimenlou.map.0.lines.1.text: Xuande is on the tower too. If you save Fengxian today — who reins him in tomorrow?
story.baimenlou.map.0.title: The Si River · The Last Counsel
story.baimenlou.objective: Find the true dead end between Lü Bu and Chen Gong, and decide whether Xiapi gets a tomorrow.
story.baimenlou.win.hook: The green plums of Xuchang are ripening. Cao Cao has already heard: the finest under heaven did not die — and you were at that table.
story.baimenlou.win.text: In the end Lü Bu does not charge the gate. He lifts off his golden headdress and, for the first time, asks Chen Gong: 'Where do we retreat?' For one night, the weeping in Xiapi stops.
story.bowang.battle.0.text: Liu Xuande finds himself a strategist and suddenly all he does is retreat? Then I'll chase until there's no slope left for you to hide on.
story.bowang.battle.1.text: Xiahou Dun has bitten on my spear. Advisor — how far is the fire?
story.bowang.battle.2.text: No hurry. He chases because he is still winning. The fire is meant for this exact moment — the moment he is certain he is right.
story.bowang.battle.3.text: Now I get it! This retreat isn't handing him the road — it's handing him a narrower and narrower one!
story.bowang.coldOpen.0.text: The grass on Bowang Slope has dried just right. Zhuge Liang weights the fire-striker under the map, and hands each man a road he must walk to the end while losing.
story.bowang.coldOpen.1.text: Three visits, and what won me over was my brother's courtesy. But if all you know is telling me to fall back — that I won't swallow!
story.bowang.coldOpen.2.text: Yide, fall back until you can hear Yunchang's gong. Before the fire, let's not turn a feint into a real rout.
story.bowang.coldOpen.3.text: Bei begged the Master down from the mountain not to fight your battles of pride, but to teach you not to bleed for nothing.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.0.bio: He remembers the last ambush, yet still refuses to admit that a pursuit can be led by the nose.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.0.quote: Same slope. I won't need you to show it to me twice.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.1.bio: The single eye looks only forward; he reads every retreat as the enemy's cowardice.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.1.quote: If Xinye holds nothing but fire, then let it burn Liu Bei first.
story.bowang.loss.clue: Lesson · Retreating is not fleeing. Every show of weakness must keep the next ambush — and the stake to buy back in. On retry, war chest +150; don't let the bait become a true rout.
story.bowang.loss.text: Xiahou Dun never rode into the fire, because your rout looked too much like a rout: the ambush rushed to rescue, the bait forgot to stop. Bowang Slope holds nothing but smoke — and not one soldier of Cao's stepped into the plan.
story.bowang.map.0.choices.0.detail: Xiahou Dun opens with -1 morale; remember the brothers' ambush
story.bowang.map.0.choices.0.text: Have Yunchang and Yide signal each other by gong
story.bowang.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember each stage of the ambush
story.bowang.map.0.choices.1.text: Walk the bait road stage by stage with Zilong
story.bowang.map.0.lines.0.text: The Military Advisor tells us each how many paces to give — and marks the very tree to stop behind. Seems playing 'defeated' is harder than playing victorious.
story.bowang.map.0.lines.1.text: My spear shows itself to Xiahou Dun first. If he bites on me, Yunchang and Yide get their true ambush.
story.bowang.map.0.lines.2.text: Fine! Then I'll lose convincingly. But whoever breaks and runs for real comes back to polish every spear in the army!
story.bowang.map.0.title: Bowang Slope · How Far to Fall Back
story.bowang.objective: Make Guan Yu and Zhang Fei believe in the war council's plan — and make Xiahou Dun believe every step of the pursuit was his own idea.
story.bowang.win.hook: The fire of Bowang taught Cao's army the name Xinye. The next visit comes faster: Zilong will carry A'dou in his arms and cut his way out through a map of ambushes he knows by heart — in reverse.
story.bowang.win.text: Zhang Fei reins in his spear first; Guan Yu follows with a cupped-hand salute. Zhuge Liang does not accept the bow — he hands the scorched, bent banner to Zilong instead. Liu Bei smiles: from this day on, the brothers compete not over who charges first, but over who is willing to be the last to fall back.
story.caochuan.battle.0.text: The water camp stays in; bows and crossbows move up. I will see how many men this fog is hiding.
story.caochuan.battle.1.text: Now pull half the drums. When he hears our strength ebb, he'll decide we've begun closing the net.
story.caochuan.battle.2.text: The empty boats have swung to the outer hulls. Cao Cao won't look where the drums are thickest — he'll guess at the quietest stretch of water.
story.caochuan.battle.3.text: The drums have gone hollow. Don't pursue — more arrows. If they're retreating, it's a trap.
story.caochuan.battle.4.text: The arrows weren't tricked out of him. He loosed them at the ambush he carries inside his own chest.
story.caochuan.coldOpen.0.text: At the third watch, Lu Su runs his hand over the straw men lining the boats and finally understands: what Zhuge Liang means to borrow is not only arrows, but the one part of Cao Cao that dares not send out ships.
story.caochuan.coldOpen.1.text: And if the fog lifts without warning? Zijing — Lu Su can gamble with you; Jiangdong cannot be buried with you.
story.caochuan.coldOpen.2.text: Rest easy, Chancellor. My brother and I know Jiangdong's waterways by heart — in fog like this, they'd never dare launch a boat.
story.caochuan.coldOpen.3.text: This hall has voted for war, so the arrows cannot live only in a ledger. Zijing — this boat keeps a promise; it does not dice with death.
story.caochuan.coldOpen.4.text: The fog's only job is hiding the boats. What Cao Cao sees in it — that part we still have to write.
story.caochuan.intros.caizhong.0.bio: The fake-defector brothers have changed costumes again; their story still drifts half a beat apart.
story.caochuan.intros.caizhong.0.quote: Th- this time my little brother stayed behind. The intelligence — I'll handle it all myself.
story.caochuan.intros.caizhong.1.bio: A young clansman of Lady Cai; every word of the surrender letter was negotiated — except with each other.
story.caochuan.intros.caizhong.1.quote: Surrendered soldier Cai Zhong, at the Chancellor's service!
story.caochuan.intros.caocao.0.bio: He read your hidden edge at the plum pavilion; now he trusts no probe on the river less.
story.caochuan.intros.caocao.0.quote: So my old friend from the plum wine has learned to hide in fog as well?
story.caochuan.intros.caocao.1.bio: On the north bank he hears every drumbeat as a sentence left unfinished — a lie half told.
story.caochuan.intros.caocao.1.quote: Boats on a foggy night mean something. No one moves out yet.
story.caochuan.loss.clue: Lesson · Cao Cao re-reads the truth from your drumbeats. Never run the same bluff to the end. On retry, reading improves.
story.caochuan.loss.text: The fog has not lifted, but Cao Cao has already stopped the arrows. You treated his suspicion as an order that would never change, and forgot that a suspicious man's chief talent is changing his mind. Lu Su can only pull you back to the empty boats.
story.caochuan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Cao's army opens with -1 morale; remember the drum array
story.caochuan.map.0.choices.0.text: Beat drums on all twenty boats at once; mimic a main force
story.caochuan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves; remember the deliberate blanks in the fog
story.caochuan.map.0.choices.1.text: Drums at bow and stern; leave gaps of silence
story.caochuan.map.0.lines.0.text: Straw butts, boats, the watches — everything is ready except Cao Cao's willingness. What if he sees through the straw men?
story.caochuan.map.0.lines.1.text: So we can't merely blur his sight. We must make him feel he sees farther than we do.
story.caochuan.map.0.lines.2.text: The fog hides the boats — and the drums paint him an ambush that isn't there.
story.caochuan.map.0.title: River Fog · Letting the Blank Speak
story.caochuan.objective: Make Cao's army decide to loose its arrows before the fog lifts — borrow Cao Cao's suspicion itself into Jiangdong's armory.
story.caochuan.win.hook: The arrows are ready; the east wind is not. Zhou Yu waits at Red Cliffs — waiting equally for Zhuge Liang to show one crack of being too late.
story.caochuan.win.text: When the fog lifts, every straw man on every boat stands bristling. Lu Su no longer asks what if the fog had lifted early — he is too busy shouting for a count. Zhuge Liang snaps off one arrowhead and slides it into his sleeve. Arrows enough. What the next page borrows is fire.
story.changban.battle.0.text: Yuanrang chases Zilong; Junyi cuts the home bridge. I want Xuande with no road left in any direction.
story.changban.battle.1.text: With A'dou in my arm, the spear cannot play only to win. Yide — does the bridge still stand?
story.changban.battle.2.text: Every time he wheels that horse, he is looking for the same man. Don't chase the spear — chase the bridge he keeps turning back toward.
story.changban.battle.3.text: That fire at Bowang — today I collect it out of your line of retreat!
story.changban.battle.4.text: Long as I'm still standing here, their hundred thousand have to come at me one at a time!
story.changban.coldOpen.0.text: In the dust of Changban, civilians, baggage, and broken soldiers jam a single road. Zhao Yun walks against the flow; Zhang Fei reins in at the bridgehead and stops.
story.changban.coldOpen.1.text: My lord, my lady and young A'dou are still behind us. Yun will go and come back. If he does not — Yide, hold the bridge for me.
story.changban.coldOpen.2.text: I don't want your 'for me'! Come back and hold it yourself!
story.changban.coldOpen.3.text: Zhao Zilong of Changshan... Wen Pin has orders to bar the way, but no heart to hound you to death. This spear holds back three parts of itself.
story.changban.coldOpen.4.text: My order: Zhao Yun taken alive. As for the black-faced general on the bridge — I will see for myself what makes three armies stop.
story.changban.intros.caocao.0.bio: After the plum pavilion he still remembers that clap of thunder — now he means to force out the answer with a thousand companies.
story.changban.intros.caocao.0.quote: The thunder hid you once. Today I let a thousand armies turn your cards over.
story.changban.intros.caocao.1.bio: Fresh off the defeat at Bowang, he is warier still — and all the less willing to give Liu Bei another chance to regroup.
story.changban.intros.caocao.1.quote: Fire does not win twice. Pursue.
story.changban.intros.caocao.2.bio: He wants more than Xuande's defeat; he wants to see what kind of man an army in rout still turns around for.
story.changban.intros.caocao.2.quote: Zhao Yun alive. The rest — spare no one.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.0.bio: After Red Cliffs he holds the old lands of Jingzhou, knowing the histories will record whether he pursued — and whether he didn't.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.0.quote: Chase or not chase at Changban — Pin still has not worked it out.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.1.bio: He remembers the spear half-withdrawn at Changban; when he strikes now, he leaves nothing in reserve.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.1.quote: This time you don't get through. My apologies to my old lord's family.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.2.bio: A Jingzhou veteran newly sworn to Cao's camp, every inch of his spear caught between present duty and old loyalty.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.2.quote: Pin patrols here under orders. The Changban road is closed.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.0.bio: The fire of Bowang still burns in his one eye; he reads Zilong's wheeling charge as the same ambush again.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.0.quote: Zhuge is not on that bridge. Let's see who saves you now.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.1.bio: Meeting you again, he still knows only forward — but he has begun to suspect every retreat that opens too easily.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.1.quote: This time you fall back, I watch what's behind you first.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.2.bio: The one-eyed general carries Bowang's old fury; he is first to catch Zhao Yun — and the likeliest to overrun him.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.2.quote: Before Changban, first repay Bowang one arrow.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.0.bio: He remembers how you found your path last time; this time every way back is inked onto his battle map.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.0.quote: The road you slipped away by last time — this time I seal it myself.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.1.bio: He does not race Xiahou Dun; he counts the paces left between Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.1.quote: One rescues, one holds the bridge. Separate them.
story.changban.loss.clue: Lesson · Cao Cao wants a prisoner, Yuanrang wants revenge, Zhang He wants the bridge cut. Make them quarrel over one line of pursuit instead of pushing each down a road of his own. On retry, enemy morale -1.
story.changban.loss.text: Zhao Yun finds A'dou but no road back to the bridge; Zhang Fei's roar stops the pursuers, but not three military orders splitting apart at once. Lone courage wins a skirmish. It cannot save everyone.
story.changban.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the meaning of walking against the tide
story.changban.map.0.choices.0.text: Shield the people first; then follow the crying to A'dou
story.changban.map.0.choices.1.detail: Pursuers open with -1 morale; remember the pact of the bridge
story.changban.map.0.choices.1.text: Agree with Zilong: the bridge is found by Yide's banner color alone
story.changban.map.0.lines.0.text: Zilong, Bei cannot order you to abandon the people to save my son. If you bring back A'dou and leave them under the blades, the battle is still mine to lose.
story.changban.map.0.lines.1.text: Yun understands. Seven passes in and out is not seven feats of daring — it is coming back every time still knowing someone is waiting.
story.changban.map.0.title: Dangyang · Against the Tide of People
story.changban.map.1.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the thread of survival
story.changban.map.1.choices.0.text: Before breaking the bridge, leave one horse-wide track
story.changban.map.1.choices.1.detail: Cao Cao opens with -150 war chest; remember the plan of divided pursuit
story.changban.map.1.choices.1.text: Move three ragged banners; split three columns of pursuers
story.changban.map.1.lines.0.text: Too little dust behind the bridge and Cao Cao suspects a trick; too much, and the people have no road. Zilong isn't back yet, and I can't even break the bridge the way a man wants to break it!
story.changban.map.1.lines.1.text: Yide, leave a gap one horse wide. If three of them pursue together, make them fight over who crosses first.
story.changban.map.1.title: Changban Slope · One Bridge, Three Orders
story.changban.objective: With Cao Cao, Xiahou Dun, and Zhang He at one table in pursuit, bring Zhao Yun home with A'dou — and keep Zhang Fei standing on Dangyang Bridge.
story.changban.win.hook: The boats of Hanjin are near — and Cao Cao has memorized that bridge. The next road runs to Jiangdong: Liu Bei needs the one sentence that will make Sun Quan commit troops.
story.changban.win.text: Zhao Yun lays the child in Liu Bei's arms, and only then does Zhang Fei give up the bridgehead. Cao Cao does not punish Xiahou Dun or Zhang He; he just stares at the broken span: 'One dared to come back. One refused to leave. It wasn't the pursuit I lost.'
story.chencang.battle.0.text: Ladders again. Zhao told you—try another way, Chancellor.
story.chencang.battle.1.text: Fire arrows fall like rain, and the ladders burn row by row. That gaunt figure on the wall has not moved a step in twenty days.
story.chencang.battle.2.text: Hold, Hao Zhao! Wang Shuang's relief has come—Tch! Even the pursuers dare follow this close?!
story.chencang.battle.3.text: Enough. Pass the order: withdraw the troops, back to Hanzhong. Chencang stands, but the name of Hao Bodao—Liang will remember it.
story.chencang.coldOpen.0.text: Chencang was small but hard. Its defender, Hao Zhao, had barely a thousand men. Shu ladders, ramming carts, and tunnels came in turn; the fire arrows on the wall called them out one by one.
story.chencang.coldOpen.1.text: Chancellor Zhuge's siege engines—Zhao has had twenty days' acquaintance with them. The city is small; the good part is, there is less to defend.
story.chencang.coldOpen.2.text: Hao Bodao knows how to hold a city; storming it only costs our men. Boyue, tell me—to besiege a city, what do you besiege first?
story.chencang.coldOpen.3.text: Wei believes: to besiege a city, first besiege the heart. Hao Zhao's townsman Jin Xiang is in our army—we can send him to urge surrender and test the man's resolve.
story.chencang.coldOpen.4.text: Twenty days now! Keep at it and Chang'an's relief force will arrive. Chancellor, grant Wen Chang three more days and I will break this city!
story.chencang.intros.haozhao.0.bio: He remembers every siege engine you've brought, and three more rows of fire arrows now crown the wall.
story.chencang.intros.haozhao.0.quote: Siege ladders? Battering rams? Tunnels? I've prepared for them all.
story.chencang.intros.haozhao.1.bio: A thousand men hold a lone city, and what they hold has never been walls—it's a single word: faith.
story.chencang.intros.haozhao.1.quote: Zhao has received Wei's grace. While the city stands, I stand. I beg the Chancellor to try another way.
story.chencang.intros.wangshuang.0.bio: His meteor hammer has recorded your officers—and recorded his own recklessness too.
story.chencang.intros.wangshuang.0.quote: This time, keep close to the main force! My hammer shows no mercy!
story.chencang.intros.wangshuang.1.bio: A giant from Longxi, he has carried the rewards of the first over the wall the whole way.
story.chencang.intros.wangshuang.1.quote: Wang Shuang is here! Whose head is worthy of my hammer?
story.chencang.loss.clue: Lesson · Hao Zhao met attack with defense, and every engine you brought only called the roll for him. On a new run, cut the relief first, then count the cooking smoke, and let his stores speak for you.
story.chencang.loss.text: On the twentieth day of the siege, the ladders burned out and Chang'an's relief arrived. Beneath the walls of Chencang you learned the same lesson: some cities will not fall to assault; some generals will not fall to persuasion.
story.chencang.map.0.choices.0.detail: Insight increases this run; remember the smoke-count
story.chencang.map.0.choices.0.text: Count the city's stores by its cooking smoke
story.chencang.map.0.choices.1.detail: Wei army starts with 200 less war chest; remember the severed relief
story.chencang.map.0.lines.0.text: Zhao knows the Chancellor will take Chencang before he moves on. A pity—not one inch of the city His Majesty gave me will I yield.
story.chencang.map.0.lines.1.text: He will not surrender. Is it faith in Wei, or faith that no one behind him would hold? Press on with the engines. Press on with the letters too.
story.chencang.map.0.lines.2.text: Chancellor, while Xing escorted the grain, he counted: the cooking smoke in the city grows thinner by the day.
story.chencang.map.0.lines.3.text: Then let us see who arrives first—his food running out, or Chang'an's relief.
story.chencang.map.0.title: Sanguan · Ladders and Letters
story.chencang.objective: Between siege ladders and fire arrows, find out why Hao Zhao holds the city, then decide whether Chencang should fall.
story.chencang.win.hook: Retreated from Chencang, but the heart of the northern campaign has not retreated. Upstream on the Wei, a greater standoff is gathering water—and this time, the opponent is Sima.
story.chencang.win.text: On the road of retreat, Wang Shuang gave chase and ran headlong into the ambush you had set at Sanguan. Wang Shuang slain, the great army turned back, and on the walls of Chencang, Hao Zhao leaned on the battlements and gazed a long while. He held the city; Zhuge Liang won the whole of Longyou its ease—and in this battle, neither man lost.
story.chibi.battle.0.text: One man borrowing wind, one man carrying fire, and one nobody. Good — I clear the whole table at once.
story.chibi.battle.1.text: Kongming first, or me? Every player you knock out, the other is reading your cards.
story.chibi.battle.2.text: The cut cable lets him believe the ships can scatter and flee. But before the order ever reaches the other hulls, the fire has decided for him.
story.chibi.battle.3.text: The empty jars don't mean no fire — they make Gongjin believe you hold no follow-up. Now push the real oil out.
story.chibi.battle.4.text: Cao Cao fears ambush; Zhou Yu fears ending with nothing; Kongming fears the wind arriving late. The gap for fire opens between those three fears.
story.chibi.coldOpen.0.text: Cao Cao's linked fleet lies north; Zhou Yu's fire ships wait south; Zhuge Liang's Seven Star Altar stands between. Three players at one table — and not two of them who win the same thing.
story.chibi.coldOpen.1.text: The linked decks ride steady as plain ground. Let me hear what Wu means to burn me with this time.
story.chibi.coldOpen.2.text: If Kongming cannot borrow the wind, the fire attack dies stillborn. And if you merely beat him, Cao Cao crosses the river all the same.
story.chibi.coldOpen.3.text: So this table holds no allies. Only the question of who sees first that the wind is already in whose sleeve.
story.chibi.intros.caocao.0.bio: From plums to Red Cliffs, he still means to force the answer you keep hidden onto the table.
story.chibi.intros.caocao.0.quote: At the wine you hid behind thunder. Where will you hide from open flame?
story.chibi.intros.caocao.1.bio: Eight hundred thousand linked hulls — he wants the north never to need naval war again.
story.chibi.intros.caocao.1.quote: The ships are chained together. The river itself is my Central Plain now.
story.chibi.intros.zhouyu.0.bio: He watched a hundred thousand arrows arrive as promised, and all the less will he let Kongming own Red Cliffs alone.
story.chibi.intros.zhouyu.0.quote: You borrowed your arrows. The fire still answers to me.
story.chibi.intros.zhouyu.1.bio: His fire attack lacks one thing only — and he refuses to admit he too is waiting on the wind.
story.chibi.intros.zhouyu.1.quote: A false note in the song, and Zhou turns his head. And if the wind plays false?
story.chibi.intros.zhuge.0.bio: He remembers the world sketched at Longzhong, and how you turned one conversation into a battlefield.
story.chibi.intros.zhuge.0.quote: Today we rank not who wins first, but when the wind rises.
story.chibi.intros.zhuge.1.bio: On the Seven Star Altar, he speaks of the hardest thing to borrow as if it were already in his sleeve.
story.chibi.intros.zhuge.1.quote: The wind will come. Whether men will wait is another matter.
story.chibi.loss.clue: Lesson · At a multi-way table everyone reads your bets; knocking out one player hands the next his chance to furl sail. On retry, reading improves.
story.chibi.loss.text: Clear Zhou Yu first and Cao Cao reels in his ships; pin Cao Cao first and Zhuge Liang stops waiting for the wind. Red Cliffs was not lost to any single card — it was lost to three players who never sat down in the same hand.
story.chibi.map.0.choices.0.detail: Cao's army opens with -200 war chest; remember the cut link
story.chibi.map.0.choices.0.text: Secretly undo one link of the chained rigging
story.chibi.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves; remember empty jars, real fire
story.chibi.map.0.choices.1.text: Swap the fire oil for empty jars — a show of weakness
story.chibi.map.0.lines.0.text: Fire ships burn once and once only. If Kongming leaves first, the wind may never come; if Mengde leaves first, he takes his main force with him.
story.chibi.map.0.lines.1.text: You both wait on the wind. I have chained my hulls together — let it come; it will only light a few more lamps.
story.chibi.map.0.lines.2.text: The prize isn't three stacks of chips. It's keeping all three men in their seats until the same instant.
story.chibi.map.0.title: Wulin · Three Fuses
story.chibi.objective: In a three-way game where no two players want the same victory, bring the fire ships, the southeast wind, and Cao Cao's suspicion all to the table at the same moment.
story.chibi.win.hook: Cao Cao breaks toward Huarong Road. Guan Yu's blade already waits there — and Zhuge Liang says tonight still owes him a favor.
story.chibi.win.text: Only when the last opponent leaves his seat does the southeast wind cross the banner-tips. The fire ships ride it into the linked fleet. Zhou Yu does not look at you — but Zhuge Liang has already folded his fan. Both understand: what you held onto just now was not three stacks of chips. It was one shared instant.
story.daodan.battle.0.text: Yunchang, today we speak only of old friendship. Come, drain this cup—
story.daodan.battle.1.text: Zijing, the wine is good. But the ink on that note: Guan remembers it clearer than you do.
story.daodan.battle.2.text: Footsteps under the deck! General, my blade—
story.daodan.battle.3.text: Zhou Cang, back. Today this blade only drinks with me.
story.daodan.battle.4.text: Father, Lu Su walked us to the bow himself. His hand has been gripping that note inside his sleeve the whole way.
story.daodan.coldOpen.0.text: Lu Su wrote the invitation three times, each politer than the last. The boat waits mid-river with axemen in the cabin, and the note says only 'a talk of old times.'
story.daodan.coldOpen.1.text: Yunchang, I have no other purpose. I only ask to settle the Jingzhou account with you, face to face.
story.daodan.coldOpen.2.text: If Zijing invites me, how would Guan dare stay away? Ping, come to the feast with me. Zhou Cang, bring the blade.
story.daodan.coldOpen.3.text: Father, the strategist's word before we left: this feast turns on the wine, not on Jingzhou. On good faith, not on the blade.
story.daodan.coldOpen.4.text: I will plant the blade at the bow and let the men of Jiangdong see what it weighs!
story.daodan.intros.dingfeng.0.bio: He moved his ambush three times, and never heard the cup break.
story.daodan.intros.dingfeng.0.quote: Wait a little longer... why has the commander's cup not hit the deck?
story.daodan.intros.dingfeng.1.bio: The old warrior who once fought with short blades in the snow has his short blades under the table now.
story.daodan.intros.dingfeng.1.quote: Three rounds in, the cup is the signal.
story.daodan.intros.lusu.0.bio: He failed to get Jingzhou back last time. This time his argument is smoother, and his axemen are hidden deeper.
story.daodan.intros.lusu.0.quote: Yunchang, what I want this time is still not your surrender. It is one word: return.
story.daodan.intros.lusu.1.bio: The most decent man in Jiangdong has finally learned to set his trap in the wine.
story.daodan.intros.lusu.1.quote: The note is here. Yunchang, look it over.
story.daodan.loss.clue: Lesson · Lu Su wants good faith, not a city; the ambush waits for a blade, not an argument. On a new run tell reading is higher: stay the blade first, then settle the account.
story.daodan.loss.text: The instant the blade cleared the sheath, the feast was lost. You could not hold down eighty-two catties of temper, nor the short blades under the deck. The river washed 'one blade to a feast' into 'both sides broken.'
story.daodan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Tell reading up this round; remember the law of the pour
story.daodan.map.0.choices.0.text: Read the rhythm of Lu Su's pouring, and the look in his eye
story.daodan.map.0.choices.1.detail: The Wu ambush starts at -1 morale; remember what a stayed blade means
story.daodan.map.0.choices.1.text: Hold Zhou Cang's scabbard down; courtesy before force
story.daodan.map.0.lines.0.text: Yunchang, there is nothing at this table but old friendship between us. I drink first, to you.
story.daodan.map.0.lines.1.text: Your wine I will drink, Zijing. The Jingzhou account can wait until we are drunk.
story.daodan.map.0.lines.2.text: The note lies under his sleeve, the axemen under the deck. Whoever moves first, loses.
story.daodan.map.0.title: Lukou · A Feast Mid-River
story.daodan.objective: At the feast in Lukou, send Lu Su home without Jingzhou — and without Guan Yu having to draw.
story.daodan.win.hook: The feast of the lone blade broke up; the account between the two houses did not. Toward Hefei the drums were beating faster and faster, waiting for Sun Quan.
story.daodan.win.text: The boat pulled away from mid-river, and Lu Su stood at the landing, watching that eighty-two-catty blade go. He never broke the cup, because Guan Yu had said at parting: 'Zijing, the pact over Jingzhou: Guan has noted it. What you are keeping is not a note. It is the good faith between two houses that has not yet broken.' No whistle sounded on the boat back to camp. Only you knew that this cup had bought Jingzhou a few more years.
story.dingjunshan.battle.0.text: Zhang He, watch the flank. As for you — survive three of my fast strikes, then we can talk about my age.
story.dingjunshan.battle.1.text: The harder he pushes you, the more you should watch me. Miaocai's blade comes from the front; my formation closes behind your back.
story.dingjunshan.battle.2.text: What you're measuring isn't the mountain. It's that half-beat after Miaocai hears the word 'fast' — the half-beat he never turns back from.
story.dingjunshan.battle.3.text: You're not repairing that abatis. You're handing Miaocai a reason he simply must be fast. Now — wait for him to break the gate open.
story.dingjunshan.battle.4.text: One wants me fast, one wants him slow. This old man only needs to stand between the two orders.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.0.text: Two drums sound on Dingjun Mountain, one high, one low. Xiahou Yuan's beats men forward; Zhang He holds ranks and sounds out the paths. The two drums never quite meet — and after listening three times, Huang Zhong unstrung his bow.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.1.text: They say the old general has a single stroke left in him. Enough, if it lands. My fear is one man too fast to meet it, one too clever to come.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.2.text: Hansheng — two generals at odds on that mountain is heaven's third road for you. On the banners, Xiaozhi writes one character only: Wait.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.3.text: Old brother — that cry of 'a general who loses his head, not his nerve' on the Shu road all those years ago. I return it to you today, word for word. Your flank is Yan Yan's to handle.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.4.text: Old, and still daring to hold the high ground? Before dawn's drum sounds, I'll come up the mountain and take that blade of yours.
story.dingjunshan.coldOpen.5.text: Miaocai, a man on high ground plays weak on purpose. If speed is all you know, you'll spare him the trouble of baiting you.
story.dingjunshan.intros.huangzhong.0.bi: The old general does not race men's feet. He races the single step that carries an enemy into his blade.
story.dingjunshan.intros.huangzhong.0.qu: What's old is the calendar, not the cut.
story.dingjunshan.intros.xiahouyuan.0.bi: Speed is his standing order — and the drum anyone else finds easiest to beat faster.
story.dingjunshan.intros.xiahouyuan.0.qu: Zhang He shifts; Xiahou strikes fast. Which one do you take first?
story.dingjunshan.intros.zhanghe.0.bio: The master of the shifting formation, brilliant at rearranging lines — less so at rearranging a comrade's temper.
story.dingjunshan.intros.zhanghe.0.quote: War has no fixed shape. A pity Miaocai only believes in one kind of fast.
story.dingjunshan.loss.clue: Historian's note · The two of them will alternate speed grabs and formation shifts; read one after the other acts. On a rerun, upgrade your Read.
story.dingjunshan.loss.text: Xiahou Yuan's speed forced you into haste; Zhang He's shifts sealed off the retreat. You waited for them to collide, and instead two rhythms took turns dragging you under. The old general's blade never left its sheath.
story.dingjunshan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read gains upgraded; note the half-beat
story.dingjunshan.map.0.choices.0.text: Sound both camps' watches first, then lay the blades
story.dingjunshan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Cao army opens with -200 supplies; note the false gap
story.dingjunshan.map.0.choices.1.text: Leave a stretch of broken abatis as bait for eager repairs
story.dingjunshan.map.0.lines.0.text: If I shore up the left, Miaocai will surely snatch glory on the right. The higher you stand, the less he'll wait for my flag.
story.dingjunshan.map.0.lines.1.text: Your formation won't be finished before Huang Zhong is off and running! A fast fight IS the soundest formation.
story.dingjunshan.map.0.lines.2.text: No need to wish them harmony. One fast, one slow — that's a few free cuts for this old man.
story.dingjunshan.map.0.title: Mount Dingjun · Half a Beat Off
story.dingjunshan.objective: Play Xiahou Yuan's speed against Zhang He's caution; let the old general's single stroke land in the half-beat where the two swap positions.
story.dingjunshan.win.hook: Hanzhong won, Guan Yu is lifted to the height of a name that shakes the empire. The autumn rains are coming to the Mian River — and fame makes the brightest flag of all.
story.dingjunshan.win.text: Xiahou Yuan charged into that half-beat before Zhang He's new formation could turn. Huang Zhong did not strike a second blow — he just slung the blade across his shoulder, and every camp in Hanzhong changed flags at once. The two drums on the mountain finally kept a single watch together.
story.fengyiting.battle.0.text: No hole cards today — only the name of father and son. Whoever first treats the other as an enemy opens the hand for me.
story.fengyiting.battle.1.text: Fengxian — will you leave with her, or with me? Think it through before you bet.
story.fengyiting.battle.2.text: All that talk of how generously you treated me, Father. So you kept count of everything I owed.
story.fengyiting.battle.3.text: Don't look at me. Look at yourselves: one terrified of losing power, one terrified he was never his own man.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.0.text: The lotus at Phoenix Pavilion bloom in perfect stillness. Dong Zhuo waits outside for his beauty; Lü Bu waits behind the rockery for an explanation. Diao Chan waits only for them to share a table.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.1.text: The Grand Chancellor wants my submission; the General wants my vow. Today I answer neither — I want them to hear each other's answer.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.2.text: At Hulao you forced me back a step. Make me yield again today, and it will not be I who leaves — it will be this whole Mei stronghold.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.3.text: Fengxian, I have been generous with you. Must even you peek at her through the bead curtain?
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.0.bio: The locks at Mei have been changed, yet he still believes every loyal heart can be locked away in his vault.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.0.quote: Come to sow discord again? This time I watch you first, and Fengxian second.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.1.bio: He keeps his favors in a ledger, and expects Lü Bu to repay them, entry by entry, in obedience.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.1.quote: Father and son at one table — what is there that cannot be said aloud?
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.0.bio: After Hulao he learned to back down once, but never again would he let anyone else decide where he belongs.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.0.quote: Last time you won my halberd. This time — don't choose for her.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.1.bio: The old defeat dulled nothing; it only made him less able to bear being treated as another man's property.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.1.quote: I know you. And I know that look in your eye — the one that says 'for your own good.'
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.2.bio: His Sky Piercer stands outside the pavilion, yet what he fears most is one ambiguous sentence inside it.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.2.quote: Let her say it plainly. You too.
story.fengyiting.loss.clue: Lesson · Don't probe Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu separately. When one bets, watch where the other looks first. The crack in the chain trick runs between the two of them; on retry, false tells are reduced.
story.fengyiting.loss.text: Dong Zhuo takes it for a rivalry over a woman; Lü Bu, for deception. Diaochan removes her earrings and does not weep: you tried to win two men for her, and forgot that what she wanted to win was one sentence — that she belonged to no one.
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; note the Preceptor's suspicion
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.0.text: Let Dong Zhuo see Lü Bu hesitate first
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.1.detail: Enemy opens with -1 morale; note Fengxian's rage
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.1.text: Let Lü Bu hear Dong Zhuo's possessiveness
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.0.text: If they come to question me separately, I can only answer in halves. Seat them together, and the Grand Preceptor raises only after glancing at Fengxian, while Fengxian folds to the sound of the Preceptor's laughter.
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.1.text: So you need not deceive two men. You need only make one true sentence land differently in two pairs of ears.
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.2.text: No. I want them to finally understand that I am not the prize inside that sentence.
story.fengyiting.map.0.title: Fengyi Pavilion · One Sentence, Two Ears
story.fengyiting.objective: Set Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu doubting each other across one table, and play the last step of the interlocking stratagem for Diao Chan.
story.fengyiting.win.hook: After Fengyi Pavilion, Lü Bu and Diaochan both leave Mei. But an envoy from Xiaopei is already on the road — next chapter, he comes to make peace between two houses.
story.fengyiting.win.text: Diaochan pushes open the pavilion door and, for the first time, speaks without borrowing anyone's expression. Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu go on staring at each other until 'father and son' is nothing but a torn invitation. She runs to neither man; she simply walks her own road out of Mei.
story.ganlu.battle.0.text: I am the Son of Heaven! Who dares slay his lord—who dares?!
story.ganlu.battle.1.text: The Duke of Sima fed you all for this day, did he not?! Strike—
story.ganlu.battle.2.text: Cheng Ji's halberd came up. The armored soldiers filled the street, watching—watching the Son of Heaven, and watching the halberd, to see whose word they would obey.
story.ganlu.battle.3.text: Let the halberd fall, and the historians will write it. Let me die, and the word 'Wei' will still stand. Come on—I am here!
story.ganlu.coldOpen.0.text: Fifth year of Ganlu, Luoyang. The twenty-year-old Son of Heaven wrote his last poem at Lingyun Terrace, titled 'The Hidden Dragon.' When it was done, he snapped the brush in two.
story.ganlu.coldOpen.1.text: Sima Zhao's heart—every passerby knows it! I will not sit and take deposition and disgrace—today, my lords, follow me to strike down this traitor!
story.ganlu.coldOpen.2.text: Fear not, my lord. The Son of Heaven takes up a sword himself—it is only a child's game. Soldiers kept a thousand days—used here, now.
story.ganlu.coldOpen.3.text: Your Majesty... I, I deserve death ten thousand times. But this matter—I can only, only take the first step away.
story.ganlu.coldOpen.4.text: My mind is made up. Even if blood stains the palace walls today, on the historian's page the name 'Wei' will still stand!
story.ganlu.intros.jiachong.0.bio: He remembers the halberd that stopped midair last time. This time he won't even give the order to stop.
story.ganlu.intros.jiachong.0.quote: This time, no holding back. Variables get removed first.
story.ganlu.intros.jiachong.1.bio: He never holds the blade himself; he only places it in the most fitting hand.
story.ganlu.intros.jiachong.1.quote: Jia Chong is here. Your Majesty, don't make your servants do the unpleasant work.
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.0.bio: The trap at Iron Cage Mountain taught him a shell of humility; now the shell is thicker and the blade is closer.
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.0.quote: Everyone who ever cornered me must die. The Son of Heaven—no exception?
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.1.bio: You have crossed blades many times; this time his back rests on the whole Sima name.
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.1.quote: Again. Your 'rewriting'—I, I should like to see which page you manage to reach.
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.2.bio: A man one step from the throne hates above all to be reminded his name is not rightful.
story.ganlu.intros.simazhao.2.quote: The Son of Heaven marching himself? A grand show. A pity—the tally of troops is in my hand.
story.ganlu.intros.wangshen.0.bio: Last time his brush did not last till dawn; this time he wets the ink earlier.
story.ganlu.intros.wangshen.0.quote: My memorial has already been copied twice. The copy for the Duke of Jin goes first.
story.ganlu.intros.wangshen.1.bio: The brush of a historian's house, between honor and lineage, fell clean and quick.
story.ganlu.intros.wangshen.1.quote: Wang Shen has a memorial to present.
story.ganlu.loss.clue: Lesson · Jia Chong wins because he 'cuts off your eyes and ears first.' On replay, keep your eyes on the halberd and gather the old loyalists; beyond victory and defeat, this page wagers on the next line of the historian's brush.
story.ganlu.loss.text: The halberd fell. The Emperor's blood spattered the bricks of the southern gate tower and did not fade for three days. Sima Zhao, hearing the news, was 'greatly shocked' and had Cheng Ji's entire clan executed—the blade and the crime sheathed together.
story.ganlu.map.0.choices.0.detail: War chest +150; remember the hearts of the old loyalists
story.ganlu.map.0.choices.0.text: First gather three thousand old guardsmen and loyal ministers
story.ganlu.map.0.choices.1.detail: Tell reading improves this chapter; remember that halberd
story.ganlu.map.0.choices.1.text: Watch the hand Cheng Ji keeps on his halberd
story.ganlu.map.0.lines.0.text: 'Alas, the dragon is trapped; it cannot cross the deep.' ...Write it ever so well, and it is still a lament for himself.
story.ganlu.map.0.lines.1.text: Your Majesty, keep the poem if you will, but the road cannot be just one. Beyond the palace walls, is there anyone left who will listen to the Son of Heaven?
story.ganlu.map.0.lines.2.text: Whether there is or not, I will walk this way. Historian, bring your brush—today every stroke writes it straight!
story.ganlu.map.0.lines.3.text: The guards at the southern gate obey only Cheng Ji. And Cheng Ji—obeys only me.
story.ganlu.map.0.title: Taiji Hall · The Hidden Dragon's Poem
story.ganlu.objective: Before the southern gate, keep one last road of retreat for the Son of Heaven—or a battle fought with a clear conscience.
story.ganlu.win.hook: The Emperor's blood was not spilled, but the Sima clan's patience had run out. The last names of Wei, Shu, and Wu would all be written into the same history.
story.ganlu.win.text: Beneath the southern gate tower, Cheng Ji's halberd never fell—you called out his father's name in the open street, and broke the order that recognized only one 'lord.' The armored soldiers murmured and scattered; Jia Chong's sleeve was empty for the first time. The Son of Heaven stood at the palace gate with his sword, and the court historian dipped his brush: 'In the fifth year of Ganlu, the Emperor personally punished traitors, and the traitorous faction collapsed.' Wei drew one last breath—and that breath bore the name Cao.
story.gaopingling.battle.0.text: Kongming is still alive, and you still love to meddle. It seems I did lose Wuzhang Plains, and it still rankles.
story.gaopingling.battle.1.text: Kongming is gone. Which of you will still treat a dying man as an opponent?
story.gaopingling.battle.2.text: He is faking? But the whole court saw him... why did you not say so sooner!
story.gaopingling.battle.3.text: If all you can do is wait for him to die, you will never see how he lives.
story.gaopingling.battle.4.text: You saw through my illness but not through the fear of the officials. Once the blade is drawn, they will stand on my side soon enough.
story.gaopingling.coldOpen.0.text: After Wuzhang Plains he and I exchanged letters for many more years. Today only four words came: do not trust his illness. He is not waiting to die. He is waiting for you to count him dead first.
story.gaopingling.coldOpen.1.text: The star over Wuzhang Plains has already fallen. No one is left to read the Tomb Tiger for you now — only a bowl of gruel deliberately spilled across the back of a hand.
story.gaopingling.coldOpen.2.text: He cannot even get gruel to his mouth. How could he take my command? I have gone to look three times, and three times it was like that.
story.gaopingling.coldOpen.3.text: My father is this ill; I, Shi, can only keep the household stores in order. If the General doubts, why not go and look again yourself?
story.gaopingling.coldOpen.4.text: General... this old man has only one thing left unsettled. One day... I ask you to look after my two sons.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.0.bio: After losing once at Gaopingling he no longer merely feigns illness; even your suspicion may be a piece on his board.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.0.quote: The same prescription. I will not brew it a second time.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.1.bio: Wuzhang Plains did not let him outlast the Crouching Dragon, so he carried his patience back to Luoyang and waits for another man who underestimates him.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.1.quote: Kongming is still alive. Good. Let him see that outlasting is not only a matter of fate.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.2.bio: He has outlasted too many rivals. Now he plays old age as his last layer of armor, and grows Cao Shuang's contempt into a blade.
story.gaopingling.intros.simayi.2.quote: This old man is very ill. General, you may of course set your mind at ease.
story.gaopingling.loss.clue: Annals · His weakness is mostly bait, and the real raise comes after the illness. On replay, fewer false tells — do not loosen your grip at a show of frailty before the showdown.
story.gaopingling.loss.text: Cao Shuang handed over his seals still believing he could live out his days as a rich man. Sima Yi did not kill him at once; he let him work it out slowly — that performance of illness was never meant to fool one man's eyes. It was meant to fatten a whole court's wishful thinking.
story.gaopingling.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read bonus this round; remember the sickbed's false evidence
story.gaopingling.map.0.choices.0.text: Cross-check the prescription, the night watches, and who feeds him
story.gaopingling.map.0.choices.1.detail: Sima Yi -150 supplies; remember the first-move gate
story.gaopingling.map.0.choices.1.text: Secure the Empress Dowager's edict and the Luoyang arsenal first
story.gaopingling.map.0.lines.0.text: If he is faking, he is deceiving me. If he is truly ill, and I move now, I prove myself a man who bullies an old minister. What would you have me do?
story.gaopingling.map.0.lines.1.text: Since Wuzhang Plains I have taught him only one thing: patience is also a bet. If you never look at the hole cards, you will mistake his endurance for heaven's will.
story.gaopingling.map.0.lines.2.text: With no Crouching Dragon across the river to warn you, you must tell for yourself whether that bowl of gruel is feeding a sick man or feeding your own contempt.
story.gaopingling.map.0.title: Gaopingling · A Blade Outside the Sickroom
story.gaopingling.objective: Expose an illness staged for Cao Shuang's eyes alone, and hold the edict, the arsenal, and Wei's last real choice before Sima Yi opens his eyes.
story.gaopingling.win.hook: The Sima blade went back into its sheath for a while, but the three kingdoms had not stopped. Years later, the sound of men wrapped in felt rolling down a cliff would echo on the Yinping trail.
story.gaopingling.win.text: The gruel bowl hit the floor and Sima Yi rolled up out of bed — to find the arsenal sealed and the Empress Dowager's edict already read aloud. Cao Shuang did not hand over his seals, and the court was not given the purge in which every man must pick a side. For the first time the Tomb Tiger found that not every clever man in the room was willing to pretend to sleep with him.
story.guandu.battle.0.text: Every hand you play counts the days you have left to live. I need only wait. Hebei has never feared one more war council.
story.guandu.battle.1.text: Benchu, it isn't that you don't know whom to heed. It's that you fear having no one left to blame if you heed them wrongly.
story.guandu.battle.2.text: Wuchao has not burned, and every general of Hebei waits for someone else to change his tune first. A thousand stratagems, and suddenly not one will sign its name.
story.guandu.battle.3.text: Tian Feng, Ju Shou, Xu You — which of them failed me? You tell me first, Mengde!
story.guandu.coldOpen.0.text: At Guandu, the grain ledger runs thinner than the battle reports. Every day Cao Cao crosses off, Yuan Shao's tent gains another adviser who claims to have a plan.
story.guandu.coldOpen.1.text: Mengde, we've known each other since we were boys. I know your temper. Your granaries, I know even better.
story.guandu.coldOpen.2.text: So Yunchang went to Xuande after all. I kept the Red Hare and lost the man. Benchu — you never even saw the man to lose.
story.guandu.coldOpen.3.text: My lord, of the ten victories and ten defeats, I will vouch only for the first nine. The tenth you must go out and win yourself.
story.guandu.coldOpen.4.text: If my lord wins, Feng must die. If he loses, Feng dies as well. In a Jizhou cell, Yuanhao has already written your verdict for you.
story.guandu.coldOpen.5.text: When Xu You comes, seat him. I will greet him with one shoe missing — but the whole army must not see that I have three days of grain left.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.0.bio: He heard the plum pavilion ranked only Liu and Cao — so he means to turn an old friends' table into a public defense of the world.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.0.quote: Mengde — count the heroes again today. Is Yuan Benchu still on the list?
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.1.bio: He returns with a thousand companies and a belly full of stratagems, still missing the one thing: a man willing to sign his name to a decision.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.1.quote: Last time the council could not decide. This time — whose voice will you follow?
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.2.bio: Four generations of high office gave him too many advisers, and a seat from which he never has to be the first to admit error.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.2.quote: Hebei's troops are seasoned, her granaries full. What will you stretch, Mengde?
story.guandu.loss.clue: Lesson · Yuan Shao's mountain of chips is not his weakness; his dread of owning a decision is. Force him to choose before the blinds climb. On retry, raid Wuchao first: enemy war chest -200.
story.guandu.loss.text: The fire at Wuchao never catches. Yuan Shao still sits behind his heaps of dispatches — each one sound, each one someone else's responsibility. And your grain truly runs out, day by day.
story.guandu.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the barefoot welcome
story.guandu.map.0.choices.0.text: Trade the true grain count for one true sentence from Xu You
story.guandu.map.0.choices.1.detail: Yuan Shao opens with -200 war chest; remember the Wuchao raid
story.guandu.map.0.choices.1.text: Feint with split columns; leave Wuchao as the only real move
story.guandu.map.0.lines.0.text: Xu You asks how much grain I have left. Tell him the truth, and he may hand me Wuchao. Lie, and he walks tonight.
story.guandu.map.0.lines.1.text: Outside, Yuan Shao's drums press closer with every beat. Cao Cao slides the true ledger toward you: what burns tonight is not grain — it is his habit of letting others decide for him.
story.guandu.map.0.title: Guandu · True Ledger, False Ledger
story.guandu.objective: Turn Yuan Shao's deep war chest into hesitation, and find the true soft spot at Wuchao before the blinds swallow Cao's army whole.
story.guandu.win.hook: The north will soon be settled, but Liu Bei waits in Xinye for a snowfall. Cao Cao has advisers enough to fill a tent — and still has not found the one man willing to open a door.
story.guandu.win.text: No fire at Wuchao — and yet, one by one, the lamps go out in Yuan Shao's tent. Cao Cao does not gloat at his old friend; he simply closes the ledger padded with false grain: 'Benchu, you lost because every man in that tent was waiting for someone else to concede first.'
story.guijin.battle.0.text: Wei outlasted Shu, and Jin took up Wei's hand. You see — waiting lasts longer than any of your clever schemes.
story.guijin.battle.1.text: He holds union as his hole card. You need not out-fate him; make him prove why it must be so, and no other way.
story.guijin.battle.2.text: Merging is not grinding three names into one. It is making sure the next name to appear need not raise a world of chaos first.
story.guijin.battle.3.text: Without me to close it out, how many more years would you fight? Would you dare say that to the people inside the walls?
story.guijin.coldOpen.0.text: That blade at Huarong fell long ago, and the north changed hands all the same. You all say fate can be rewritten — and in the end is it not my Sima house that closes the book?
story.guijin.coldOpen.1.text: You let Cao Cao live at Huarong and bought Wei another breath. Pity that breath ended up surnamed Sima. Whom did your righteousness save?
story.guijin.coldOpen.2.text: Tower ships a hundred zhang long, iron chains a thousand fathoms deep. Wang Jun built boats in Yizhou for seven years for this one run downstream.
story.guijin.coldOpen.3.text: Lord Yang recommended Yu on his deathbed. He had already gathered the hearts of Jingzhou for me; Yu lacks only a rising river.
story.guijin.coldOpen.4.text: Iron chains across the Yangtze, and the natural moat looks after itself. Jin tower ships? Let them first ask permission of the rocks in the river!
story.guijin.coldOpen.5.text: Rest easy, Your Majesty. Cen Hun will add three more chains — fire will not burn through them, water will not flood them under!
story.guijin.coldOpen.6.text: This is the last page of the old history. If you win, "all under heaven becomes one" will no longer be the only sentence that can finish the book.
story.guijin.intros.simayan.0.bio: He was once forced to admit that union was not the only ending, so this time he means to gather every possibility back in at once.
story.guijin.intros.simayan.0.quote: Last time you left three banners standing. This time I will take the poles as well.
story.guijin.intros.simayan.1.bio: What he inherited was not only three kingdoms' territory, but his grandfather's deepest talent: waiting until everyone else is sick of it.
story.guijin.intros.simayan.1.quote: You fought a lifetime, and in the end does it not come down to one word — merge?
story.guijin.intros.wangjun.0.bio: The river wind last time made him remember you; this time he has brought two sets of torches.
story.guijin.intros.wangjun.0.quote: What you cannot burn is my ship. Again!
story.guijin.intros.wangjun.1.bio: An old general of seventy who still wants a marquisate has staked half his life on this one river.
story.guijin.intros.wangjun.1.quote: Tower ships down from Yizhou. The kingly air of Jinling ends on this voyage.
story.guijin.loss.clue: Annals · Sima Yan presses steadily with the momentum of union. On replay the enemy opens at -200 supplies; do not believe the ending for him ahead of time.
story.guijin.loss.text: Stone City finally hung the Jin banner. The people did get their peace — only the old history wrote every name smaller and smaller, until all that remained was the two words, returned to Jin.
story.guijin.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read bonus this round; remember the history of the many
story.guijin.map.0.choices.0.text: Write down the commoners' names on the back of the surrender first
story.guijin.map.0.choices.1.detail: Sima Yan opens at -1 morale; remember the echo of the three parts
story.guijin.map.0.choices.1.text: Raise the three kingdoms' old banners and contest one last hand
story.guijin.map.0.lines.0.text: I have spared every life in Jianye and left the lord of Shu his title of ease. What more do you want? Is a lifetime's name as a warlord worth more than peace?
story.guijin.map.0.lines.1.text: If peace may be named by one man only, then the next split will again leave only the blade with a voice.
story.guijin.map.0.lines.2.text: Do not fight over seats for heroes alone. Look at the back of the surrender — the ones left out of it are the ones who truly waited three generations.
story.guijin.map.0.title: Stone City · The Names Outside the Surrender
story.guijin.objective: Play out the last hand of the three kingdoms before "all under heaven becomes one" is written down, and prove that merging need not mean erasing every name.
story.guijin.win.hook: Scroll four is written out, yet a page remains on the reverse. The Writer has already laid out the cards: he wants to talk with you about these lives you have altered.
story.guijin.win.text: The tower ships stopped mid-river, and Jianye never offered a surrender. Looking at the three old banners, Sima Yan asked for the first time: "If the realm is not a trophy, what is left for me to keep?" No one could answer for him — but the grain market in the city opened its doors as usual the next morning.
story.huainan.battle.0.text: Wei's generals, Sima's soldiers—tell me, whose orders do your blades truly obey?!
story.huainan.battle.1.text: A hundred riders in pursuit? Wen Yang turns—one spear, one man, line up!
story.huainan.battle.2.text: Shouchun's grain can hold a year. Your Sima blades will dull first! Grow cold first!
story.huainan.battle.3.text: It isn't me who kills them. It's the word 'wait'—wait for reinforcements, wait for heaven's mandate, wait for someone else to die first.
story.huainan.coldOpen.0.text: The year after Sima Yi died, the first call to arms against the usurper rose in Huainan. Over the four years that followed, the same fire burned this land three times.
story.huainan.coldOpen.1.text: Sima Shi deposes the emperor and sets himself up—Heaven and earth will not suffer it! The six armies of Huainan ask only one question today: Wei, or the Sima?
story.huainan.coldOpen.2.text: Huainan rebels again. The situation my father left behind—I will settle it. However the eye pains me, I must march in person.
story.huainan.coldOpen.3.text: General Guanqiu, Wen Qin and his son with three thousand riders will take the vanguard! Charge the center, seize Sima Shi!
story.huainan.coldOpen.4.text: Father, in a night raid my spear goes out first. The Wei banners on Lejia will change in a single night!
story.huainan.intros.guanqiujian.0.bio: The old general who carved the stone in Liaodong is still waiting—for the second call to arms no one dares answer.
story.huainan.intros.guanqiujian.0.quote: However hard the stone, it must be carved a second time.
story.huainan.intros.guanqiujian.1.bio: He carved the deeds of Liaodong; now he means to carve the crimes of the Sima.
story.huainan.intros.guanqiujian.1.quote: Once this call goes out, success is Heaven's, but the name is mine.
story.huainan.intros.leshen.0.bio: He guards the Huainan his father left him, and the name of the Yue Jin household.
story.huainan.intros.leshen.0.quote: My father's formation—I haven't changed a single step.
story.huainan.intros.wenqin.0.bio: A son of Qiao Commandery, brave and nothing more—his throat is as loud as his nerve.
story.huainan.intros.wenqin.0.quote: No man named Wen fears death! Charge!
story.huainan.intros.wenyang.0.bio: Eighteen years old, a spear, and every pursuer's nightmare.
story.huainan.intros.wenyang.0.quote: Who dares chase? Wen Yang is here!
story.huainan.intros.zhugedan.0.bio: He saw Shouchun burn once. This time he raised the walls another three feet.
story.huainan.intros.zhugedan.0.quote: One more stand. The world remembers only that I rebelled anyway.
story.huainan.intros.zhugedan.1.bio: The Zhuge family's 'dog'—bites the hardest, and stands the loneliest.
story.huainan.intros.zhugedan.1.quote: Better a headless ghost than a man named Sima!
story.huainan.loss.clue: Lesson · Huainan was lost not for want of allies, but because each man waited on the others. On a new run, read the proclamations first and sort lord from follower; Wen Yang's valor is the last gate, not the whole city.
story.huainan.loss.text: Three rebellions fell one after another, and the walls of Shouchun changed flags three times. You remembered every proclamation's opening line, but never reckoned that Wu's reinforcements would arrive a step late each time—while the Sima blades came faster and faster.
story.huainan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Tell reading improves this chapter; remember the difference in the proclamations
story.huainan.map.0.choices.0.text: Study the proclamation's signatures and grain ledgers
story.huainan.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +150; remember the pact of outside aid
story.huainan.map.0.choices.1.text: Escort the proclamation east, and court Wu
story.huainan.map.0.lines.0.text: My brother has a tumor in his eye, yet he marches on Huainan himself. I stay in Luoyang—not from fear, but to watch every pair of eyes at court.
story.huainan.map.0.lines.1.text: The first rebellion fell to hunger, the second to suspicion, the third... I won't live to see it. Whoever comes after, finish my proclamation for me.
story.huainan.map.0.lines.2.text: The day Shouchun fell, my son rode alone, in and out seven times. Father told me to go, so I went—keep this life, and keep rebelling!
story.huainan.map.0.lines.3.text: Three fires, burning the same sentence. What you must read is: which wisp of smoke is loyalty—and which is only regret.
story.huainan.map.0.title: Xiangcheng · A Fire of the Same Name
story.huainan.objective: In the linked hands of the three Huainan rebellions, read the line between loyalty and recklessness, and find the one the call to arms was meant to reach.
story.huainan.win.hook: Huainan's fires burned out three times, and the Son of Heaven in Luoyang could sit still no longer—he would carry the dragon banner out the palace gates himself.
story.huainan.win.text: The proclamation reached Luoyang, and slipped into the historians' dreams. Three fires did not topple the Sima clan, but they scorched the strokes of 'Wei' deeper line by line: even their soldiers began to remember they had once been named Cao. Sima Shi peeled the gauze from his eye and found that more than his eye was aching.
story.huarong.battle.0.text: At Red Cliffs you learned to keep all three houses in their seats. Now only you and I remain — harder, isn't it?
story.huarong.battle.1.text: I signed the order; the charge is mine to bear. Shove the articles of war at me alone, and you are still making another man's hand fall with the blade.
story.huarong.battle.2.text: The debt is Guan's to owe; these lives were won by three armies. Don't let one word — honor — pay the bill for everyone.
story.huarong.battle.3.text: I calculated that Cao Cao's fate was not to die here. What I could not calculate was how you would choose. On this page at last, man outranks heaven by one move.
story.huarong.battle.4.text: He no longer speaks of the empire, only of old times. Cao Cao at the end of his road still knows exactly what can be wagered.
story.huarong.coldOpen.0.text: Cao Cao's horse is mired to the knee; a dozen riders are all that remain behind him. Guan Yu sits his horse, blade level — looking neither at you nor at the empty road to Jiangling.
story.huarong.coldOpen.1.text: Red Cliffs burned the linked fleet; it cannot burn an old debt. Yunchang — is this table down to you and me?
story.huarong.coldOpen.2.text: Here is my oath, and here is the old kindness. Guan asks one thing only: this stroke of the blade — for whose eyes does it fall?
story.huarong.coldOpen.3.text: Don't choose for him. What you have won is only this: that the choosing truly happens.
