story.shezhan.win.hook: Lu Su has boats waiting at the river. Zhuge Liang still needs a hundred thousand arrows — and Cao Cao's arrows outnumber Jiangdong's patience.
story.shezhan.win.text: Sun Quan flips the word 'surrender' face-down on the desk and calls for the maps of war. Zhang Zhao asks no more how many soldiers Cao Cao has — only how many ships Jiangdong can still fight. The ministers still argue, but no one can again describe surrender as an answer that costs nothing.
story.shuiyan.battle.0.text: As long as the ranks hold, water is only water. Guan Yu's fame is great, but even he must wait for heaven to fight his battle.
story.shuiyan.battle.1.text: The old channel looks like a way out. It is the shallowest water here. Yu Jin will not abandon his camp — so walk that safe road into a dead end for him.
story.shuiyan.battle.2.text: The stakes are sunk. He still says the high ground can be reached — because he hasn't seen the door close under the water.
story.shuiyan.battle.3.text: Water past the knee, and still no camp moves without orders. Wait — signal the high ground. Why no reply?
story.shuiyan.battle.4.text: Water is not the blade. What forbids retreat is an order heavy as a mountain; the water merely drowns the mountain.
story.shuiyan.coldOpen.0.text: The Mian had already swallowed the old boundary stones, yet Yu Jin's camps still stood in lines without a single flaw. Pang De's coffin waited outside the gate, its lacquer darker than the clouds.
story.shuiyan.coldOpen.1.text: The strength of the Seven Armies is discipline; their peril is that no man dares move camp without orders.
story.shuiyan.coldOpen.2.text: Lord Guan, the heavens may not side with you. My stores can hold ten days yet. If you linger, the first thing to break will be your own lines outside Fancheng.
story.shuiyan.coldOpen.3.text: General Yu, I came with my coffin waiting outside the camp. We hold together — and what we hold is not Wei soil, but each of our lords' names.
story.shuiyan.coldOpen.4.text: He means to wait out the rain. I need not make it fall sooner — only make him unable to bring himself to move first.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.0.bio: A former son of Xiliang, he trusts no fate — only the blade in his hand and the coffin outside the camp.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.0.quote: One more battle. The coffin is unused; the man, unreturned.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.1.bio: He remembers how Xiliang scattered and re-formed; he has traded defiance for a loyalty that means to die.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.1.quote: The young Ma lost in Xiliang. I will not lose here.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.2.bio: A surrenderer who arrived bearing his own coffin — every arrow repays a debt to his honor.
story.shuiyan.intros.pangde.2.quote: The coffin is here. Lord Guan — your fullest, please.
story.shuiyan.intros.yujin.0.bio: He remembers how low ground swallows an army, and still he will not let one unauthorized move ruin a spotless name.
story.shuiyan.intros.yujin.0.quote: Rising water can be measured. Morale cannot be allowed to break first.
story.shuiyan.intros.yujin.1.bio: Steady as Mount Tai, he trusts orders most — and admits they've gone stale last.
story.shuiyan.intros.yujin.1.quote: All camps: not one step of relocation without written order.
story.shuiyan.loss.clue: Historian's note · Flood pressure lowers formations; it does not seal the retreat. Take the high ground first. On a rerun, upgrade your Read.
story.shuiyan.loss.text: The rain came at last, and you mistook rising water for victory already won. Yu Jin withdrew up the high ground in good order; the Seven Armies were soaked but unbroken — and Guan Yu's tower ships ran aground in the very channel he had prepared.
story.shuiyan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read the retreat; note the old channel
story.shuiyan.map.0.choices.0.text: Leave the old channel open; feign weakness, don't seal it
story.shuiyan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Yu Jin opens with -200 supplies; note the sunken stakes
story.shuiyan.map.0.choices.1.text: Sink stakes to close the high-ground ford
story.shuiyan.map.0.lines.0.text: Break the dikes, and my men take the high ground. Settle into a long siege, and Fancheng calls for aid first. However hard it rains, it cannot give orders for me.
story.shuiyan.map.0.lines.1.text: What he needs most is not only the high ground, but an order that still lets him keep his dignity.
story.shuiyan.map.0.lines.2.text: Then give him a way out that looks like it doesn't require moving camp.
story.shuiyan.map.0.title: Zengkou Stream · The Water Strikes Second
story.shuiyan.objective: Store the water but do not trust it. Lock down the high ground and the retreat before the Seven Armies move camp — turn the weather into a military order.
story.shuiyan.win.hook: Yu Jin taken; Xudu shaken. But in Jiangdong Lü Meng sheds his armor for plain white robes, and Lu Xun sends a most humble letter to Jingzhou.
story.shuiyan.win.text: The banners of the Seven Armies went under one by one. When Yu Jin set down his sword, Guan Yu's first order was to send him a dry boat, not a rope. The cries of a name that shook the empire came only at night; alone, Guan Yu looked back upstream — as if he could already see the narrower, snowier road that waits beyond great fame.
story.sishui.battle.0.text: Another one chasing fame with a cup of wine. You'll lose three times before it cools.
story.sishui.battle.1.text: The wine's surface is still calm. Yunchang — what the tent hurries is the drum, not your blade.
story.sishui.battle.2.text: Guan is in no hurry. If he only swings while riding a streak, then before this cup cools, the one in a hurry will be him.
story.sishui.coldOpen.0.text: Nineteen cups sit poured in the lords' tent while Hua Xiong takes his second head outside the pass. The third cup is filled. No one rises.
story.sishui.coldOpen.1.text: This cup I pour myself. Whoever brings me Hua Xiong's head will find it still warm on his return.
story.sishui.coldOpen.2.text: Our Peach Garden oath was never a call for brothers to die in my place. Keep the cup — Guan will come back to drink it himself.
story.sishui.coldOpen.3.text: Second Brother, I'll beat the drum for you. And if you don't come back, I'll never drink again, no matter how warm they pour it!
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.0.bio: He remembers the cup that never cooled last time — and remembers better who was in no hurry.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.0.quote: Pouring again? This time I'll cool it before the feast begins.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.1.bio: The streak has convinced him every challenger will be in more of a hurry than the last.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.1.quote: The wine is at the perfect warmth. So is your head.
story.sishui.loss.clue: Lesson · The warm wine was never a demand for a fast win; it was faith that you would come back. Hua Xiong's streaks goad you into swinging first. Make him do the hurrying — on restart he begins with -1 morale.
story.sishui.loss.text: The wine has gone stone cold, and no one in the tent speaks of a second cup. You did not lose to Hua Xiong's quick blade — you misheard 'come back and drink' as 'win this instant.'
story.sishui.map.0.choices.0.detail: Hua Xiong starts with -1 morale; remember the promise of that cup
story.sishui.map.0.choices.0.text: Leave the wine in the tent; make no bold vow
story.sishui.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reads improved this round; remember where he looks back
story.sishui.map.0.choices.1.text: First watch how Hua Xiong reins his horse around
story.sishui.map.0.lines.0.text: The whole tent is counting Hua Xiong's kills. Yunchang alone is watching where he turns to look after each one.
story.sishui.map.0.lines.1.text: He counts on the next streak to break the lords' nerve. If I refuse to do his hurrying for him, the hurry becomes his.
story.sishui.map.0.title: Sishui · A Cup for a Token
story.sishui.objective: Amid the lords' contempt and Hua Xiong's streak, win Guan Yu a cup still warm and a chance to ride out.
story.sishui.win.hook: Hua Xiong is driven back, and the gates of Hulao swing open. Lü Bu has one question: the one who kept the wine warm — dare he come again?
story.sishui.win.text: Guan Yu returns the cup to Cao Cao's hand, the wine still warm at the surface. Liu Bei unclasps his dust-caked cloak; Zhang Fei's drum falls silent only now. Cao Cao looks at you instead: 'The whole tent was in a hurry just now. Only you were willing to wait for him.'
story.taoyuan.battle.0.text: I charge first! Don't lag behind and give the Scarves a laugh!
story.taoyuan.battle.1.text: Yide presses the line while Xuande shields the volunteers. Don't let all three push forward and hand the enemy your backs.
story.taoyuan.battle.2.text: Yide, come back! You swore someone would catch the fallen — the oath is not only for others to keep.
story.taoyuan.battle.3.text: Don't stare at the fallen banner. First see who still waits with a hand out.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.0.text: In Zhuo Commandery, peach blossoms drift onto the posted notice; rain bleeds the characters 'Yellow Scarf' into each other. Three hands reach to tear it down at once, fingertips meeting.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.1.text: Bei has nothing but straw sandals and hot blood. If you two would walk this road, lend your lives to the villagers first.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.2.text: I've got wine, I've got a spear, and I've never feared staking my life! But if we lose — who buries us?
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.3.text: So today we do not pledge to win together. We pledge one thing only: whoever falls back, the other two bring him home.
story.taoyuan.loss.clue: Lesson · Rescue is not all three shoving all-in together: one presses the line, one holds the way back. Restart with +150 war chest; leave your partner a retreat first.
story.taoyuan.loss.text: The wine is still warm, but the three of you are pinned in three separate places. You finally understand: if 'living and dying together' only means charging at the same time, it is just three lonely battles that never see each other.
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Enemy starts with -1 morale; remember the pact of rescue
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.0.text: Write 'we bring each other back' into the oath
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reads improved this round; remember the volunteers' retreat
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.1.text: First teach the volunteers to read the way out
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.0.text: We swear brotherhood and don't drink first? I'm not even afraid of which hill they'll bury me on!
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.1.text: Not fearing death is the easy part. The hard part is watching a brother lose, and setting down your own hard-won name to go fetch him.
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.2.text: Then this clause comes before 'same year, same month.' Only those who come back march together again.
story.taoyuan.map.0.title: Peach Grove · Terms of Retreat First
story.taoyuan.objective: Shield the village volunteers from the Yellow Scarves — and let three strangers' oath survive its first defeat.
story.taoyuan.win.hook: The Peach Garden wine has not worn off, and the lords are already swearing pacts at Suanzao. The next cup must be kept warm in front of a man named Hua Xiong.
story.taoyuan.win.text: Peach petals settle in three bowls. Liu Bei pushes a fourth toward you — without asking you to call him brother. 'Today you saw how we began. If someday one of us is lost, remember for us the way back.'
story.tianshui.battle.0.text: The Chancellor's decoys—I have already unraveled them once. Are you the second round?
story.tianshui.battle.1.text: Boy, your spear is fast. But what you guard is Ma Zun's city, not your own heart.
story.tianshui.battle.2.text: He deployed by the old draft, and you locked him in with that same old draft. The youth stared at the formation map and suddenly realized that what he knew by heart was the Shu camp's own playbook.
story.tianshui.battle.3.text: Boyue, Liang will not take your city. Liang only wants to ask you one thing: would you want a realm that could use your art of war?
story.tianshui.coldOpen.0.text: At the first march from Qishan, three commanderies answered. Zhuge Liang himself set an ambush at Tianshui, only to see a youth on the wall deploy by the map and unmask the Chancellor's decoys one by one.
story.tianshui.coldOpen.1.text: Since Changban I have met no rival. Yet today beneath the walls of Tianshui, this boy's spear actually forced me to rein my horse and turn back.
story.tianshui.coldOpen.2.text: Do not blame me, old general. I have read the Chancellor's art of war since childhood; today I merely returned it, unchanged, on behalf of the brothers defending the city.
story.tianshui.coldOpen.3.text: Zilong has been cautious all his life. Anyone who can make him rein his horse and turn back—Liang must go meet him in person.
story.tianshui.coldOpen.4.text: Chancellor, Xing wishes to ride with you! They say he is of my generation—this blade of mine wants to meet him too.
story.tianshui.intros.jiangwei.0.bio: He remembers how you stripped away his opening moves, step by step. This time he has pitched his formation on the road you will take.
story.tianshui.intros.jiangwei.0.quote: Again? This time, the first move is mine.
story.tianshui.intros.jiangwei.1.bio: A young commandery clerk between Jicheng and Tianshui; his art of war was stolen, his loyalty his own.
story.tianshui.intros.jiangwei.1.quote: Jiang Wei is here. The Chancellor's schemes—I can match them.
story.tianshui.loss.clue: Lesson · Jiang Wei wins by the first move, not by numbers. On a replay, send the letter first, then set your trap; let him come to you—don't chase him.
story.tianshui.loss.text: You pressed to win him over, and the youth turned your scheme against you. As the gates of Tianshui closed, he stood on the wall and said softly: "The Chancellor's talent—I admire it. But my spear comes out only to defend the land."
story.tianshui.map.0.choices.0.detail: This round, insight increases; remember the mirrored board
story.tianshui.map.0.choices.0.text: Turn the Chancellor's old draft against him
story.tianshui.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +120, Jiang Wei starts with morale -1
story.tianshui.map.0.choices.1.text: Send the Chancellor's handwritten letter to the front
story.tianshui.map.0.lines.0.text: Liang sets decoys, and he sees through them; Liang shifts the supply road, and he guards it. This boy wages war as if he had read Liang's old drafts first.
story.tianshui.map.0.lines.1.text: Chancellor, why bother? Let Wenchang take one army and seize Jicheng by night—the man will fall into our hands!
story.tianshui.map.0.lines.2.text: What's General Wei rushing for! What the Chancellor wants isn't the city, it's the man. My father always said: what you grab won't submit; what you invite will be true.
story.tianshui.map.0.lines.3.text: Right now he is defending the commandery governor's orders. To win him, first let him discover what he truly wants to defend.
story.tianshui.map.0.title: Tianshui · He Is Reading You
story.tianshui.objective: See through every opening move of the young man from Jicheng, and invite the north campaign's greatest surprise into the Shu camp.
story.tianshui.win.hook: With Jiang Wei won, the banners of the north campaign press harder. But the name Jieting has already begun to glow coldly on the war map.
story.tianshui.win.text: On the day Jicheng opened its gates, Jiang Wei rode out alone to surrender. Without removing his armor, he first bowed deeply to the Shu camp. Zhuge Liang stepped down from his carriage and steadied him: "All my life I have studied—today I have an heir." Zhao Yun stood by, hand on his spear, and smiled. From then on, every roll call of the north campaign bore one more young name—a name that had read every old draft of the Chancellor.
story.tielongshan.battle.0.text: Jiang Wei, you can ring the mountain, but you cannot ring the sky. In three days your defeat will report itself.
story.tielongshan.battle.1.text: The Qiang tents have answered this old man. General Jiang—is there still anyone standing at your back?
story.tielongshan.battle.2.text: The Qiang road is still in my hands! General, storm the mountain as you please—no Qiang will cross Zhang Yi's line!
story.tielongshan.battle.3.text: Chancellor, I am one step short again… No—the step I lack, I will walk myself!
story.tielongshan.coldOpen.0.text: Jiang Wei drew up his lines with a river at his back and shattered the Wei army at the Tao, pinning Sima Zhao on Iron Cage Mountain. There is no water on the mountain—but the men below brought the fire of the Qiang tribes.
story.tielongshan.coldOpen.1.text: Sima Zhao is trapped on a waterless mountain and must surrender within three days. Jiang Wei worries about only one thing—Guo Huai's relief force will come by the Qiang road.
story.tielongshan.coldOpen.2.text: We dug three zhang on the mountain and found no spring… My father always said, in a siege, count the helping hands first. Guo Boji, will you come?
story.tielongshan.coldOpen.3.text: The Qiang waver, and both Wei and Shu use them. This old man need not break Jiang Wei—only send the Qiang fire burning back into his own camp.
story.tielongshan.coldOpen.4.text: Boyue! Three years since Xiahou Ba came over to Shu, and only today do I learn: every inch of Longyou is an old acquaintance.
story.tielongshan.intros.guohuai.0.bio: The old rival of Dingjun Mountain still remembers your hill—this time he has hidden his relief force inside the Qiang tents.
story.tielongshan.intros.guohuai.0.quote: Last time you took the high ground. This time, I've borrowed the wind.
story.tielongshan.intros.guohuai.1.bio: Thirty years in Guanzhong, and he knows the word "borrow" best of all—borrow the Qiang, borrow the water, borrow your patience for the siege.
story.tielongshan.intros.guohuai.1.quote: Guo Huai will not fight your ring. I will only take it apart.
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.0.bio: The rain at Shangfang Valley saved him once, and ever since he has believed that a trap carries Heaven's will in it.
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.0.quot: Trap me again? The rain came last time. It will come this time too.
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.1.bio: He has tasted being surrounded, and this time on the mountain his calm is uncanny.
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.1.quot: Bottle me up three days? I can wait. Can you?
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.2.bio: The besieged second son shows no panic—because his calm is itself a feint.
story.tielongshan.intros.simazhao.2.quot: General Jiang, the wind is high on the mountain. Your grain—it scatters in the wind.
story.tielongshan.loss.clue: Lesson · Guo Huai wins by borrowing outside force, not by the edge of his blade. On a fresh run, settle the Qiang before you storm the mountain; your ring will always lose to the roads beyond it.
story.tielongshan.loss.text: The Qiang fire rose at your back, and on Iron Cage Mountain Sima Zhao laughed in the rain. As Jiang Wei led his men back to Jiange, he looked once over his shoulder at that mountain—a siege is a hand of cards, and at last he believed it.
story.tielongshan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read-the-tell gain this run; remember the key to the Qiang road
story.tielongshan.map.0.choices.0.text: Secure the Qiang first, cut off Guo Huai's relief
story.tielongshan.map.0.choices.1.text: Strike fast while they thirst, take the mountain camp first
story.tielongshan.map.0.lines.0.text: Boyue, the Qiang and the Wei have been trading glances for three days now. Zhongquan has watched the affairs of Yongzhou half his life—they answer only to grain, not to banners.
story.tielongshan.map.0.lines.1.text: Jiang Wei has staked everything on one battle with a river at his back; there is no road of retreat. If the Qiang turn to Guo Huai, the whole way of the siege—above and below the mountain—will change.
story.tielongshan.map.0.lines.2.text: General, let Zhang Yi take one force and choke the Qiang road. My rank is low, but this move cannot be off by an inch.
story.tielongshan.map.0.lines.3.text: The man who rings a mountain fears two things: the water on it, and the roads off it. He has not found the water. The roads are still in your hand.
story.tielongshan.map.0.title: The Tao · The Qiang Road
story.tielongshan.objective: Whoever rings Iron Cage Mountain must first outplay the man who comes to break the ring—hold Longyou for Jiang Wei, this one move of the chessboard.
story.tielongshan.win.hook: The beacon smoke of Longyou has not died, and already a call to arms has reached Luoyang from Huainan—three years running, three fires of the same name have caught on Wei soil.
story.tielongshan.win.text: The Qiang road held, and Guo Huai's word "borrow" came to nothing. On Iron Cage Mountain, Sima Zhao drank the last waterskin dry, then looked down at the Shu camps standing utterly still below and, for the first time, sued for peace and withdrew on his own. Jiang Wei did not pursue—the great victory at the Tao opened the cities of Longyou one by one, and the road north grew a little wider.
story.tongguan.battle.0.text: Cao the Deceiver! Your wall of ice stops horses — it does not stop vengeance!
story.tongguan.battle.1.text: Whelp! Know me? The Tiger Marquis stands before you this day!
story.tongguan.battle.2.text: Han Sui held the letter, his fingers resting on the ink blot. The glance Ma Chao stole at it was colder than any of Cao Cao's thousand armies.
story.tongguan.battle.3.text: Whelp, I know you do not submit. But your father's death — do you truly dare lay that whole account on me alone?
story.tongguan.coldOpen.0.text: Wind rolled sand along Tong Pass. Ma Chao's white robes paced before the lines like a banner that refuses to fall. In Cao Cao's tent, Jia Xu slowly ground ink.
story.tongguan.coldOpen.1.text: Cao the Deceiver! You murdered my father and defied heaven itself! If I don't cut you down at Tong Pass today, I am no son of Ma!
story.tongguan.coldOpen.2.text: If the whelp lives, I'll have no ground to be buried in. Gentlemen — who will block this wind for me?
story.tongguan.coldOpen.3.text: My lord, step back from the line! The Mad Tiger stands here — Ma whelp, come on!
story.tongguan.coldOpen.4.text: No alarm, my lord. The men of Xiliang are many, their hearts uneven. Wenhe's ink is slower than the Tiger's blade — and far more poisonous.
story.tongguan.intros.machao.0.bio: He remembers the night of ice and fire on the Wei River. The hate has not faded; the spear has only grown heavier.
story.tongguan.intros.machao.0.quote: Come to block me again? Ask my spear first!
story.tongguan.intros.machao.1.bio: He once set the spear down beside the fire at Jiameng. Now its point trembles, very slightly.
story.tongguan.intros.machao.1.quote: You saw me lay it down once... never speak of it!
story.tongguan.intros.machao.2.bio: Silk robes, silver spear — half a life spent demanding an answer for a dead father and uncles.
story.tongguan.intros.machao.2.quote: A father's debts fall to the son. Heaven's law. Stand aside!
story.tongguan.intros.xuchu.0.bio: The battle by the Wei taught him to remember you. This time he's wound the rope at his waist three turns tighter.
story.tongguan.intros.xuchu.0.quote: Again! I've strength left to spend!
story.tongguan.intros.xuchu.1.bio: Schemes of sowing discord mean nothing to him. He holds one truth: with his lord behind him, there is no retreat.
story.tongguan.intros.xuchu.1.quote: The whelp's spear is fast? My life is harder!
story.tongguan.loss.clue: Historian's note · Ma Chao's strength is trading rage for chips. On a rerun his false tells shrink. Wear him down with the ice wall first, then sow doubt with the ink blot.
story.tongguan.loss.text: Ma Chao's fury did not wait for your scheme of discord to ripen. Three charges of the iron cavalry, four breaches in the ice — and in the moment Cao Cao cut his beard and threw off his robe, all you saw in the chaos was the Mad Tiger's back.
story.tongguan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read gains upgraded this round; note the ice wall
story.tongguan.map.0.choices.0.text: Raise the ice fortress overnight; hold still, let them break
story.tongguan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Xiliang army opens with -1 morale; note the ink blot
story.tongguan.map.0.choices.1.text: Leave a smudged ink blot on the letter of discord
story.tongguan.map.0.lines.0.text: One night of cold wind, and the Wei grew ice-slush. Build through the night, and by dawn there's a fortress of ice — cavalry cannot charge ice.
story.tongguan.map.0.lines.1.text: An ice wall stops horses, not hatred. To break Xiliang, first break the bond between Han Sui and Ma Chao — one letter is enough.
story.tongguan.map.0.lines.2.text: Let him shove all his fury into the pot first. Then let him see the ink blot on the letter.
story.tongguan.map.0.title: South of the Wei · The Ice Fortress
story.tongguan.objective: Shield Cao Cao inside the fury of the Xiliang iron cavalry — and give Ma Chao's vengeance somewhere it can be spoken aloud.
story.tongguan.win.hook: Xiliang has scattered, but the hatred is still looking for a rider. It will wait three more years for Ma Chao, beside the fire basin at Jiameng Pass.
story.tongguan.win.text: When the wind over the southern Wei died, the Xiliang camp burned on its own — not Cao Cao's fire, but the ink blot on that letter. Ma Chao sat his horse alone before the broken lines, spear leveled at Cao Cao, and for a long time it did not fall. At last he wheeled west. Cao Cao stroked his beard and said softly: 'I did not beat him. I beat him into finally wondering whom that account is truly owed to.'
story.wancheng.battle.0.text: By day you accepted my surrender; by night you treated me as a man with nothing left to say. This spear of Zhang Xiu's is only now being delivered.
story.wancheng.battle.1.text: Did I misread Zhang Xiu, or myself? Dian Wei — let no one into the tent.
story.wancheng.battle.2.text: My lord, go! The halberds are still here. No man alive makes Dian Wei guard a door empty-handed tonight.
story.wancheng.battle.3.text: My lord, go! Ask not how much longer Dian Wei can stand — ask only whether the horses are ready.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.0.text: Wancheng's flag of surrender has barely come down, and Cao's camp is already singing deep into the night. Dian Wei sits outside the tent, halberds in his arms. Only you notice an extra pair of feet in the wall's shadow.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.1.text: I still remember that warmed cup of wine at Sishui. A pity — tonight men's hearts cooled faster than wine, and I never tasted it.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.2.text: Sleep well, my lord. Dian Wei knows nothing of cards — only this door: while I stand, my halberds stand, and so does the door.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.3.text: Must a surrendered general bow his head to earn his wine? Lord Cao — come count with me who owes whom, tonight.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.0.bio: A surrender flag can be raised a second time. A silent humiliation, once suffered, cannot be taken back.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.0.quote: This time, ask nothing of the twin halberds. Ask first whether you'll hear me to the end.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.1.bio: The Spear King of the Northlands has surrendered once already; when he strikes again, there will be no second hesitation.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.1.quote: Surrender by day, spear-song by night. Sit down, Lord Cao.
story.wancheng.loss.clue: Lesson · Zhang Xiu's resolve was written the moment he stopped looking at Cao Cao. Don't fixate on the spear point; guard the gate and the halberds first. On retry, false tells are reduced.
story.wancheng.loss.text: Only when the halberds are stolen do you understand: what Zhang Xiu waited for was not Cao Cao asleep, but Cao Cao mistaking another man's humiliation for safety. Fire still burns at the gate, and Dian Wei does not fall back again.
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; halberds and retreat guarded together
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.0.text: Stand with Dian Wei over the halberds and the horse road behind camp
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.1.detail: Zhang Xiu opens with -1 morale; remember the surrendered soldiers' hearts
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.1.text: Let the surrendered troops return to their old camps, weapons in hand
story.wancheng.map.0.lines.0.text: Hu Che'er has toasted me three bowls tonight, but his eyes keep resting on the halberds. If the weapons go, what do I guard my lord's retreat with?
story.wancheng.map.0.lines.1.text: Zhang Xiu has surrendered — so why does he sit like a man on needles? Did I mistake 'submission' for 'nothing left to say'?
story.wancheng.map.0.title: Wancheng · The Twin Halberds Hold
story.wancheng.objective: On the night Zhang Xiu's surrender turns to revolt, guard Dian Wei's twin halberds first — then keep one last line of retreat open for Cao Cao.
story.wancheng.win.hook: Wancheng's gate held, but Cao Cao has no time to grow wiser. He is already at the walls of Xiapi — and this time the one besieged is Lü Bu.
story.wancheng.win.text: The twin halberds stay in Dian Wei's hands; Zhang Xiu's fire never seals the camp gate. Cao Cao is a long way down the road before he looks back, and for the first time he does not ask how many men he lost — only, 'Is Dian Wei still at his post?' Behind him, the big man lifts a halberd in answer.
story.wuzhangyuan.battle.0.text: Send me women's clothes and I will wear them for my officers to see. Whatever can shame a grown man into fury was never what settles a battle.
story.wuzhangyuan.battle.1.text: It is not that he lacks nerve. He has counted my life among the blinds. Do not wait alongside him — make every refusal cost him supplies.
story.wuzhangyuan.battle.2.text: Chancellor, the southeastern star has not dimmed yet. Drink your medicine first; I will watch this hand with you.
story.wuzhangyuan.battle.3.text: Zhongda, the new grain is already in the granary. That autumn wind you are waiting for will be late this year, I think.
story.wuzhangyuan.battle.4.text: You want the star to burn ten years longer. I wait only for the moment it dims. We shall see who breaks first.
story.wuzhangyuan.coldOpen.0.text: At Bowang I borrowed fire; at Red Cliffs, wind. My whole life I have borrowed heaven's timing. Not this time. Win me one day, and I will live that day out to its end.
story.wuzhangyuan.coldOpen.1.text: I pulled back too fast at Xicheng. This time I will not even listen to your qin. The day your grain runs out is the day I march.
story.wuzhangyuan.coldOpen.2.text: I do not ask what ambush you have laid, nor what clever scheme. At Wuzhang Plains only one thing is compared: who runs dry first.
story.wuzhangyuan.coldOpen.3.text: Chancellor, the medicine has gone cold again. You always say you will finish this dispatch first, but the dispatches never end.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.0.bio: This time you hold the feather fan yourself, and the Tomb Tiger no longer has to guess the Crouching Dragon's face across the Shu camp.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.0.quote: Kongming. At last you are willing to sit across from me yourself.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.1.bio: Since the southeastern star brightened he knows fate itself can be won away, yet he still believes he understands attrition best.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.1.quote: Extra years are still years. I can still afford to spend them.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.2.bio: The retreat from the empty city is his old wound; now he grinds that wound into patience behind firm walls.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.2.quote: Last time I counted your city. This time I count only your grain.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.3.bio: He treats not fighting as the longest-lived bet, waiting for the autumn wind to clear the other side's chips for him.
story.wuzhangyuan.intros.simayi.3.quote: You may win every exchange. I only need to last until the final night.
story.wuzhangyuan.loss.clue: Annals · Firm walls turn blinds into blades. On replay, +150 supplies; fight for grain early, and do not race him at wasting away.
story.wuzhangyuan.loss.text: The southeastern star dimmed, and Sima Yi still had not fought. He won no hand. He simply let every "I will do it tomorrow" stretch into a blind posted in the autumn wind.
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.choices.0.detail: +200 supplies; remember the Wei riverbank fields
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.choices.0.text: Farm alongside the people and let the supply road grow itself
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Sima Yi -200 supplies; remember turning guest into host
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.choices.1.text: Send a strike force out of Xie Valley to cut Wei's supply road
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.lines.0.text: He will not give battle, so the whole army urges the Chancellor to press again. But the harder we press, the more we prove the autumn wind really stands with Wei.
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.lines.1.text: Boyue, farming the frontier is not surrender. Let the soldiers know there will be grain next year, let the people know we will not trouble them this year — then I need not borrow those extra years from the night sky.
story.wuzhangyuan.map.0.title: Wugong River · Borrow One Day from the Living
story.wuzhangyuan.objective: Force Sima Yi to answer before the grain runs out and the autumn wind turns, and bring Zhuge Liang back from the falling star that was written for him.
story.wuzhangyuan.win.hook: Fourteen years pass quickly. In Luoyang someone has begun to play sick; this time the Crouching Dragon is still here, and the old board is not yet cleared.
story.wuzhangyuan.win.text: The lamp at Wuzhang Plains did not go out. Sima Yi gave battle at last and lost the first move on the banks of the Wugong; Zhuge Liang used the gap to move army and supply road forward together. At dawn he pushed the medicine bowl aside and wrote another Petition on the March — not to borrow ten years, but to stop handing every day over to fate.
story.xianshan.battle.0.text: Sun Jian! You have chased us for two days — and the arrows have chased you for two!
story.xianshan.battle.1.text: Don't answer every drumbeat. Bamboo rattles; not everything that rattles is a man.
story.xianshan.battle.2.text: Arrow storm incoming. Watch the banner, not the man — the banner falls toward where the ambush truly is.
story.xianshan.battle.3.text: My lord, change horses! Gongfu's back can still take one more volley!
story.xianshan.coldOpen.0.text: Luoyang's embers are still warm; the Imperial Seal burns against Sun Jian's chest. On the walls of Xiangyang, Liu Biao's second arrow is already nocked.
story.xianshan.coldOpen.1.text: I fought my way from Changsha to Luoyang and never lost a battle. And Liu Jingsheng thinks one city and a few arrows will keep a Jiangdong tiger?
story.xianshan.coldOpen.2.text: My lord, the bamboo on Xian Mountain is thick — the pursuit should not go in full strength. Better to send scouts ahead; this old minister will hold the rear.
story.xianshan.coldOpen.3.text: Demou, you are over-cautious. That 'Lü Gong' is fleeing so fast his helmet sits crooked. If we don't press now, Liu Biao really will find his reinforcements!
story.xianshan.coldOpen.4.text: In the apocrypha, the tiger often dies on the very day it trusts its own claws most.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.0.bio: The fleet's escape route is set; one task remains — don't let the Cai family sink with the ship.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.0.quote: I hold the water this time. The mountain is yours, General Huang.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.1.bio: He has traded his sister's pillow-talk and his brother-in-law's command seals alike for chips.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.1.quote: Jingzhou's waters raise no tigers. General, don't waste your arrows.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.0.bio: He remembers how fast Sun Jian's blade is; this time he has buried his ambush deeper.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.0.quote: Another Sun-family tiger. Xian Mountain has arrows to spare.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.1.bio: He cannot beat Sun Jian — but he knows the man's nature. A tiger never goes around.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.1.quote: Jiangxia's arrows have waited two years for this day.
story.xianshan.loss.clue: Lesson · Huang Zu's ambush baits you into going all-in on 'chaos.' When the bamboo rattles, look at the banners first. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.xianshan.loss.text: The instant the arrows find you among the bamboo, you see how orderly that 'rout' really was. The tiger died in the pursuit — and Jiangdong must wait for a boy to catch the falling name.
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; note the doubt in the bamboo shadows
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.0.text: Send Han Dang to scout the bamboo first; advance slowly
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +100; enemy opens with -1 morale
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.1.text: Ride with the tiger and punch straight through the bamboo
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.0.text: Movement in the bamboo — too many to count. Let me take the volunteers in first, my lord; you hold back.
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.1.text: I hear you, Yigong. But if I hold back, every man behind me will move half a beat slower on my behalf.
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.2.text: A tiger's courage is at the front of the line. A tiger's way out is usually in that one glance over the shoulder.
story.xianshan.map.0.title: Deng Sai · Shadows in the Bamboo
story.xianshan.objective: In the bamboo shadows of Xian Mountain, read that arrow for Sun Jian — keep the fire of Jiangdong from dying at the first stroke.
story.xianshan.win.hook: The tiger lives, and Jiangdong's story finds its next name — the white horses of Jieqiao are already galloping toward Youzhou.
story.xianshan.win.text: Arrow after arrow finds only bamboo. Pinned under his horse, Huang Zu is still shouting 'impossible.' Sun Jian does not kill him — he snaps two of his arrows instead: 'Go tell Liu Jingsheng I'll be knocking on Xiangyang's gate myself next year.' That is how the fire of Jiangdong crossed Xian Mountain.
story.xiaoyaojin.battle.0.text: Zhang Liao is here! Hear me, Wu men: today I take the loosest point in your line, and nothing else!
story.xiaoyaojin.battle.1.text: Eight hundred men drove into the Wu lines like an awl. Where they passed, the banners of a hundred thousand went down by themselves.
story.xiaoyaojin.battle.2.text: The lord is over the bridge! Of the three hundred... a few dozen left. Enough. Enough to hold one more turn!
story.xiaoyaojin.battle.3.text: Gongji, come back! Ling Tong, come back! Jiangdong cannot be bought with your lives, one by one!
story.xiaoyaojin.coldOpen.0.text: On the wall of Hefei, Zhang Liao drew up eight hundred men who had come to die. Not a drop of water stood on their armor; they had waited all night. Outside, a hundred thousand Wu troops had just finished striking camp.
story.xiaoyaojin.coldOpen.1.text: The Wu men have just arrived and their lines are not set. Right now eight hundred can do the work of eighty thousand. With me. Charge!
story.xiaoyaojin.coldOpen.2.text: Zhang Liao? How dare he come out of the gate! Steady, all camps, hold. Gan Ning, Ling Tong, cover the flanks!
story.xiaoyaojin.coldOpen.3.text: My lord, go first! The Ling family's three hundred can still hold them a while!
story.xiaoyaojin.coldOpen.4.text: Gongji! Do not play the hero! Your three hundred are not coin to buy our lord one march!
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.lejin.0.bio: He holds Hefei with Zhang Liao and Li Dian; the three agree to their faces, and each keeps his edge to himself.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.lejin.0.quote: General Zhang breaks the front, Yue holds the rear. The gate of Hefei opens, and does not close behind you.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.lidian.0.bio: When he urged Zhang Liao to break the enemy's spirit first, there was no private grudge in it. In laying out a line he values one thing above all: room to spare.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.lidian.0.quote: Li Mancheng will not match you in savagery. I only close the road you meant to leave by.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.zhangliao.0.bio: He remembers how you steadied your lines mid-crossing. This time he moved his charge half a beat earlier.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.zhangliao.0.quot: Steady your lines again? My blade will not give you time to dress ranks.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.zhangliao.1.bio: The nerve of eight hundred men is something he fed them, night after night.
story.xiaoyaojin.intros.zhangliao.1.quot: Ten years Zhang Liao has waited for one charge like today's!
story.xiaoyaojin.loss.clue: Lesson · Zhang Liao wins by the disorder, not by numbers. On a new run, form up before you cross; if he cannot break you, he will not dare leave the gate alone.
story.xiaoyaojin.loss.text: A hundred thousand in order could not stop eight hundred with nerve. The bridge went down, Ling Tong's three hundred stayed on the far bank, and Zhang Liao's name has lived in the crying of Jiangdong children ever since.
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.choices.0.detail: Tell reading up this round; remember the crossing in order
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.choices.0.text: Form the hundred thousand up before they cross
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +100; Zhang Liao's troops start at -1 morale
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.choices.1.text: Take the rearguard yourself so the lord crosses first
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.lines.0.text: My lord, two planks of the ford bridge have rotted; a horse cannot gallop it. Youping will carry you across first!
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.lines.1.text: Youping, get the lord out! I hold Zhang Liao!
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.lines.2.text: What Zhang Liao wants is not Sun Quan's head. It is four words: the Wu army breaks itself. Do not lose the heart of a hundred thousand to the nerve of eight hundred.
story.xiaoyaojin.map.0.title: Xiaoyao Ford · The Bridge at Mid-Crossing
story.xiaoyaojin.objective: At the narrow bridge over Xiaoyao Ford, keep Zhang Liao's eight hundred from breaking ten thousand apart, and bring Ling Tong's rearguard home.
story.xiaoyaojin.win.hook: Xiaoyao Ford taught Jiangdong to look home to Jingzhou. And Liu Bei's drums in Hanzhong had already reached the foot of Dingjun Mountain.
story.xiaoyaojin.win.text: The moment the ford bridge was mended, the hundred thousand found their order. Zhang Liao watched from the wall and sheathed his blade. 'The Wu men can hold steady now. This city does not sally again.' Ling Tong came onto the planks covered in blood, and Sun Quan dismounted to hold him up. There was no laughter on the road back to Jianye, only one line from Sun Quan: 'I will remember Hefei. I will remember Zhang Wenyuan.'
story.yanglu.battle.0.text: General Lu, another battle spared today. Hu has brewed new tea—from Jiangling; you can tell the difference.
story.yanglu.battle.1.text: Xiling has fallen. Bu Chan's head—Kang delivered it to Jianye himself. Lord Jin's abacus has lost a key bead.
story.yanglu.battle.2.text: Tea should be drunk hot, a city waits until ripe. General, Hu can wait—can you wait for Jianye?
story.yanglu.battle.3.text: You held off an undefeated foe in the field, yet you are besieged from within. Lord Yang… you were never surrounding me. You were surrounding my court, weren't you?
story.yanglu.coldOpen.0.text: On the Jingzhou border, two armies faced each other for two years without a battle. When Wu hunters' game fled into Jin territory, Yang Hu always sent it back; when Lu Kang fell ill, Yang Hu sent medicine, and Lu Kang took it openly.
story.yanglu.coldOpen.1.text: General Lu, Hu does not deceive men in mourning, nor generals who are ill. The medicine is here, and my trust is here too.
story.yanglu.coldOpen.2.text: Lord Yang sends medicine—how could Kang doubt it? But Kang has a question: when you hunt cities with trust, do you hunt Wu's land, or Wu's heart?
story.yanglu.coldOpen.3.text: Edicts from Jianye are more urgent than soldiers from Xiangyang. They want Kang to fight; Kang would rather hold out one more year.
story.yanglu.coldOpen.4.text: Beneath Xiling, Bu Chan surrendered the city to Jin. Lu Kang's siege now surrounded a rebel city of his own.
story.yanglu.intros.yanghu.0.bio: He read your battle plans twice and still only tightened the hunting net by one inch.
story.yanglu.intros.yanghu.0.quote: What's the rush? Hu's net closes one inch a year.
story.yanglu.intros.yanghu.1.bio: A famed general in light furs and loose belts, who uses trust as bait and virtue as hook.
story.yanglu.intros.yanghu.1.quote: Hu will not fight you blade to blade. Hu only waits for hearts to cross the river on their own.
story.yanglu.loss.clue: Lesson · Yang Hu's blade is good faith; a hasty assault strikes exactly where he wants it. Begin again by securing Xiling first, then honoring his terms; he can afford to lose time, but you cannot afford to lose hearts.
story.yanglu.loss.text: At last the edict urging battle from Jianye outweighed the letters at the frontier. On the day your army marched, the people by the river pointed to the Jin camp and said: "By Lord Yang's virtue, not a stalk of our grain has been taken." The battle had not yet begun, yet the hearts beyond the walls had already crossed the river.
story.yanglu.map.0.choices.0.detail: Jin army starts with -200 war chest; remember to settle inside first
story.yanglu.map.0.choices.0.text: Take Xiling first, then discuss the border
story.yanglu.map.0.choices.1.detail: This replay: Tell detection up; remember two years of trust
story.yanglu.map.0.choices.1.text: Keep the pact with Lord Yang; open no border quarrel
story.yanglu.map.0.lines.0.text: Every time Hu gives battle, he sets a date and arrays his troops openly—no ambush, no raid. Some call Hu foolish—they do not understand this is the fastest blade.
story.yanglu.map.0.lines.1.text: Lord Yang treats me with trust, and Kang returns it in kind. But with Xiling in revolt, the trust between our borders will be tested by fire.
story.yanglu.map.0.lines.2.text: His way of winning is 'not fighting.' If you rush to battle, you will send hearts across the river for him.
story.yanglu.map.0.title: Xiangyang · Each Keeps His Ground
story.yanglu.objective: Face Yang Hu across the border for two years and win 'the war that is not fought'—preserve Wu's last general, and its last trust.
story.yanglu.win.hook: After Yang and Lu, no great commander remained to hold the line. The tower ships of Yizhou have already been launched; the iron chains of Jianye are rusting through, inch by inch.
story.yanglu.win.text: Xiling is settled, and the border envoys remain unbroken. As Yang Hu lay dying he petitioned the throne to march on Wu, handing Du Yu the whole of his life's preparation together with the reek of medicine that clung to his breast; Lu Kang also fell ill and died that same year, and the people of Wu raised a stele for him, on which no word of defeat is carved. The two steles face each other across the river—and you have won this page: two names, and neither one yielded to the other.
story.yiling.battle.0.text: The harder you push, the less I need to. What you are staking is not your war chest. It is how many more days the Shu camps can bear it.
story.yiling.battle.1.text: If I give one step here, do I fail the men who came into Shu with me, and then marched east with me?
story.yiling.battle.2.text: Elder brother, my life is still my own. Stop feeding other men's lives to my ghost.
story.yiling.battle.3.text: The dead do not come back because a few more join them. Look at the oil first, then at your revenge.
story.yiling.battle.4.text: You finally look outside your camps. A pity that once the fire is up, even a clear order arrives one beat late.
story.yiling.coldOpen.0.text: The leaves at Xiaoting are so thick no wind gets through. Every camp touches the next, as if someone had laid seven hundred li of grievance out as one fuse.
story.yiling.coldOpen.1.text: The life at Maicheng: you took it back for me. If you march east again today, stop using me as the reason.
story.yiling.coldOpen.2.text: When Yunchang's head reached Luoyang I did not weep. Now every camp has men calling his name, and I can no longer turn back.
story.yiling.coldOpen.3.text: Your Majesty, the river fleet should lead, straight down the water. Abandon the boats for dry ground, and seven hundred li of lives go into the woods, into the hands of the Omen.
story.yiling.coldOpen.4.text: Shamoke, king of the Five Streams, has arrived, and Ma Liang has checked the Yiling road map again. Your Majesty, all that is missing is your word: move camp.
story.yiling.coldOpen.5.text: The Han emperor stands behind us. In this fight, the king's mace knows nothing of Wu water!
story.yiling.coldOpen.6.text: I am not afraid of Lord Liu's anger. The angrier he is, the more carefully he stacks woods, linked camps and hearts into one pile of kindling, with his own hands.
story.yiling.intros.luxun.0.bio: Jingzhou stands, and he still holds Jiangdong. This war is no longer only vengeance, and can still be ruined by temper.
story.yiling.intros.luxun.0.quote: General Guan still lives. This war should not be about one breath of spite.
story.yiling.intros.luxun.1.bio: He keeps the fire of youth inside a scholar's sleeve, waiting for Liu Bei to link his own chances into a fuse.
story.yiling.intros.luxun.1.quote: Your lord wants revenge. I want Jiangdong. Where should the fire fall?
story.yiling.loss.clue: Lesson · Lu Xun holds still to raise the blinds, then bets on your haste. On a new run false tells are fewer: break the linked camps first.
story.yiling.loss.text: The fire ran the camps faster than any order could. Covering Liu Bei's retreat to Baidi, you understood at last that Lu Xun had never waited for an east wind. He waited for the night your anger would not let you change a thing.
story.yiling.map.0.choices.0.detail: Tell reading up this round; remember the plan to move camp
story.yiling.map.0.choices.0.text: Leave the woods for high ground and break the camps apart
story.yiling.map.0.choices.1.detail: Lu Xun's war chest -200; remember where the oil lies
story.yiling.map.0.choices.1.text: Raid the Wu fire-oil train by night
story.yiling.map.0.lines.0.text: The men went into the woods to escape the heat, on my order. Move camp today and they will think I fear Lu Xun.
story.yiling.map.0.lines.1.text: Your Majesty, Lu Xun holding still is not fear. He is waiting for us to stack our own camps into kindling. One lone camp can be given up. Seven hundred li of hearts cannot.
story.yiling.map.0.title: Xiaoting · Move Camp Before the Fire
story.yiling.objective: Break up seven hundred li of linked camps, and before Lu Xun strikes the flame, let Liu Bei see how many lives lie outside his vengeance.
story.yiling.win.hook: Yiling did not burn to ash, but Liu Bei fell at Yong'an Palace. On the next page, the opponent has no name at all.
story.yiling.win.text: When the first fire arrow fell, the old camps were empty. Lu Xun watched the scattered high ramparts from across the river and put away the slow match he had never lit. Liu Bei did not pursue. He had the camps counted, one by one, by the names of the men going home.
story.yinping.battle.0.text: Th-there is no grain behind me and no road under my feet. Where do you think I can retreat to, except forward?
story.yinping.battle.1.text: Do not chase his command banner. The man in the felt is him, and the slowest baggage train is where the whole army's survival is hidden.
story.yinping.battle.2.text: High ground is no advantage; holding water and a way back is. Let Zhan take this lesson at Mianzhu on my father's behalf.
story.yinping.battle.3.text: Deng Zhong! The names of my father and my grandfather stand here — my spear is faster than yours!
story.yinping.battle.4.text: I have already crossed the mountains. D-do you think a few piles of rock can hold me?
story.yinping.coldOpen.0.text: There is no road through Yinping, only animal tracks washed thin by rain. Deng Ai had his men wrapped in felt and rolled down the cliffs, and rolled his own life into that old felt with them.
story.yinping.coldOpen.1.text: Th-they all say there is no road through Yinping. No road is exactly why no one stops me.
story.yinping.coldOpen.2.text: F-Father, Zhong will go down first and scout. If Mianzhu breaks, Chengdu surrenders without a fight — let your son wade this stretch for you.
story.yinping.coldOpen.3.text: While my father lived he often sighed that we were born into comfort. Today Mianzhu is at my back, Chengdu's granaries stand a year deep, and Zhan has nowhere left to retreat.
story.yinping.coldOpen.4.text: Grandfather, father — the names of three generations rest on today. Shang asks to be first up the wall!
story.yinping.coldOpen.5.text: Tazhong cannot be lost, and neither can Chengdu. What I fear is not fighting on two fronts, but every post assuming another post has men.
story.yinping.intros.dengai.0.bio: Yinping once threw him against a waiting ambush, yet he believes all the more that even a dead end holds a second animal track.
story.yinping.intros.dengai.0.quote: Th-this time I come down somewhere else. Will you still be waiting?
story.yinping.intros.dengai.1.bio: He stammers when he speaks and never hesitates when he acts; every impossibility on other men's lips is his reason to push the whole stack in.
story.yinping.intros.dengai.1.quote: A m-mountain does not make way. But a man can go around one.
story.yinping.intros.dengzhong.0.bio: His first battle at Mianzhu gave him a taste of blood; this time he pushes his father's risky move one square further.
story.yinping.intros.dengzhong.0.quote: Wh-what my father taught me, I will teach you.
story.yinping.intros.dengzhong.1.bio: A boy under a tiger of a father, eager to prove the name Deng does not belong only to the older generation.
story.yinping.intros.dengzhong.1.quote: Show some respect before my father!
story.yinping.loss.clue: Annals · Deng Ai keeps pushing with a lone army, and falling back only saves him grain. On replay the enemy opens at -200 supplies; get ahead of him and smother the landing.
story.yinping.loss.text: When Deng Ai reached the bottom, all he had behind him was a layer of felt worn through. Jiangyou opened its gates not because no brave men stood inside, but because every man there had counted Yinping's one word, impossible, as a garrison.
story.yinping.map.0.choices.0.detail: Read bonus this round; remember the lamps on the cliff
story.yinping.map.0.choices.0.text: Set three beacon posts in sight of one another, per the old note
story.yinping.map.0.choices.1.detail: Deng Ai -200 supplies; remember the empty granary ruse
story.yinping.map.0.choices.1.text: Move the Jiangyou supply road and leave empty granaries as bait
story.yinping.map.0.lines.0.text: The old note holds a single line: Yinping is no road; the guard at Jiangyou must not be withdrawn. Everyone called it overcaution then. Now that page weighs more than the cliff stone.
story.yinping.map.0.lines.1.text: Holding the posts is not enough; you must hold the echo between them. Otherwise one lamp goes out and a hundred li still believes it can see.
story.yinping.map.0.lines.2.text: I have read my father's old note three times: "Yinping is no road; the guard at Jiangyou must not be withdrawn." The posts must be placed where they can see one another.
story.yinping.map.0.title: Yinping · Light the Lamp Where No One Stands
story.yinping.objective: Set two answers between Motian Ridge and Mianzhu, so Deng Ai's lone army has nowhere to land — and the Zhuge father and son need not buy their names with death.
story.yinping.win.hook: Shu held, but the tide-sound at Jianye was already fading. The old history has one line left: the three parts return to Jin.
story.yinping.win.text: A lamp appeared on Motian Ridge first, then the rolling logs. When Deng Ai looked up, the empty granaries at Jiangyou had already been locked; the impossible road he bought with lives had become a dead end. Jiang Wei put the old note away and held no victory feast — he only went first to top up the oil at the three beacon posts.
story.yuanshemen.battle.0.text: Never mind the trick shot. If I win this hand — do you dare let Xuande fight his way out of the city too?
story.yuanshemen.battle.1.text: If I miss, I'll honor your terms. But if all you want is to see me embarrassed, you've misread this hand.
story.yuanshemen.battle.2.text: General Ji — what you must win today is not your orders, but the ability to face your soldiers again once you return.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.0.text: Outside the camp gate, a halberd's small branch waits to be hit; inside it sit two armies one word away from slaughter. Lü Bu sets his bow on the table and asks you to deal first.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.1.text: At Hulao you said I only knew how to press forward. Today both houses are watching — watch me make them withdraw with a single arrow.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.2.text: Ji Ling, hear my order: take Xiaopei, or never show your face in Huainan again! My imperial seal deserves the empire, not a favor to Lü Bu.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.3.text: I ride under my lord's orders; one arrow will not turn me back. Unless every man at this table agrees the arrow is worth the wager.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.4.text: Bei will not spend the lives of Xiaopei's people to prove anyone's marksmanship.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.0.bio: He still refuses to accept that arrow, but he has begun, seriously, to weigh the other life hanging on it.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.0.quote: We can wager again. First, state both houses' terms — word for word, no changes.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.1.bio: His trident rides on a military order; he cannot retreat looking like a man frightened off by a trick shot.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.1.quote: General Lü has his godly archery. I have my orders.
story.yuanshemen.loss.clue: Lesson · Brokering peace isn't offending neither side; it's making both sides accept the same stake first. Don't overpromise before the arrow flies. On retry, false tells are reduced.
story.yuanshemen.loss.text: Before the arrow even leaves the string, Ji Ling and Liu Bei are both on their feet. You were busy guaranteeing the hit for Lü Bu — and forgot to ask whether the other two would stake an army order and a city's people on the same sentence.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the shared stake
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.0.text: State first what happens if the arrow misses
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.1.detail: Ji Ling opens with -1 morale; remember the courtesy of the shared table
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.1.text: Seat Xuande and Ji Ling on the same side
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.0.text: One arrow and my brother's off the hook? If he misses, I'll snap that bow over his head first!
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.1.text: So the hard part isn't the hit. It's making both houses honor the ledger even if he misses.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.2.text: Then spell out what happens on a miss as well. I don't lean on another man's confidence today.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.title: The Camp Gate · One Shared Stake
story.yuanshemen.objective: Keep a line of retreat open for both Ji Ling and Liu Bei — and force Lü Bu to prove that arrow is not just another brand of arrogance.
story.yuanshemen.win.hook: The camp gate saved Xiaopei, but not Lü Bu's own Xiapi; and Cao Cao, out of Xuchang, has already set out for Wancheng.
story.yuanshemen.win.text: As the arrow flies, Ji Ling watches Liu Bei, not the branch. Only when Liu Bei slides his blade a discreet inch away does Ji Ling finally stand down. Lü Bu laughs — only you see the sweat on his palm. If that arrow were mere marksmanship, it would have saved no one.
story.zhujiu.battle.0.text: Cards are like men. Look first; don't be quick to claim them.
story.zhujiu.battle.1.text: The heroes of the age — tell me, whom do you think I will name first?
story.zhujiu.battle.2.text: The thunder is coming. You should drop your chopsticks now.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.0.text: On White Gate Tower you chose a road for him to live by. Over today's cup, I want to know what you chose for yourself.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.1.text: If he brings up Fengxian, don't rush to answer. First listen to how many heroes he counts before he reaches the world.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.2.text: Since White Gate Tower, Xuande has grown more careful. Careful men make the best drinking companions.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.3.text: Green plums over a small cup; a clap of thunder in the distance. Suddenly you understand: not one question at this table is about the world.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.0.bio: He remembers every choice made at White Gate Tower — above all, who you let live.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.0.quote: Fengxian lives; Xuande sits at this table. The heroes of today number more than two, I fear.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.1.bio: Over wine and green plums, he treats every man's ambition as a hole card waiting to be flipped.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.1.quote: Don't fear the thunder. Fear my next sentence.
story.zhujiu.loss.clue: Lesson · Cao Cao starts reading your bets from the second hand on. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.zhujiu.loss.text: You answered 'who are the heroes' — and missed his real question: 'will you be my enemy?' The wine held no poison; the words closed in around you all the same.
story.zhujiu.map.0.choices.0.text: Hide your face behind the thunder
story.zhujiu.map.0.choices.1.text: Ask him, instead, what he feared most at White Gate Tower
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.0.text: When he names you a hero, mere modesty tells him you understood. You must do better than that.
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.1.text: Then I should play the fool?
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.2.text: No. Let him believe cards are the only thing you understand.
story.zhujiu.map.0.title: The Plum Pavilion · Answered Before Asked
story.zhujiu.objective: Hide your own answer — and hear clearly the one sentence Cao Cao never says.
story.zhujiu.win.hook: Guan Yu is about to seal the seal and hang up the gold. In the game at Xuchang, Cao Cao has learned how well you can hide your edge.
story.zhujiu.win.text: The chopsticks fall; the thunder stops. Cao Cao smiles and pours your wine himself, and does not ask a second time. Liu Bei knows that for one instant, all three of you saw each other's hole cards.
story.zuizhong.battle.0.text: That star over the Wuzhang Plains still burns. You think saving Kongming was the answer? All it did was give Zhongda one man he cannot beat by waiting.
story.zuizhong.battle.1.text: I kept the autumn wind of Wuzhang Plains for you. You can beat Sima Yi, but you may not be able to carry a man who has to die.
story.zuizhong.battle.2.text: Seal the scroll, and I bind these apocrypha into a book. They will live on the page you rewrote, but never reach the next one.
story.zuizhong.battle.3.text: Restore the record, and I take back the ink and brush. The snow of Maicheng, the wind of Wuzhang Plains remain as they were; you carry away only the memory of having seen them.
story.zuizhong.battle.4.text: Tear the scroll, and anyone may live again, anyone may die again. There is no draft, and no me to catch you when you fall.
story.zuizhong.battle.5.text: At Huarong you let Cao Cao go, trusting that one word, 'righteousness,' could outweigh future ruin. Today I ask again: do you dare trust that the unknown can outweigh the ending?
story.zuizhong.battle.6.text: At Huarong you let the blade fall, and changed a villain's fate—but not the heirs who would fight for his seat. Tearing the scroll will not spare you the choice.
story.zuizhong.battle.7.text: I know every old card of yours, but not the next one. That, reader, is why I am willing to sit down and gamble with you.
story.zuizhong.coldOpen.0.text: You let Lü Bu live at Baimen Tower, and afterward every man had one more road than he should have had. You think I did not see? I have kept every stroke.
story.zuizhong.coldOpen.1.text: You saved Guan Yu at Maicheng, and I watched Yiling lose its reason and Baidicheng lose its lingering grief. But you have not saved every regret, have you?
story.zuizhong.coldOpen.2.text: The snow at Maicheng is still there; the fire at Yiling was waiting too. You have saved some, and with your own hand turned past pages you could not reach in time.
story.zuizhong.coldOpen.3.text: Seal the scroll and keep your unofficial history; return the history and give back the lives as they were; tear the scroll and let no one foreknow anything again. Beat me, and only then is the choice yours.
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.0.bio: He remembers that you once carried an ending out of this page, yet still will not admit the book has only one place to end.
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.0.quote: Back to rewrite the answer again? This time even I won't keep it for you.
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.1.bio: He saw the southeast star still burning, and he knew that saving Kongming had not made history any lighter.
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.1.quote: You saved him once—does that mean you truly know how to save anyone?
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.2.bio: He knows every page you have turned, yet for the first time he sits where he can only read the cards, not set the outcome.
story.zuizhong.intros.写卷人.2.quote: I wrote where you came from. Now let me see what you choose.
story.zuizhong.loss.clue: Lesson · The Writer knows your old tricks, but can only bet by the odds; on a replay his false tells decrease—don't let his all-knowing tone frighten you off.
story.zuizhong.loss.text: He lifted his brush and added a 'again' beside your name, and all the rewrites receded to the margin. But he did not erase the seat you had taken—which means that next time, he will still need you to come.
story.zuizhong.objective: Make the Writer admit you are not a footnote to his text; win the last hand and decide, between sealing the scroll, returning the history, and tearing it up, where the book goes.
story.zuizhong.win.hook: All three answers lie in the next question. What you choose is not the ending, but who has the right to write it.
story.zuizhong.win.text: The Writer pushed back his cards, and for the first time did not write an ending for you. On the table lay side by side a sealing cord, an old history, and a paper knife without a blade: seal the scroll and keep what was changed; restore the record and bear what was lost; tear the scroll and return it to the unknown. As you reached out, the whole book was waiting.

tell.archetype.commander.strongFake.2: All of you watch—this hand is certain!

tell.archetype.commander.strongTrue.1: Provisions are ample. What fear of a long siege?

tell.archetype.sage.strongFake.2: This plan cannot fail… it cannot!

tell.archetype.sage.trapLeak.1: Half a moment more, and the fire will be just right.
tell.archetype.sage.trapLeak.2: We wait quietly for the change.
tell.archetype.sage.weakFake.0: My talents are shallow—I yield the first move to you.
tell.archetype.sage.weakFake.1: Today we discuss the way, not the win.
tell.archetype.sage.weakFake.2: You go ahead; I'll hold the rear.
tell.archetype.sage.weakTrue.1: One tempo lost, and the whole board binds my hands.

tell.archetype.veteran.bluffLeak.2: Call, then. What are you hesitating for?
tell.archetype.veteran.strongFake.0: In my day I… and today I still can!
tell.archetype.veteran.strongFake.1: The old blade is not dull—not dull!
tell.archetype.veteran.strongTrue.1: The old experience is still here.

tell.archetype.veteran.trapLeak.1: An old fellow's patience is the hardest to endure.
tell.archetype.veteran.trapLeak.2: No hurry. The tea is still hot.
tell.archetype.veteran.weakFake.0: This old man yields to the worthy.
tell.archetype.veteran.weakFake.1: Just playing along—don't take it seriously.
tell.archetype.veteran.weakFake.2: At my age, win or lose matters little.
tell.archetype.veteran.weakTrue.1: The hand is slow. I'll own it.
tell.archetype.veteran.weakTrue.2: This old head just won't turn anymore.

tell.famous.caocao.strongFake.1: Better I betray others than they betray me—so too this hand!

tell.famous.caocao.trapLeak.0: Let us watch him spear-in-hand, composing verse.
tell.famous.caocao.trapLeak.1: I am fond of laying schemes—in my sleep.
tell.famous.caocao.weakFake.0: Cao is off his game today. I give you three parts.
tell.famous.caocao.weakFake.1: I am merciful today. I break my rule and yield.
tell.famous.caocao.weakTrue.0: Winning is a joy; losing, too, has its charm.

tell.famous.diaochan.strongFake.0: This humble maid... may not lose, you know?

tell.famous.diaochan.strongTrue.0: The dance beneath the moon knows its measure.

tell.famous.guanyu.bluffLeak.0: Guess—does this blade leave its sheath?

title.startSub: Between the records and the romance, there is a card table
title.story: You found a tattered scroll, the Records of Heroes, telling of another Three Kingdoms — heroes who fought for the realm by day and gambled for it by night. Each page turned, the chaos begins anew; win the table, and one regret is rewritten.
title.sub: The histories record the battlefield, never the card table
